  simpa only [mul_pow, pow_two, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm] using hc

name: Hellinger.Fourier.unit_ne_zero
statement: theorem unit_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : unit i ≠ (fun _ => false)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hi := congrFun h i
  simp [unit] at hi

name: Hellinger.Fourier.translate_comp
statement:
theorem translate_comp {n : ℕ} (u v x : Cube n) :
    translate u (translate v x) = translate (translate u v) x
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  cases hxi : x i <;> cases hui : u i <;> cases hvi : v i <;>
    simp [translate, hxi, hui, hvi]

name: Hellinger.Fourier.translate_unit
statement:
theorem translate_unit {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (x : Cube n) :
    translate (unit i) x = Function.update x i (!(x i))
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  by_cases h : j = i
  · subst j
    cases hxi : x i <;> simp [translate, unit, hxi]
  · simp [translate, unit, h]

name: Hellinger.Fourier.unit_pair_ne_zero
statement:
theorem unit_pair_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    translate (unit j) (unit i) ≠ (fun _ => false)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hi := congrFun h i
  simp [translate, unit, hij] at hi

name: Hellinger.Fourier.mean_translated_product
statement:
theorem mean_translated_product {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ) (u v : Cube n) :
    mean (fun x => f (translate u x) * f (translate v x)) =
      autocorrelation f (translate v u)
proof:
:= by
  have h := mean_translate
    (fun x => f (translate u x) * f (translate v x)) u
  simp only [translate_twice, translate_comp] at h
  exact h.symm

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.weightedMeasure_singleton
statement:
@[simp] theorem weightedMeasure_singleton (p : α → ℝ) (a : α) :
    weightedMeasure p {a} = ENNReal.ofReal (p a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [weightedMeasure, Measure.finsetSum_apply, Measure.smul_apply, Measure.dirac_apply', Pi.single_apply]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.weightedMeasure_real_singleton
statement:
theorem weightedMeasure_real_singleton (p : α → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (a : α) :
    (weightedMeasure p).real {a} = p a
proof:
:= by
  rw [measureReal_def, weightedMeasure_singleton, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hp a)]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.weightedMeasure_univ
statement:
theorem weightedMeasure_univ (p : α → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) :
    weightedMeasure p univ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑ a, p a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [weightedMeasure, Measure.finsetSum_apply, ← ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun a _ => hp a)]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.weightedMeasure_integral
statement:
theorem weightedMeasure_integral (p : α → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (f : α → ℝ) :
    ∫ a, f a ∂weightedMeasure p = ∑ a, p a * f a
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_fintype Integrable.of_finite]
  simp only [weightedMeasure_real_singleton p hp, smul_eq_mul]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.weightedMeasure_eq_withDensity
statement:
theorem weightedMeasure_eq_withDensity (p q : α → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a)
    (hq : ∀ a, 0 ≤ q a) (hs : ∀ a, q a = 0 → p a = 0) :
    weightedMeasure p = (weightedMeasure q).withDensity (fun a => ENNReal.ofReal (p a / q a))
proof:
:= by
  apply Measure.ext_of_singleton
  intro a
  rw [weightedMeasure_singleton, withDensity_apply _ (measurableSet_singleton a),
    lintegral_singleton, weightedMeasure_singleton]
  by_cases hqa : q a = 0
  · simp [hqa, hs a hqa]
  · rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (div_nonneg (hp a) (hq a)), div_mul_cancel₀ _ hqa]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.weightedMeasure_absolutelyContinuous
statement:
theorem weightedMeasure_absolutelyContinuous (p q : α → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a)
    (hq : ∀ a, 0 ≤ q a) (hs : ∀ a, q a = 0 → p a = 0) :
    weightedMeasure p ≪ weightedMeasure q
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightedMeasure_eq_withDensity p q hp hq hs]
  exact withDensity_absolutelyContinuous _ _

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.weightedMeasure_llr
statement:
theorem weightedMeasure_llr (p q : α → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a)
    (hq : ∀ a, 0 ≤ q a) (hs : ∀ a, q a = 0 → p a = 0) :
    llr (weightedMeasure p) (weightedMeasure q) =ᵐ[weightedMeasure p]
      fun a => Real.log (p a / q a)
proof:
:= by
  have hac := weightedMeasure_absolutelyContinuous p q hp hq hs
  have hd : (weightedMeasure p).rnDeriv (weightedMeasure q) =ᵐ[weightedMeasure q]
      fun a => ENNReal.ofReal (p a / q a) := by
    rw [weightedMeasure_eq_withDensity p q hp hq hs]
    exact Measure.rnDeriv_withDensity _ (measurable_of_countable _)
  filter_upwards [hac hd] with a ha
  simp only [llr, ha, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (div_nonneg (hp a) (hq a))]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.klDiv_weightedMeasure_ne_top
statement:
theorem klDiv_weightedMeasure_ne_top (p q : α → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a)
    (hq : ∀ a, 0 ≤ q a) (hs : ∀ a, q a = 0 → p a = 0) :
    InformationTheory.klDiv (weightedMeasure p) (weightedMeasure q) ≠ ∞
proof:
:=
  InformationTheory.klDiv_ne_top (weightedMeasure_absolutelyContinuous p q hp hq hs)
    Integrable.of_finite

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.klDiv_weightedMeasure
statement:
theorem klDiv_weightedMeasure (p q : α → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a)
    (hq : ∀ a, 0 ≤ q a) (hs : ∀ a, q a = 0 → p a = 0)
    (hm : (∑ a, p a) = ∑ a, q a) :
    (InformationTheory.klDiv (weightedMeasure p) (weightedMeasure q)).toReal =
      ∑ a, p a * Real.log (p a / q a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [InformationTheory.toReal_klDiv_of_measure_eq
    (weightedMeasure_absolutelyContinuous p q hp hq hs)
    (by rw [weightedMeasure_univ p hp, weightedMeasure_univ q hq, hm])]
  rw [integral_congr_ae (weightedMeasure_llr p q hp hq hs), weightedMeasure_integral p hp]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.signProbability_nonneg
statement:
theorem signProbability_nonneg {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (b : Bool) :
    0 ≤ signProbability t b
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> simp only [signProbability, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true] <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.signProbability_sum
statement: theorem signProbability_sum (t : ℝ) : ∑ b : Bool, signProbability t b = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [signProbability]
  ring

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.mean_signProbability
statement:
theorem mean_signProbability {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (u : Ω → ℝ) (b : Bool) :
    mean (fun y => signProbability (u y) b) = signProbability (mean u) b
proof:
:= by
  cases b
  · change mean (fun y => (1 + u y) / 2) = (1 + mean u) / 2
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
    rw [mean_mul_const, mean_add, mean_const]
  · change mean (fun y => (1 - u y) / 2) = (1 - mean u) / 2
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
    rw [mean_mul_const, mean_sub, mean_const]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.signProbability_zero_of_mean_zero
statement:
theorem signProbability_zero_of_mean_zero
    {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (u : Ω → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ y, u y ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (b : Bool)
    (hm : signProbability (mean u) b = 0) (y : Ω) : signProbability (u y) b = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmean : mean (fun y => signProbability (u y) b) = 0 := by rw [mean_signProbability, hm]
  have hs : (∑ y, signProbability (u y) b) = 0 := by
    unfold mean at hmean
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hmean).resolve_left (inv_ne_zero (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero))
  exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun y _ => signProbability_nonneg (hu y) b)).mp hs
    y (Finset.mem_univ y)

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.posteriorMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem posteriorMass_nonneg {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (u : Ω → ℝ) (hu : ∀ y, u y ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (p : Bool × Ω) :
    0 ≤ posteriorMass u p
proof: := mul_nonneg (by positivity) (signProbability_nonneg (hu p.2) p.1)

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.productMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem productMass_nonneg {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (u : Ω → ℝ) (hu : ∀ y, u y ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (p : Bool × Ω) :
    0 ≤ productMass u p
proof:
:=
  mul_nonneg (by positivity) (signProbability_nonneg (EntropyTransfer.mean_mem_Icc hu) p.1)

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.posteriorMass_support
statement:
theorem posteriorMass_support {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (u : Ω → ℝ) (hu : ∀ y, u y ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (p : Bool × Ω)
    (hp : productMass u p = 0) : posteriorMass u p = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero)
  have hm := (mul_eq_zero.mp hp).resolve_left hcard
  simp only [posteriorMass, signProbability_zero_of_mean_zero u hu p.1 hm p.2, mul_zero]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.posteriorMass_sum
statement:
theorem posteriorMass_sum {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (u : Ω → ℝ) :
    ∑ p, posteriorMass u p = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [posteriorMass, ← Finset.mul_sum, signProbability_sum, mul_one]
  simp [Fintype.card_ne_zero]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.productMass_sum
statement:
theorem productMass_sum {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (u : Ω → ℝ) :
    ∑ p, productMass u p = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [productMass, ← Finset.mul_sum, signProbability_sum, mul_one]
  simp [Fintype.card_ne_zero]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.signProbability_entropy
statement:
theorem signProbability_entropy (t : ℝ) :
    (∑ b : Bool, signProbability t b * Real.log (signProbability t b)) =
      -Real.binEntropy ((1 - t) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hrel : 1 - (1 - t) / 2 = (1 + t) / 2 := by ring
  rw [Real.binEntropy, Real.log_inv, Real.log_inv, hrel]
  simp [signProbability]
  ring

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.mul_log_div_of_support
statement:
theorem mul_log_div_of_support (p q : ℝ) (h : q = 0 → p = 0) :
    p * Real.log (p / q) = p * Real.log p - p * Real.log q
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · simp [hp]
  · have hq : q ≠ 0 := mt h hp
    rw [Real.log_div hp hq]
    ring

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.posteriorMass_KL_sum
statement:
theorem posteriorMass_KL_sum {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (u : Ω → ℝ) (hu : ∀ y, u y ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    (∑ p, posteriorMass u p * Real.log (posteriorMass u p / productMass u p)) =
      Real.binEntropy ((1 - mean u) / 2) - mean (fun y => Real.binEntropy ((1 - u y) / 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero)
  have hterm (b : Bool) (y : Ω) :
      posteriorMass u (b, y) * Real.log (posteriorMass u (b, y) / productMass u (b, y)) =
        (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹ *
          (signProbability (u y) b * Real.log (signProbability (u y) b) -
            signProbability (u y) b * Real.log (signProbability (mean u) b)) := by
    dsimp only [posteriorMass, productMass]
    rw [mul_div_mul_left _ _ hcard, mul_assoc,
      mul_log_div_of_support _ _ (fun h => signProbability_zero_of_mean_zero u hu b h y)]
  simp_rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, hterm]
  simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [mul_sub]
  have hfirst : (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹ *
      ∑ b : Bool, ∑ y, signProbability (u y) b * Real.log (signProbability (u y) b) =
        -mean (fun y => Real.binEntropy ((1 - u y) / 2)) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp only [signProbability_entropy, mean, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, mul_neg]
  have hsecond : (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹ *
      ∑ b : Bool, ∑ y, signProbability (u y) b * Real.log (signProbability (mean u) b) =
        -Real.binEntropy ((1 - mean u) / 2) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    simp_rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← mul_assoc]
    change (∑ b : Bool, mean (fun y => signProbability (u y) b) *
      Real.log (signProbability (mean u) b)) = _
    simp only [mean_signProbability, signProbability_entropy]
  rw [hfirst, hsecond]
  ring

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.weightedMeasure_map
statement:
theorem weightedMeasure_map {β : Type*} [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass β] (p : α → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (F : α → β) :
    (weightedMeasure p).map F = weightedMeasure (fun b => ∑ a, if F a = b then p a else 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Measure.ext_of_singleton
  intro b
  rw [Measure.map_apply (measurable_of_countable F) (measurableSet_singleton b),
    weightedMeasure_singleton]
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun a _ => ite_nonneg (hp a) le_rfl)]
  simp [weightedMeasure, Measure.finsetSum_apply, Measure.smul_apply, Set.indicator_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.weightedMeasure_map_fst
statement:
theorem weightedMeasure_map_fst {β : Type*} [Fintype β] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass β] (p : α × β → ℝ) (hp : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) :
    (weightedMeasure p).map Prod.fst = weightedMeasure (fun a => ∑ b, p (a, b))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [weightedMeasure_map p hp Prod.fst]
  congr 1
  funext a
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_comm]
  simp

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.weightedMeasure_map_snd
statement:
theorem weightedMeasure_map_snd {β : Type*} [Fintype β] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass β] (p : α × β → ℝ) (hp : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) :
    (weightedMeasure p).map Prod.snd = weightedMeasure (fun b => ∑ a, p (a, b))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [weightedMeasure_map p hp Prod.snd]
  congr 1
  funext b
  simp [Fintype.sum_prod_type]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.weightedMeasure_prod
statement:
theorem weightedMeasure_prod {β : Type*} [Fintype β] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass β] (p : α → ℝ) (q : β → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) :
    (weightedMeasure p).prod (weightedMeasure q) = weightedMeasure (fun z => p z.1 * q z.2)
proof:
:= by
  apply Measure.ext_of_singleton
  rintro ⟨a, b⟩
  rw [← Set.singleton_prod_singleton, Measure.prod_prod, weightedMeasure_singleton, weightedMeasure_singleton,
    Set.singleton_prod_singleton, weightedMeasure_singleton, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (hp a)]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.posteriorMass_first_marginal
statement:
theorem posteriorMass_first_marginal (u : Ω → ℝ) (b : Bool) :
    (∑ y, posteriorMass u (b, y)) = signProbability (mean u) b
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [posteriorMass, ← Finset.mul_sum, mean] using mean_signProbability u b

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.posteriorMass_second_marginal
statement:
theorem posteriorMass_second_marginal (u : Ω → ℝ) (y : Ω) :
    (∑ b : Bool, posteriorMass u (b, y)) = (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp only [posteriorMass, ← Finset.mul_sum, signProbability_sum, mul_one]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.posteriorJoint_probability
statement:
theorem posteriorJoint_probability (u : Ω → ℝ) (hu : ∀ y, u y ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (posteriorJoint u)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  rw [posteriorJoint, weightedMeasure_univ _ (posteriorMass_nonneg u hu), posteriorMass_sum]
  simp

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.posteriorJoint_map_fst
statement:
theorem posteriorJoint_map_fst (u : Ω → ℝ) (hu : ∀ y, u y ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    (posteriorJoint u).map Prod.fst = weightedMeasure (signProbability (mean u))
proof:
:= by
  rw [posteriorJoint, weightedMeasure_map_fst _ (posteriorMass_nonneg u hu)]
  simp only [posteriorMass_first_marginal]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.posteriorJoint_map_snd
statement:
theorem posteriorJoint_map_snd (u : Ω → ℝ) (hu : ∀ y, u y ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    (posteriorJoint u).map Prod.snd = weightedMeasure (fun _ : Ω => (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  rw [posteriorJoint, weightedMeasure_map_snd _ (posteriorMass_nonneg u hu)]
  simp only [posteriorMass_second_marginal]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.posteriorJoint_product_marginals
statement:
theorem posteriorJoint_product_marginals (u : Ω → ℝ) (hu : ∀ y, u y ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    ((posteriorJoint u).map Prod.fst).prod ((posteriorJoint u).map Prod.snd) =
      weightedMeasure (productMass u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [posteriorJoint_map_fst u hu, posteriorJoint_map_snd u hu,
    weightedMeasure_prod _ _ (signProbability_nonneg (EntropyTransfer.mean_mem_Icc hu))]
  congr 1
  funext p
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.posteriorJoint_KL_ne_top
statement:
theorem posteriorJoint_KL_ne_top (u : Ω → ℝ) (hu : ∀ y, u y ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    InformationTheory.klDiv (posteriorJoint u)
      (((posteriorJoint u).map Prod.fst).prod ((posteriorJoint u).map Prod.snd)) ≠ ∞
proof:
:= by
  rw [posteriorJoint_product_marginals u hu]
  exact klDiv_weightedMeasure_ne_top _ _ (posteriorMass_nonneg u hu) (productMass_nonneg u hu)
    (posteriorMass_support u hu)

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.posteriorJoint_mutualInformation
statement:
theorem posteriorJoint_mutualInformation (u : Ω → ℝ) (hu : ∀ y, u y ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    mutualInformationBits (posteriorJoint u) =
      PaperSpecs.binaryEntropyBits ((1 - mean u) / 2) -
        mean (fun y => PaperSpecs.binaryEntropyBits ((1 - u y) / 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mutualInformationBits, posteriorJoint_product_marginals u hu]
  change (InformationTheory.klDiv (weightedMeasure (posteriorMass u))
    (weightedMeasure (productMass u))).toReal / Real.log 2 = _
  rw [klDiv_weightedMeasure _ _ (posteriorMass_nonneg u hu) (productMass_nonneg u hu)
    (posteriorMass_support u hu) (by rw [posteriorMass_sum, productMass_sum]),
    posteriorMass_KL_sum u hu, sub_div]
  unfold PaperSpecs.binaryEntropyBits
  congr 1
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mean_mul_const]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.signProbability_boolean
statement:
theorem signProbability_boolean (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (x : Ω) (b : Bool) :
    signProbability (f x) b = if outputBit f x = b then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases hf x with h | h <;> cases b <;> norm_num [signProbability, outputBit, h]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.apply_signProbability
statement:
theorem apply_signProbability (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (y : Ω) (b : Bool) :
    (∑ x, K.weight y x * signProbability (f x) b) = signProbability (K.apply f y) b
proof:
:= by
  cases b
  · simp only [signProbability, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, ← mul_div_assoc, mul_add,
      mul_one, ← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_add_distrib, K.row_sum, UniformChannel.apply]
  · simp only [signProbability, if_true, ← mul_div_assoc, mul_sub,
      mul_one, ← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, K.row_sum, UniformChannel.apply]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.channelMass_nonneg
statement: theorem channelMass_nonneg (K : UniformChannel Ω) (z : Ω × Ω) : 0 ≤ channelMass K z
proof:
:=
  mul_nonneg (by positivity) (K.nonneg _ _)

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.channelMass_first_marginal
statement:
theorem channelMass_first_marginal (K : UniformChannel Ω) (x : Ω) :
    (∑ y, channelMass K (x, y)) = (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp [channelMass, ← Finset.mul_sum, K.column_sum]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.channelMass_second_marginal
statement:
theorem channelMass_second_marginal (K : UniformChannel Ω) (y : Ω) :
    (∑ x, channelMass K (x, y)) = (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp [channelMass, ← Finset.mul_sum, K.row_sum]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.channelJoint_probability
statement: theorem channelJoint_probability (K : UniformChannel Ω) : IsProbabilityMeasure (channelJoint K)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  rw [channelJoint, weightedMeasure_univ _ (channelMass_nonneg K), Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp only [channelMass_first_marginal, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  simp [Fintype.card_ne_zero]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.channelJoint_map_fst
statement:
theorem channelJoint_map_fst (K : UniformChannel Ω) :
    (channelJoint K).map Prod.fst = weightedMeasure (fun _ : Ω => (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  rw [channelJoint, weightedMeasure_map_fst _ (channelMass_nonneg K)]
  simp only [channelMass_first_marginal]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.channelJoint_map_snd
statement:
theorem channelJoint_map_snd (K : UniformChannel Ω) :
    (channelJoint K).map Prod.snd = weightedMeasure (fun _ : Ω => (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  rw [channelJoint, weightedMeasure_map_snd _ (channelMass_nonneg K)]
  simp only [channelMass_second_marginal]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.outputJoint_eq_posteriorJoint
statement:
theorem outputJoint_eq_posteriorJoint (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) :
    outputJoint K f = posteriorJoint (K.apply f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [outputJoint, channelJoint, weightedMeasure_map _ (channelMass_nonneg K)]
  unfold posteriorJoint
  congr 1
  funext p
  rcases p with ⟨b, y⟩
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  have ht (x : Ω) :
      (∑ z : Ω, if (outputBit f x, z) = (b, y) then channelMass K (x, z) else 0) =
        if outputBit f x = b then channelMass K (x, y) else 0 := by
    by_cases h : outputBit f x = b <;> simp [h]
  simp_rw [ht]
  have hs (x : Ω) : (if outputBit f x = b then channelMass K (x, y) else 0) =
      (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹ * (K.weight y x * signProbability (f x) b) := by
    rw [signProbability_boolean f hf]
    split_ifs <;> simp [channelMass]
  simp_rw [hs]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, apply_signProbability]
  rfl

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.outputJoint_probability
statement:
theorem outputJoint_probability (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) : IsProbabilityMeasure (outputJoint K f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [outputJoint_eq_posteriorJoint K f hf]
  apply posteriorJoint_probability
  apply K.apply_mem_Icc
  intro x
  rcases hf x with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.outputJoint_KL_ne_top
statement:
theorem outputJoint_KL_ne_top (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) :
    InformationTheory.klDiv (outputJoint K f)
      (((outputJoint K f).map Prod.fst).prod ((outputJoint K f).map Prod.snd)) ≠ ∞
proof:
:= by
  rw [outputJoint_eq_posteriorJoint K f hf]
  apply posteriorJoint_KL_ne_top
  apply K.apply_mem_Icc
  intro x
  rcases hf x with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.outputJoint_mutualInformation
statement:
theorem outputJoint_mutualInformation (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) :
    mutualInformationBits (outputJoint K f) =
      PaperSpecs.binaryEntropyBits ((1 - mean f) / 2) -
        mean (fun y => PaperSpecs.binaryEntropyBits ((1 - K.apply f y) / 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [outputJoint_eq_posteriorJoint K f hf,
    posteriorJoint_mutualInformation _ (K.apply_mem_Icc f (fun x => by
      rcases hf x with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num)), K.mean_apply]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.cubeBSC_joint_mass
statement:
theorem cubeBSC_joint_mass (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (x y : PaperSpecs.Cube n) :
    channelMass (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) (x, y) =
      (2 ^ n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∏ i, if y i = x i then (1 + ρ) / 2 else (1 - ρ) / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [channelMass, cubeBSC, UniformChannel.product, bsc, Fintype.card_fun,
    Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.bscMutualInformation_eq_posteriorInformation
statement:
theorem bscMutualInformation_eq_posteriorInformation {n : ℕ} (f : PaperSpecs.Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : PaperSpecs.IsBoolean f) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    bscMutualInformation f ρ hρ = PaperSpecs.posteriorInformation f ρ hρ
proof:
:=
  outputJoint_mutualInformation (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) f hf

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.bscMutualInformation_KL_ne_top
statement:
theorem bscMutualInformation_KL_ne_top {n : ℕ} (f : PaperSpecs.Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : PaperSpecs.IsBoolean f) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    InformationTheory.klDiv (outputJoint (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) f)
      (((outputJoint (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) f).map Prod.fst).prod
        ((outputJoint (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) f).map Prod.snd)) ≠ ∞
proof:
:=
  outputJoint_KL_ne_top (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) f hf

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.bscMutualInformation_le_of_hellinger
statement:
theorem bscMutualInformation_le_of_hellinger {n : ℕ} (f : PaperSpecs.Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : PaperSpecs.IsBoolean f) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hH : PaperSpecs.HellingerBound f ρ hρ) :
    bscMutualInformation f ρ hρ ≤ 1 - PaperSpecs.binaryEntropyBits ((1 - ρ) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bscMutualInformation_eq_posteriorInformation f hf]
  exact EntropyTransfer.hellinger_implies_ck f hf ρ hρ hH

name: Hellinger.SmallPrincipalRanks.alternating_rank_ge_two
statement:
theorem alternating_rank_ge_two {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (C : Matrix ι ι F2) (hs : C.IsSymm) (hd : ∀ i, C i i = 0) (hC : C ≠ 0) :
    2 ≤ C.rank
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij⟩ : ∃ i j, C i j ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hC (Matrix.ext h)
  have hji : C j i = C i j := congrArg (fun A => A i j) hs.eq
  let e : Fin 2 → ι := ![i, j]
  have hdet : (C.submatrix e e).det ≠ 0 := by
    simp only [Matrix.det_fin_two, Matrix.submatrix_apply]
    change C i i * C j j - C i j * C j i ≠ 0
    rw [hd, hd, hji, zero_mul, zero_sub]
    exact neg_ne_zero.mpr (mul_ne_zero hij hij)
  have hr := Matrix.rank_of_det_ne_zero hdet
  have hle := C.rank_submatrix_le e e
  simpa only [hr, Fintype.card_fin] using hle

name: Hellinger.SmallPrincipalRanks.alternating_three_rank
statement:
theorem alternating_three_rank (C : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) F2)
    (hs : C.IsSymm) (hd : ∀ i, C i i = 0) (hC : C ≠ 0) : C.rank = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hs10 : C 1 0 = C 0 1 := congrArg (fun A => A 0 1) hs.eq
  have hs20 : C 2 0 = C 0 2 := congrArg (fun A => A 0 2) hs.eq
  have hs21 : C 2 1 = C 1 2 := congrArg (fun A => A 1 2) hs.eq
  let v : Fin 3 → F2 := ![C 1 2, C 0 2, C 0 1]
  have hv : v ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h12 : C 1 2 = 0 := congrFun h 0
    have h02 : C 0 2 = 0 := congrFun h 1
    have h01 : C 0 1 = 0 := congrFun h 2
    apply hC
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [hd, hs10, hs20, hs21, h12, h02, h01]
  have hker : C.mulVecLin v = 0 := by
    change C *ᵥ v = 0
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;>
      dsimp [v] <;> simp only [hd, hs10, hs20, hs21] <;>
      ring_nf <;> simp only [show (2 : F2) = 0 from rfl, mul_zero]
  have hkpos : 0 < Module.finrank F2 C.mulVecLin.ker := by
    apply Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr
    refine ⟨⟨v, hker⟩, ?_⟩
    intro h
    exact hv (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  have hdim := C.mulVecLin.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  have htotal : Module.finrank F2 (Fin 3 → F2) = 3 := by simp
  rw [htotal] at hdim
  have hlow := alternating_rank_ge_two C hs hd hC
  change C.rank + Module.finrank F2 C.mulVecLin.ker = 3 at hdim
  omega

name: Hellinger.SmallPrincipalRanks.principal_three_nonzero
statement:
theorem principal_three_nonzero (B : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) F2)
    (hs : B.IsSymm) (hd : ∀ i, B i i = 0) (hdet : B.det ≠ 0)
    (S : Finset (Fin 4)) (hS : S.card = 3) : principalMatrix B S ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hSc : Sᶜ.card = 1 := by simp [Finset.card_compl, hS]
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hSc
  have hmem (i : Fin 4) (hi : i ≠ k) : i ∈ S := by
    by_contra hiS
    have hiC : i ∈ Sᶜ := by simpa using hiS
    rw [hk] at hiC
    exact hi (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hiC)
  have hz (i j : Fin 4) (hi : i ≠ k) (hj : j ≠ k) : B i j = 0 :=
    congrArg (fun C : Matrix S S F2 => C ⟨i, hmem i hi⟩ ⟨j, hmem j hj⟩) hzero
  let U : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 2) F2 := fun i j =>
    if j = 0 then B k i else if i = k then 1 else 0
  let V : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 4) F2 := fun i j =>
    if i = 0 then (if j = k then 1 else 0) else B k j
  have hfactor : B = U * V := by
    ext i j
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    by_cases hi : i = k
    · subst i
      by_cases hj : j = k
      · subst j
        simp [U, V, hd]
      · simp [U, V, hd, hj]
    · by_cases hj : j = k
      · subst j
        have hsym : B i k = B k i := congrArg (fun C => C k i) hs.eq
        simp [U, V, hi, hd, hsym]
      · simp [U, V, hi, hj, hz i j hi hj]
  have hr : B.rank = 4 := by simpa using Matrix.rank_of_det_ne_zero hdet
  have hU : U.rank ≤ 2 := by simpa using U.rank_le_card_width
  have hle := Matrix.rank_mul_le_left U V
  rw [← hfactor, hr] at hle
  omega

name: Hellinger.SmallPrincipalRanks.principal_three_rank
statement:
theorem principal_three_rank (B : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) F2)
    (hs : B.IsSymm) (hd : ∀ i, B i i = 0) (hdet : B.det ≠ 0)
    (S : Finset (Fin 4)) (hS : S.card = 3) : (principalMatrix B S).rank = 2
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin 3 ≃ S := (Finset.equivFinOfCardEq hS).symm
  let C := (principalMatrix B S).submatrix e e
  have hCs : C.IsSymm := by
    ext i j
    exact congrArg (fun A => A (e i).val (e j).val) hs.eq
  have hCd : ∀ i, C i i = 0 := fun i => hd (e i).val
  have hCn : C ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply principal_three_nonzero B hs hd hdet S hS
    ext i j
    have hh := congrArg (fun A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) F2 => A (e.symm i) (e.symm j)) h
    change C (e.symm i) (e.symm j) = (0 : F2) at hh
    change principalMatrix B S i j = (0 : F2)
    simpa only [C, Matrix.submatrix_apply, e.apply_symm_apply] using hh
  have hr := alternating_three_rank C hCs hCd hCn
  simpa only [C, Matrix.rank_submatrix] using hr

name: Hellinger.SmallPrincipalRanks.alternating_two_rank
statement:
theorem alternating_two_rank (C : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) F2)
    (hs : C.IsSymm) (hd : ∀ i, C i i = 0) :
    C.rank = if C 0 1 = 0 then 0 else 2
proof:
:= by
  have hs10 : C 1 0 = C 0 1 := congrArg (fun A => A 0 1) hs.eq
  by_cases h : C 0 1 = 0
  · rw [if_pos h]
    have hz : C = 0 := by
      ext i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [hd, hs10, h]
    rw [hz, Matrix.rank_zero]
  · rw [if_neg h]
    have hdet : C.det ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hd, hd, zero_mul, zero_sub, hs10]
      exact neg_ne_zero.mpr (mul_ne_zero h h)
    simpa using Matrix.rank_of_det_ne_zero hdet

name: Hellinger.SmallPrincipalRanks.principal_two_rank
statement:
theorem principal_two_rank {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) F2)
    (hs : B.IsSymm) (hd : ∀ i, B i i = 0) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (hS : S.card = 2)
    (i j : S) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (principalMatrix B S).rank = if B i j = 0 then 0 else 2
proof:
:= by
  let e₀ : Fin 2 → S := ![i, j]
  have heinj : Function.Injective e₀ := by
    intro x y h
    fin_cases x <;> fin_cases y
    · rfl
    · exact False.elim (hij h)
    · exact False.elim (hij h.symm)
    · rfl
  have hecard : Fintype.card (Fin 2) = Fintype.card S := by simpa using hS.symm
  let e : Fin 2 ≃ S := Equiv.ofBijective e₀
    ((Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card e₀).mpr ⟨heinj, hecard⟩)
  let C := (principalMatrix B S).submatrix e e
  have hCs : C.IsSymm := by
    ext x y
    exact congrArg (fun A => A (e x).val (e y).val) hs.eq
  have hCd : ∀ x, C x x = 0 := fun x => hd (e x).val
  have h := alternating_two_rank C hCs hCd
  have hval : C 0 1 = B i j := rfl
  rw [hval] at h
  simpa only [C, Matrix.rank_submatrix] using h

name: Hellinger.SmallPrincipalRanks.principal_two_rank_iff
statement:
theorem principal_two_rank_iff {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) F2)
    (hs : B.IsSymm) (hd : ∀ i, B i i = 0) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (hS : S.card = 2)
    (i j : S) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ((principalMatrix B S).rank = 2 ↔ B i j ≠ 0) ∧
      ((principalMatrix B S).rank = 0 ↔ B i j = 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [principal_two_rank B hs hd S hS i j hij]
  by_cases h : B i j = 0 <;> simp [h]

name: Hellinger.SmallPrincipalRanks.principal_empty_rank
statement:
theorem principal_empty_rank {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) F2) :
    (principalMatrix B ∅).rank = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hle := (principalMatrix B ∅).rank_le_card_width
  simpa using hle

name: Hellinger.SmallPrincipalRanks.inverse_polar_principal_three
statement:
theorem inverse_polar_principal_three (Q : Form 4) (hQ : IsUnit (polarMatrix Q).det)
    (S : Finset (Fin 4)) (hS : S.card = 3) :
    (principalMatrix (polarMatrix Q)⁻¹ S).rank = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hB := InterlaceMoment.inverse_polar_isAdjMatrix Q hQ
  apply principal_three_rank _ hB.symm hB.apply_diag _ S hS
  rw [Matrix.det_nonsing_inv, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
  exact inv_ne_zero (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mp hQ)

name: Hellinger.SmallPrincipalRanks.inverse_polar_principal_two
statement:
theorem inverse_polar_principal_two (Q : Form 4) (hQ : IsUnit (polarMatrix Q).det)
    (S : Finset (Fin 4)) (hS : S.card = 2) (i j : S) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (principalMatrix (polarMatrix Q)⁻¹ S).rank =
      if (polarMatrix Q)⁻¹ i j = 0 then 0 else 2
proof:
:= by
  have hB := InterlaceMoment.inverse_polar_isAdjMatrix Q hQ
  exact principal_two_rank _ hB.symm hB.apply_diag S hS i j hij

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.abs_diagonal
statement:
theorem abs_diagonal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (d : ι → ℝ) :
    CFC.abs (Matrix.diagonal d) = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => |d i|)
proof:
:= by
  apply CFC.sqrt_unique
  · simp only [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
      Matrix.diagonal_conjTranspose, star_trivial]
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact abs_mul_abs_self (d i)
  · exact (Matrix.posSemidef_diagonal_iff.mpr (fun i => abs_nonneg (d i))).nonneg

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.traceNorm_diagonal
statement:
theorem traceNorm_diagonal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (d : ι → ℝ) :
    traceNorm (Matrix.diagonal d) = ∑ i, |d i|
proof:
:= by
  rw [traceNorm, abs_diagonal, Matrix.trace_diagonal]

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.multiplication_xor
statement:
theorem multiplication_xor (n : ℕ) (f : Cube n → ℝ) (s t : Cube n) :
    ParityBlocks.transformedReflection n f s t = Fourier.walsh f (Fourier.translate s t)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ParityBlocks.transformedReflection, Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply,
    hadamardUnitary_coe, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, hadamard_transpose]
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_diagonal, ProductState.hadamard]
  calc
    (∑ x, (normalization n * Fourier.phase x s * f x) *
        (normalization n * Fourier.phase t x)) =
      normalization n ^ 2 * ∑ x, f x * Fourier.phase (Fourier.translate s t) x := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro x _
        rw [Fourier.phase_symm x s, ← FourierProducts.phase_product]
        ring
    _ = _ := by
      unfold Fourier.walsh mean
      rw [Fourier.cube_card]
      push_cast
      have hnorm := normalization_square n
      have hne : (2 : ℝ) ^ n ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have hn : normalization n ^ 2 = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ := by
        rw [← one_div]
        apply (eq_div_iff hne).mpr
        exact hnorm
      rw [hn]

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.sum_three_bits
statement:
theorem sum_three_bits {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R] (F : Cube 3 → R) :
    (∑ x, F x) = ∑ a : Bool, ∑ b : Bool, ∑ c : Bool, F ![a, b, c]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← threeBitsEquiv.symm.sum_comp F]
  simp [Fintype.sum_prod_type, threeBitsEquiv]

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.vec3_last
statement: @[simp] theorem vec3_last (a b c : Bool) : (![a, b, c] : Cube 3) 2 = c
proof: := rfl

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.pairSwap_involutive
statement: theorem pairSwap_involutive : Function.Involutive pairSwap
proof:
:= by
  unfold Function.Involutive
  decide

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.pairing_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem pairing_apply (x : Cube 3) : pairing x = pairSwap x
proof: := rfl

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.degree_three
statement:
theorem degree_three (a b c : Bool) :
    Fourier.degree ![a, b, c] =
      (if a then 1 else 0) + (if b then 1 else 0) + (if c then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> cases c <;> decide

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.pairing_nofixed
statement: theorem pairing_nofixed (x : Cube 3) : pairing x ≠ x
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ x : Cube 3, pairSwap x ≠ x := by decide
  exact h x

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.pairing_inv
statement: theorem pairing_inv : pairing⁻¹ = pairing
proof: := rfl

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.fourierReflection_isHermitian
statement: theorem fourierReflection_isHermitian : fourierReflection.IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.IsHermitian, fourierReflection, pairing_inv]

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.fourierReflection_squared
statement: theorem fourierReflection_squared : fourierReflection * fourierReflection = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [fourierReflection, ← Matrix.permMatrix_mul]
  have h : pairing * pairing = 1 := by
    apply Equiv.ext
    intro x
    exact pairSwap_involutive x
  rw [h, Matrix.permMatrix_one]

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.fourierReflection_entry
statement:
theorem fourierReflection_entry (x y : Cube 3) :
    fourierReflection x y = if pairing x = y then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [fourierReflection, Equiv.toPEquiv_apply]
  rfl

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.fourierReflection_diagonal
statement: theorem fourierReflection_diagonal (x : Cube 3) : fourierReflection x x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [fourierReflection_entry, if_neg (pairing_nofixed x)]

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.conjugate_diagonal
statement:
theorem conjugate_diagonal (d : Cube 3 → ℝ) :
    fourierReflection * Matrix.diagonal d * fourierReflection =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun x => d (pairing x))
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.ext_iff_mulVec.mpr
  intro v
  ext x
  simp only [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, fourierReflection, Matrix.permMatrix_mulVec,
    Function.comp_apply, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal]
  change d (pairSwap x) * v (pairSwap (pairSwap x)) = d (pairSwap x) * v x
  rw [pairSwap_involutive]

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.fourier_trace_distance
statement:
theorem fourier_trace_distance (c : ℝ) (hc : c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    traceNorm (Matrix.diagonal (eigenvalue 3 c) -
      fourierReflection * Matrix.diagonal (eigenvalue 3 c) * fourierReflection) / 2 =
        c * (1 + c ^ 2) / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [conjugate_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_sub, traceNorm_diagonal, sum_three_bits]
  norm_num [Fintype.sum_bool, eigenvalue, degree_three, pairSwap, Matrix.cons_val]
  have h₁ : 0 ≤ ((1 + c) / 2) ^ 3 - ((1 + c) / 2) ^ 2 * ((1 - c) / 2) := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hc.1 (sq_nonneg ((1 + c) / 2))]
  have h₂ : 0 ≤ (1 + c) / 2 * ((1 - c) / 2) ^ 2 - ((1 - c) / 2) ^ 3 := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hc.1 (sq_nonneg ((1 - c) / 2))]
  rw [abs_sub_comm (((1 - c) / 2) ^ 3),
    abs_sub_comm (((1 + c) / 2) ^ 2 * ((1 - c) / 2)),
    abs_of_nonneg h₁, abs_of_nonneg h₂]
  ring

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.hadamard_conjugate_involution
statement:
theorem hadamard_conjugate_involution (n : ℕ) (A : Matrix (Cube n) (Cube n) ℝ) :
    Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (hadamardUnitary n)
      (Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (hadamardUnitary n) A) = A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, hadamardUnitary_coe,
    Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
    hadamard_transpose]
  simp only [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hadamard_squared, Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hadamard_squared, Matrix.mul_one]

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.reflection_isHermitian
statement: theorem reflection_isHermitian : reflection.IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  change star reflection = reflection
  rw [reflection, ← map_star]
  congr 1
  exact fourierReflection_isHermitian

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.reflection_squared
statement: theorem reflection_squared : reflection * reflection = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflection, ← map_mul, fourierReflection_squared, map_one]

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.reflection_fourier_diagonal
statement:
theorem reflection_fourier_diagonal (x : Cube 3) :
    (Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (hadamardUnitary 3) reflection) x x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflection, hadamard_conjugate_involution, fourierReflection_diagonal]

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.reflection_trace_distance
statement:
theorem reflection_trace_distance (c : ℝ) (hc : c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    traceNorm (state 3 c - reflection * state 3 c * reflection) / 2 =
      c * (1 + c ^ 2) / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← traceNorm_conjugate (hadamardUnitary 3)]
  rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, ParityBlocks.transformed_state,
    reflection, hadamard_conjugate_involution]
  exact fourier_trace_distance c hc

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.fourierReflection_not_multiplication
statement:
theorem fourierReflection_not_multiplication (f : Cube 3 → ℝ) :
    fourierReflection ≠ ParityBlocks.transformedReflection 3 f
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h₁ := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Cube 3) (Cube 3) ℝ =>
    M ![false, false, false] ![false, false, true]) h
  have h₂ := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Cube 3) (Cube 3) ℝ =>
    M ![false, true, false] ![false, true, true]) h
  rw [fourierReflection_entry, multiplication_xor] at h₁ h₂
  have hs : Fourier.translate ![false, false, false] ![false, false, true] =
      Fourier.translate ![false, true, false] ![false, true, true] := by decide
  rw [hs] at h₁
  norm_num [pairSwap, Matrix.cons_val, show
    (![true, false, false] : Cube 3) ≠ ![false, true, true] from by decide] at h₁ h₂
  linarith

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.reflection_not_multiplication
statement:
theorem reflection_not_multiplication (f : Cube 3 → ℝ) :
    reflection ≠ Matrix.diagonal f
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hh := congrArg (Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (hadamardUnitary 3)) h
  rw [reflection, hadamard_conjugate_involution] at hh
  exact fourierReflection_not_multiplication f hh

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.reflection_counterexample
statement:
theorem reflection_counterexample (c : ℝ) (hc : c ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∃ P : Matrix (Cube 3) (Cube 3) ℝ,
      P.IsHermitian ∧ P * P = 1 ∧
      (∀ x, (Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (hadamardUnitary 3) P) x x = 0) ∧
      traceNorm (state 3 c - P * state 3 c * P) / 2 = c * (1 + c ^ 2) / 2 ∧
      c * (1 + c ^ 2) / 2 < c ∧ (∀ f : Cube 3 → ℝ, P ≠ Matrix.diagonal f)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨reflection, reflection_isHermitian, reflection_squared,
    reflection_fourier_diagonal, reflection_trace_distance c ⟨hc.1.le, hc.2.le⟩,
    ?_, reflection_not_multiplication⟩
  have hs : c ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hc.2 hc.1, hc.2]
  nlinarith [mul_pos hc.1 (sub_pos.mpr hs)]

name: Hellinger.FunctionContracts.translation
statement:
theorem translation (n : ℕ) (f : Cube n → ℝ) (hf : IsBoolean f)
    (S : Finset (Fin n)) (hS : S.Nonempty) (hs : SignReversing f S)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean f = 0 ∧ root ρ ≤ posteriorRootMean f ρ hρ ∧
    HellingerBound f ρ hρ ∧
    bscMutualInformation f ρ hρ ≤ 1 - binaryEntropyBits ((1 - ρ) / 2) ∧
    (0 < ρ → ρ < 1 →
      (objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) = 1 - root ρ ↔ SignedDictatorOn f S) ∧
      (bscMutualInformation f ρ hρ = 1 - binaryEntropyBits ((1 - ρ) / 2) ↔
        SignedDictatorOn f S))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hm, hR, hH⟩ := ChannelSections.translation_hellinger n f hf S hS hs ρ hρ
  obtain ⟨hI, heI⟩ := ProbabilityContracts.translation_information n f hf S hS hs ρ hρ
  refine ⟨hm, hR, hH, hI, ?_⟩
  intro hp hl
  refine ⟨?_, heI hp hl⟩
  have heR := TranslationEquality.translation_equality n f hf S hS hs ρ hρ hp hl
  have hobj : objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) = 1 - posteriorRootMean f ρ hρ := by
    simp only [objective, UniformChannel.mean_apply, hm, posteriorRootMean]
    norm_num [root]
  rw [hobj]
  have he : (1 - posteriorRootMean f ρ hρ = 1 - root ρ) ↔
      posteriorRootMean f ρ hρ = root ρ := by constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
  exact he.trans heR

name: Hellinger.FunctionContracts.flat_spectra_and_quadratic_phases
statement:
theorem flat_spectra_and_quadratic_phases :
    (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (f : Cube n → ℝ), IsBoolean f → Flatness.IsBent f →
      ∀ (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1),
        HellingerBound f ρ hρ ∧
        bscMutualInformation f ρ hρ ≤ 1 - binaryEntropyBits ((1 - ρ) / 2) ∧
        (0 < ρ → objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) < 1 - root ρ)) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (f : Cube n → ℝ), IsQuadratic f →
      ∀ (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1),
        HellingerBound f ρ hρ ∧
        bscMutualInformation f ρ hρ ≤ 1 - binaryEntropyBits ((1 - ρ) / 2) ∧
        (0 < ρ → ρ < 1 →
          (objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) = 1 - root ρ ↔ SignedDictatorOn f Finset.univ) ∧
          (bscMutualInformation f ρ hρ = 1 - binaryEntropyBits ((1 - ρ) / 2) ↔
            SignedDictatorOn f Finset.univ)))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro n hn f hf hb ρ hρ
    obtain ⟨hH, hstrict⟩ := AllBent.paper_bent_hellinger n hn f hf hb ρ hρ
    exact ⟨hH, (ProbabilityContracts.bent_information n hn f hf hb ρ hρ).1, hstrict⟩
  · intro n hn f hq ρ hρ
    obtain ⟨hH, heH⟩ := AllQuadratic.paper_quadratic_hellinger n hn f hq ρ hρ
    obtain ⟨hI, heI⟩ := ProbabilityContracts.quadratic_information n hn f hq ρ hρ
    exact ⟨hH, hI, fun hp hl => ⟨heH hp hl, heI hp hl⟩⟩

name: Hellinger.FunctionContracts.flat_amplitude
statement: theorem flat_amplitude (n : ℕ) : Flatness.amplitude n = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℝ) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Flatness.amplitude, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_natCast (2 : ℝ) n,
    ← Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2), ← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
  congr 1
  ring

name: Hellinger.FunctionContracts.bent_definition_equivalence
statement:
theorem bent_definition_equivalence (n : ℕ) (f : Cube n → ℝ) :
    Flatness.IsBent f ↔ ∀ s, |Fourier.walsh f s| = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℝ) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Flatness.isBent_iff_abs, flat_amplitude]

name: Hellinger.FunctionContracts.consequences_of_flatness
statement:
theorem consequences_of_flatness (n : ℕ) (_hn : 0 < n) (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : IsBoolean f) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    Even n ∧ mean f ^ 2 = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ ∧
    mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x) ^ 2) = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ * (1 + ρ ^ 2) ^ n ∧
    (∀ x, |(cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℝ) / 2) * (1 + ρ) ^ n) ∧
    (∀ x, Flatness.sensitivity f x =
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => f (Function.update x i (!(x i))) ≠ f x)).card : ℝ)) ∧
    mean (Flatness.sensitivity f) = (n : ℝ) / 2 ∧
    mean (fun x => Flatness.sensitivity f x ^ 2) = (n : ℝ) * (n + 1) / 4 ∧
    (n : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (2 * (n + 1)) ≤ mean (fun x => Real.sqrt (Flatness.sensitivity f x))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Flatness.dimension_even hf hb, Flatness.mean_sq hb,
    Flatness.noise_second_moment hb ρ hρ, ?_, Flatness.sensitivity_eq_card hf,
    Flatness.sensitivity_mean hb, Flatness.sensitivity_second_moment hf hb,
    Flatness.sensitivity_sqrt_mean_lower hf hb⟩
  intro x
  rw [← flat_amplitude]
  exact Flatness.noise_abs_le hb ρ hρ x

name: Hellinger.FunctionContracts.odd_real_dual
statement:
theorem odd_real_dual (n : ℕ) (h : Cube n → ℝ)
    (ho : ∀ x, h (antipode n x) = -h x) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    root ρ ≤ mean (fun x => Real.sqrt (1 + h x ^ 2)) -
      mean (fun x => |(cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply h x|) ∧
    (0 < ρ → ρ < 1 →
      (mean (fun x => Real.sqrt (1 + h x ^ 2)) -
        mean (fun x => |(cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply h x|) = root ρ ↔
        ∃ i : Fin n, ∃ negative : Bool,
          h = fun x => (ρ / root ρ) * (if negative then -boolSign (x i) else boolSign (x i))))
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨OddDual.odd_dual_bound_all n h ho ρ hρ,
    fun hp hl => OddDual.odd_dual_equality_iff_all n h ho ρ hρ hp hl⟩

name: Hellinger.FunctionContracts.bent_high_noise
statement:
theorem bent_high_noise (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (_hf : IsBoolean f) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hhigh : ρ ≤ 3 / 10) :
    HellingerBound f ρ hρ ∧ (0 < ρ → objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) < 1 - root ρ)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨BentLarge.bent_high_noise_hellinger hn f hb ρ hρ hhigh,
    fun hp => BentLarge.bent_high_noise_hellinger_strict hn f hb ρ hρ hhigh hp⟩

name: Hellinger.FunctionContracts.bent_large_dimension
statement:
theorem bent_large_dimension (n : ℕ) (hn : 6 ≤ n) (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : IsBoolean f) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    HellingerBound f ρ hρ ∧ (0 < ρ → objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) < 1 - root ρ)
proof:
:=
  BentLow.bent_large_hellinger hn hf hb ρ hρ

name: Hellinger.FunctionContracts.four_point_completion
statement:
theorem four_point_completion (n : ℕ) (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : IsBoolean f) (hmean : mean f = 0) (x y : Cube n)
    (hyx : y ≠ x) (hyax : y ≠ antipode n x)
    (hfx : f x = 1) (hfax : f (antipode n x) = 1)
    (hfy : f y = -1) (hfay : f (antipode n y) = -1)
    (hother : ∀ z, z ≠ x → z ≠ antipode n x → z ≠ y → z ≠ antipode n y →
      f (antipode n z) = -f z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (∃ g : Cube n → ℝ,
      (g = FourPoint.plusCompletion f x y ∨ g = FourPoint.minusCompletion f x y) ∧
      IsBoolean g ∧ (∀ z, g (antipode n z) = -g z) ∧
      (∀ z, z ≠ x → z ≠ antipode n x → z ≠ y → z ≠ antipode n y → g z = f z) ∧
      objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) ≤ objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply g)) ∧
    HellingerBound f ρ hρ ∧
    bscMutualInformation f ρ hρ ≤ 1 - binaryEntropyBits ((1 - ρ) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨FourPoint.four_point_completion n f hf hmean x y hyx hyax hfx hfax hfy hfay hother ρ hρ,
    ProbabilityContracts.four_point_information n f hf hmean x y hyx hyax hfx hfax hfy hfay hother ρ hρ⟩

name: Hellinger.BentFourFinal.bent_fourth_moment_identity
statement:
theorem bent_fourth_moment_identity (f : Cube 4 → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC 4 ρ hρ).apply f x) ^ 4) =
      (∑ s : Cube 4, noiseDerivativeSum (mixedTerms (dual f)) ρ s ^ 2) / 256
proof:
:= by
  have hg := dual_boolean f hb
  have hgb := dual_bent f hf
  have hrep := bent_quadratic_representation (dual f) hg hgb
  obtain ⟨hc, hl, he⟩ := coefficient_squares (dual f) hg
  rw [FourierProducts.noise_fourth_moment]
  have hterm (s a : Cube 4) :
      (ρ ^ degree a * walsh f a) * (ρ ^ degree (translate s a) * walsh f (translate s a)) =
        (1 / 16 : ℝ) * (ρ ^ (degree a + degree (translate s a)) *
          (dual f a * dual f (translate s a))) := by
    simp only [dual, pow_add]
    ring
  simp_rw [hterm, ← Finset.mul_sum, mul_pow]
  have hsum : (∑ s : Cube 4, (1 / 16 : ℝ) ^ 2 *
      (∑ a, ρ ^ (degree a + degree (translate s a)) * (dual f a * dual f (translate s a))) ^ 2) =
      (1 / 256 : ℝ) * ∑ s : Cube 4,
        (∑ a, ρ ^ (degree a + degree (translate s a)) * (dual f a * dual f (translate s a))) ^ 2 := by
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    norm_num
  rw [hsum]
  conv_lhs => rw [hrep]
  simp_rw [quadratic_weighted_derivative _ _ _ hc hl he]
  ring

name: Hellinger.BentFourFinal.bent_fourth_moment_upper
statement:
theorem bent_fourth_moment_upper (f : Cube 4 → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC 4 ρ hρ).apply f x) ^ 4) ≤
      BentEstimates.bentH (ρ ^ 2) ^ 2 / 256
proof:
:= by
  rw [bent_fourth_moment_identity f hf hb]
  have hg := dual_boolean f hb
  have hgb := dual_bent f hf
  have hrep := bent_quadratic_representation (dual f) hg hgb
  obtain ⟨hc, hl, he⟩ := coefficient_squares (dual f) hg
  have hnd := quadratic_bent_nondegenerate (constantTerm (dual f))
    (linearTerms (dual f)) (mixedTerms (dual f)) hc hl he (by rw [← hrep]; exact hgb)
  exact BentFourGraphs.derivative_moment_upper _ he hnd ρ

name: Hellinger.BentFourFinal.bent_four_middle_strict
statement:
theorem bent_four_middle_strict (f : Cube 4 → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (ht₀ : 1 / 16 ≤ ρ ^ 2) (ht₁ : ρ ^ 2 ≤ 7 / 10) :
    objective ((cubeBSC 4 ρ hρ).apply f) < 1 - root ρ
proof:
:= by
  let u := (cubeBSC 4 ρ hρ).apply f
  have hu (x : Cube 4) : u x ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    have h := UniformChannel.apply_mem_Icc (cubeBSC 4 ρ hρ) f
      (fun y => by rcases hf y with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> constructor <;> norm_num) x
    change u x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 at h
    nlinarith [h.1, h.2]
  have hmean : (∑ x : Cube 4, (1 / 16 : ℝ) * u x) ^ 2 = 1 / 16 := by
    have h := Flatness.noisy_mean_sq hb ρ hρ
    norm_num at h
    simpa [mean, cube_card, Finset.mul_sum] using h
  have hQ₂ : (∑ x : Cube 4, (1 / 16 : ℝ) * u x ^ 2) = (1 + ρ ^ 2) ^ 4 / 16 := by
    have h := Flatness.noise_second_moment hb ρ hρ
    norm_num at h
    simpa [mean, cube_card, Finset.mul_sum, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using h
  have hQ₄ : (∑ x : Cube 4, (1 / 16 : ℝ) * u x ^ 4) ≤ BentEstimates.bentH (ρ ^ 2) ^ 2 / 256 := by
    have h := bent_fourth_moment_upper f hf hb ρ hρ
    simpa [mean, cube_card, Finset.mul_sum] using h
  have h := BentEstimates.four_dimensional_weighted_hellinger_gap
    (fun _ : Cube 4 => (1 / 16 : ℝ)) u (by intro; norm_num)
    (by simp) hu (ρ ^ 2) ht₀ ht₁ hmean hQ₂ hQ₄
  change root (mean u) - mean (fun x => root (u x)) < 1 - root ρ
  simp only [root, mean, cube_card, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] at *
  norm_num only [one_div, inv_pow] at *
  simp only [← Finset.mul_sum] at h
  nlinarith only [h]

name: Hellinger.BentFourFinal.bent_four_low_strict
statement:
theorem bent_four_low_strict (f : Cube 4 → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hlo : 5 / 6 ≤ ρ) :
    objective ((cubeBSC 4 ρ hρ).apply f) < 1 - root ρ
proof:
:= by
  let S := mean (fun x => Real.sqrt (Flatness.sensitivity f x))
  have hs : (3 + 3 * Real.sqrt 2 + 2 * Real.sqrt 3) / 8 ≤ S := by
    exact le_of_eq (bent_four_sensitivity_mean f hf hb).symm
  have hfac := BentEstimates.four_low_noise_ratio_gt_one ((1 - ρ) / 2) S
    (((1 + ρ) / 2) ^ 3 * S) (by linarith only [hlo]) hs (by ring_nf; rfl)
  have hprod := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hfac) (Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 - ρ ^ 2))
  have hevent := BentLow.posterior_root_mean_lower (show 1 ≤ 4 by omega) hf ρ hρ
  have hR : root ρ ≤ mean (fun x => root ((cubeBSC 4 ρ hρ).apply f x)) := by
    change root ρ * 1 ≤ root ρ * (((1 + ρ) / 2) ^ 3 * S) at hprod
    change root ρ * ((1 + ρ) / 2) ^ 3 * S ≤ _ at hevent
    nlinarith only [hprod, hevent]
  have hroot : root (mean ((cubeBSC 4 ρ hρ).apply f)) < 1 := by
    apply (Real.sqrt_lt' (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)).mpr
    have h := Flatness.noisy_mean_sq hb ρ hρ
    norm_num at h
    linarith only [h]
  unfold objective
  linarith only [hR, hroot]

name: Hellinger.BentFourFinal.bent_four_hellinger
statement:
theorem bent_four_hellinger (f : Cube 4 → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    objective ((cubeBSC 4 ρ hρ).apply f) ≤ 1 - root ρ ∧
      (0 < ρ → objective ((cubeBSC 4 ρ hρ).apply f) < 1 - root ρ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hhi : ρ ≤ 3 / 10
  · exact ⟨BentLarge.bent_high_noise_hellinger (by omega) f hb ρ hρ hhi,
      fun hp => BentLarge.bent_high_noise_hellinger_strict (by omega) f hb ρ hρ hhi hp⟩
  · have hm : objective ((cubeBSC 4 ρ hρ).apply f) < 1 - root ρ := by
      by_cases hlo : 5 / 6 ≤ ρ
      · exact bent_four_low_strict f hf hb ρ hρ hlo
      · apply bent_four_middle_strict f hf hb ρ hρ
        · nlinarith [hρ.1]
        · nlinarith [hρ.1]
    exact ⟨le_of_lt hm, fun _ => hm⟩

name: Hellinger.MatrixLifting.outer_mul
statement:
theorem outer_mul (u v w z : ι → ℝ) :
    Matrix.vecMulVec u v * Matrix.vecMulVec w z = (v ⬝ᵥ w) • Matrix.vecMulVec u z
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec, Matrix.vecMulVec_smul]

name: Hellinger.MatrixLifting.pureDifference_isHermitian
statement: theorem pureDifference_isHermitian (v w : ι → ℝ) : (pureDifference v w).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  have hv : (Matrix.vecMulVec v v).PosSemidef := by
    simpa using Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star v
  have hw : (Matrix.vecMulVec w w).PosSemidef := by
    simpa using Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star w
  exact hv.isHermitian.sub hw.isHermitian

name: Hellinger.MatrixLifting.pureDifference_square
statement:
theorem pureDifference_square (v w : ι → ℝ) (hv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1) (hw : w ⬝ᵥ w = 1) :
    pureDifference v w * pureDifference v w =
      Matrix.vecMulVec v v + Matrix.vecMulVec w w -
        (v ⬝ᵥ w) • Matrix.vecMulVec v w - (v ⬝ᵥ w) • Matrix.vecMulVec w v
proof:
:= by
  unfold pureDifference
  rw [sub_mul, mul_sub, mul_sub]
  simp only [outer_mul, hv, hw, one_smul, dotProduct_comm w v]
  abel

name: Hellinger.MatrixLifting.pureDifference_cube
statement:
theorem pureDifference_cube (v w : ι → ℝ) (hv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1) (hw : w ⬝ᵥ w = 1) :
    pureDifference v w * pureDifference v w * pureDifference v w =
      (1 - (v ⬝ᵥ w) ^ 2) • pureDifference v w
proof:
:= by
  rw [pureDifference_square v w hv hw]
  unfold pureDifference
  simp only [sub_mul, add_mul, mul_sub, smul_mul_assoc, outer_mul,
    hv, hw, dotProduct_comm w v, one_smul, smul_smul]
  module

name: Hellinger.MatrixLifting.pureDifference_square_trace
statement:
theorem pureDifference_square_trace (v w : ι → ℝ)
    (hv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1) (hw : w ⬝ᵥ w = 1) :
    (pureDifference v w * pureDifference v w).trace = 2 * (1 - (v ⬝ᵥ w) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pureDifference_square v w hv hw]
  simp only [trace_sub, trace_add, trace_smul, trace_vecMulVec, hv, hw,
    dotProduct_comm w v, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: Hellinger.MatrixLifting.pureDifference_square_posSemidef
statement:
theorem pureDifference_square_posSemidef (v w : ι → ℝ) :
    (pureDifference v w * pureDifference v w).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  have h := Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self (pureDifference v w)
  rwa [(pureDifference_isHermitian v w).eq] at h

name: Hellinger.MatrixLifting.one_sub_inner_sq_nonneg
statement:
theorem one_sub_inner_sq_nonneg (v w : ι → ℝ)
    (hv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1) (hw : w ⬝ᵥ w = 1) : 0 ≤ 1 - (v ⬝ᵥ w) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := (pureDifference_square_posSemidef v w).trace_nonneg
  rw [pureDifference_square_trace v w hv hw] at h
  linarith

name: Hellinger.MatrixLifting.traceNorm_pureDifference
statement:
theorem traceNorm_pureDifference (v w : ι → ℝ)
    (hv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1) (hw : w ⬝ᵥ w = 1) :
    traceNorm (pureDifference v w) = 2 * Real.sqrt (1 - (v ⬝ᵥ w) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let H := pureDifference v w
  let t := 1 - (v ⬝ᵥ w) ^ 2
  have ht : 0 ≤ t := one_sub_inner_sq_nonneg v w hv hw
  have hH : H.IsHermitian := pureDifference_isHermitian v w
  have hH₂ : (H * H).PosSemidef := pureDifference_square_posSemidef v w
  have htr : (H * H).trace = 2 * t := pureDifference_square_trace v w hv hw
  change traceNorm H = 2 * Real.sqrt t
  by_cases htzero : t = 0
  · have hsqzero : H * H = 0 := hH₂.trace_eq_zero_iff.mp (by rw [htr, htzero, mul_zero])
    have hzero : H = 0 := Matrix.conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_zero.mp (hH.eq.symm ▸ hsqzero)
    simp [hzero, htzero]
  · have htpos : 0 < t := lt_of_le_of_ne ht (Ne.symm htzero)
    have hspos : 0 < Real.sqrt t := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr htpos
    have hsne : Real.sqrt t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hspos
    have hssq : Real.sqrt t ^ 2 = t := Real.sq_sqrt ht
    have hfour : (H * H) * (H * H) = t • (H * H) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, pureDifference_cube v w hv hw, smul_mul_assoc]
    have hcoefficient : (Real.sqrt t)⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt t)⁻¹ * t = 1 := by
      field_simp
      nlinarith
    have habs : CFC.abs H = (Real.sqrt t)⁻¹ • (H * H) := by
      change CFC.sqrt (star H * H) = _
      apply CFC.sqrt_unique
      · rw [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, hfour, smul_smul,
          hcoefficient, one_smul]
        exact congrArg (fun X => X * H) hH.eq.symm
      · exact (hH₂.smul (inv_nonneg.mpr hspos.le)).nonneg
    rw [traceNorm, habs, trace_smul, htr, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
    nlinarith

name: Hellinger.MatrixLifting.traceNorm_weighted_pureDifference_le
statement:
theorem traceNorm_weighted_pureDifference_le {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (p : α → ℝ) (v w : α → ι → ℝ) (hp : ∀ y, 0 ≤ p y)
    (hv : ∀ y, v y ⬝ᵥ v y = 1) (hw : ∀ y, w y ⬝ᵥ w y = 1) :
    traceNorm (∑ y, p y • pureDifference (v y) (w y)) ≤
      ∑ y, p y * (2 * Real.sqrt (1 - (v y ⬝ᵥ w y) ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ y, traceNorm (p y • pureDifference (v y) (w y)) :=
      traceNorm_sum_le Finset.univ _ (fun y _ =>
        (pureDifference_isHermitian (v y) (w y)).smul (.of_nonneg (hp y)))
    _ = _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y _
      rw [traceNorm_smul, abs_of_nonneg (hp y), traceNorm_pureDifference _ _ (hv y) (hw y)]

name: Hellinger.BentLowExact.alpha_bounds
statement:
theorem alpha_bounds (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (hmax : α ≤ 1 / (n : ℝ)) : α ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ (n : ℝ) * α ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hnR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hp : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hm := (le_div_iff₀ hp).mp hmax
  have hs := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnR hα
  constructor <;> nlinarith

name: Hellinger.BentLowExact.coefficient_le
statement:
theorem coefficient_le (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (hmax : α ≤ 1 / (n : ℝ)) :
    (1 - α) ^ (((n : ℝ) - 2) / 2) * Real.sqrt (1 - (n : ℝ) * α) ≤
      (1 - α) ^ (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hhalf, hna⟩ := alpha_bounds n hn α hα hmax
  have hb : 0 ≤ 1 - α := by linarith
  have hq : 0 ≤ 1 - (n : ℝ) * α := by linarith
  have hpow : ((1 - α) ^ (((n : ℝ) - 2) / 2)) ^ 2 = (1 - α) ^ (n - 2) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast _ 2, ← Real.rpow_mul hb]
    have he : (((n : ℝ) - 2) / 2) * (2 : ℝ) = ((n - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hn]
      norm_num
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
    rw [he, Real.rpow_natCast]
  have hbern := one_add_mul_sub_le_pow (show (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - α by linarith) n
  have hpowbound : 1 - (n : ℝ) * α ≤ (1 - α) ^ n := by nlinarith only [hbern]
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpowbound (pow_nonneg hb (n - 2))
  have hexp : n - 2 + n = (n - 1) * 2 := by omega
  rw [← pow_add, hexp, pow_mul] at hmul
  have hsq : ((1 - α) ^ (((n : ℝ) - 2) / 2) * Real.sqrt (1 - (n : ℝ) * α)) ^ 2 ≤
      ((1 - α) ^ (n - 1)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, hpow, Real.sq_sqrt hq]
    exact hmul
  have hright : 0 ≤ (1 - α) ^ (n - 1) := pow_nonneg hb _
  nlinarith only [hsq, hright]

name: Hellinger.BentLowExact.manuscript_low_noise
statement:
theorem manuscript_low_noise {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α)
    (hmax : α ≤ 1 / (n : ℝ))
    (hρ : 1 - 2 * α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean (fun x => root ((cubeBSC n (1 - 2 * α) hρ).apply f x)) /
        (2 * Real.sqrt (α * (1 - α))) ≥
      (1 - α) ^ (((n : ℝ) - 2) / 2) * Real.sqrt (1 - (n : ℝ) * α) *
        mean (fun x => Real.sqrt (Flatness.sensitivity f x))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hhalf, _⟩ := alpha_bounds n hn α hα.le hmax
  have hb : 0 < 1 - α := by linarith
  have hden : 0 < 2 * Real.sqrt (α * (1 - α)) := by positivity
  have hroot : root (1 - 2 * α) = 2 * Real.sqrt (α * (1 - α)) := by
    have hs : Real.sqrt (α * (1 - α)) ^ 2 = α * (1 - α) := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
    have hr : root (1 - 2 * α) ^ 2 = 1 - (1 - 2 * α) ^ 2 :=
      Real.sq_sqrt (by nlinarith [hρ.1, hρ.2])
    have hnroot : 0 ≤ root (1 - 2 * α) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    nlinarith only [hs, hr, hnroot, le_of_lt hden]
  have hevent := BentLow.posterior_root_mean_lower (show 1 ≤ n by omega) hf (1 - 2 * α) hρ
  rw [hroot] at hevent
  have hbase : (1 + (1 - 2 * α)) / 2 = 1 - α := by ring
  rw [hbase] at hevent
  have hm : 0 ≤ mean (fun x => Real.sqrt (Flatness.sensitivity f x)) := by
    unfold mean
    positivity
  have hc := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (coefficient_le n hn α hα.le hmax) hm
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hden).mpr
  nlinarith only [hc, hevent, hden]

name: Hellinger.BentLowExact.manuscript_low_noise_full
statement:
theorem manuscript_low_noise_full {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α)
    (hmax : α ≤ 1 / (n : ℝ)) :
    let hρ : 1 - 2 * α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      obtain ⟨hhalf, _⟩
proof:
:= alpha_bounds n hn α hα.le hmax
      constructor <;> linarith
    mean (fun x => root ((cubeBSC n (1 - 2 * α) hρ).apply f x)) /
        (2 * Real.sqrt (α * (1 - α))) ≥
      (1 - α) ^ (((n : ℝ) - 2) / 2) * Real.sqrt (1 - (n : ℝ) * α) *
        mean (fun x => Real.sqrt (Flatness.sensitivity f x)) := by
  dsimp only
  exact manuscript_low_noise hn f hf α hα hmax _

name: Hellinger.F2Model.objective_comp_equiv
statement:
theorem objective_comp_equiv {Ω Λ : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Λ]
    (e : Ω ≃ Λ) (f : Λ → ℝ) : objective (f ∘ e) = objective f
proof:
:= by
  have hm := mean_comp_equiv e f
  have hr := mean_comp_equiv e (fun x => root (f x))
  unfold objective
  rw [hm]
  exact congrArg (root (mean f) - ·) hr

name: Hellinger.F2Model.noise_objective_bits
statement:
theorem noise_objective_bits {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (f : (ι → F2) → ℝ) :
    objective ((noise ι ρ hρ).apply f) =
      objective ((indexedBSC ι ρ hρ).apply (f ∘ bitsEquiv ι))
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : ((noise ι ρ hρ).apply f) ∘ bitsEquiv ι =
      (indexedBSC ι ρ hρ).apply (f ∘ bitsEquiv ι) := by
    funext x
    exact noise_apply_bits ρ hρ f x
  rw [← hfun, objective_comp_equiv]

name: Hellinger.F2Model.bitEquiv_xor
statement:
@[simp] theorem bitEquiv_xor (x y : Bool) :
    bitEquiv (Bool.xor x y) = bitEquiv x + bitEquiv y
proof:
:= by
  cases x <;> cases y <;> simp [show (1 : F2) + 1 = 0 from rfl]

name: Hellinger.F2Model.bitsEquiv_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem bitsEquiv_zero (n : ℕ) : bitsEquiv (Fin n) (fun _ => false) = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  rfl

name: Hellinger.F2Model.bitsEquiv_translate
statement:
theorem bitsEquiv_translate (n : ℕ) (x v : Fourier.Cube n) :
    bitsEquiv (Fin n) (Fourier.translate x v) = bitsEquiv (Fin n) x + bitsEquiv (Fin n) v
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simpa only [Fourier.translate, bitsEquiv_apply, Pi.add_apply, Bool.xor_comm] using
    bitEquiv_xor (x i) (v i)

name: Hellinger.F2Model.autocorrelation_bits
statement:
theorem autocorrelation_bits (n : ℕ) (f : Cube n → ℝ) (v : Fourier.Cube n) :
    Fourier.autocorrelation (f ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) v =
      mean (fun x : Cube n => f x * f (x + bitsEquiv (Fin n) v))
proof:
:= by
  unfold Fourier.autocorrelation
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, bitsEquiv_translate]
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, add_comm] using mean_comp_equiv (bitsEquiv (Fin n))
    (fun x => f x * f (x + bitsEquiv (Fin n) v))

name: Hellinger.F2Model.walsh_autocorrelation
statement:
theorem walsh_autocorrelation {n : ℕ} (f : Fourier.Cube n → ℝ) (t : Fourier.Cube n) :
    Fourier.walsh (Fourier.autocorrelation f) t = Fourier.walsh f t ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold Fourier.walsh
  simp_rw [Fourier.autocorrelation_formula]
  have hswap :
      (fun x => (∑ s, Fourier.walsh f s ^ 2 * Fourier.phase s x) * Fourier.phase t x) =
      (fun x => Fourier.phase t x * (∑ s, Fourier.walsh f s ^ 2 * Fourier.phase s x)) := by
    funext x
    ring
  rw [hswap, Fourier.mean_mul_expansion]
  have ho (s : Fourier.Cube n) : Fourier.walsh (Fourier.phase t) s = if t = s then 1 else 0 :=
    Fourier.orthogonality t s
  simp [ho]
  rfl

name: Hellinger.F2Model.bent_of_autocorrelation
statement:
theorem bent_of_autocorrelation (n : ℕ) (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hc : ∀ v : Cube n, v ≠ 0 → mean (fun x => f x * f (x + v)) = 0) :
    Flatness.IsBent (f ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  have hcorr (v : Fourier.Cube n) :
      Fourier.autocorrelation (f ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) v =
        if v = (fun _ => false) then 1 else 0 := by
    rw [autocorrelation_bits]
    by_cases hv : v = (fun _ => false)
    · rw [if_pos hv, hv, bitsEquiv_zero]
      have hsq (x : Cube n) : f x * f (x + 0) = 1 := by
        rcases hf x with hx | hx <;> simp [hx]
      simp only [hsq, mean_const]
    · rw [if_neg hv]
      apply hc
      intro hz
      exact hv ((bitsEquiv (Fin n)).injective (hz.trans (bitsEquiv_zero n).symm))
  intro s
  rw [← walsh_autocorrelation]
  simp only [Fourier.walsh, hcorr, mean]
  simp [Fourier.phase, boolSign]

name: Hellinger.F2Model.bent_autocorrelation
statement:
theorem bent_autocorrelation (n : ℕ) (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : Flatness.IsBent (f ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n))) (v : Cube n) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    mean (fun x => f x * f (x + v)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := (bitsEquiv (Fin n)).surjective v
  rw [← autocorrelation_bits]
  apply Flatness.autocorrelation_zero hf
  intro hw
  exact hv (hw ▸ bitsEquiv_zero n)

name: Hellinger.F2Model.bent_linearEquiv
statement:
theorem bent_linearEquiv (n : ℕ) (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hb : Flatness.IsBent (f ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n))) (M : Cube n ≃ₗ[F2] Cube n) :
    Flatness.IsBent ((f ∘ M) ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  apply bent_of_autocorrelation n (f ∘ M) (fun x => hf _)
  intro v hv
  have hmv : M v ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hv (M.injective (h.trans M.map_zero.symm))
  have hm := mean_comp_equiv M.toEquiv (fun x => f x * f (x + M v))
  dsimp only [Function.comp_def] at hm
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, map_add]
  exact hm.trans (bent_autocorrelation n f hb (M v) hmv)

name: Hellinger.BentFourClassification.sign_signCode
statement: theorem sign_signCode (r : ℝ) (hr : r ^ 2 = 1) : sign (signCode r) = r
proof:
:= by
  rcases sq_eq_one_iff.mp hr with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num [signCode]

name: Hellinger.BentFourClassification.quadraticPhase_isQuadratic
statement:
theorem quadraticPhase_isQuadratic (c : ℝ) (l : Fin 4 → ℝ) (e : Fin 6 → ℝ)
    (hc : c ^ 2 = 1) (hl : ∀ i, l i ^ 2 = 1) (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1) :
    PaperSpecs.IsQuadratic (quadraticPhase c l e)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨signCode c, (fun i => signCode (l i)), crossCoefficients e, ?_⟩
  intro x
  change quadraticPhase c l e x = sign (PaperSpecs.quadraticValue _ _ _ x)
  have hx : x = (fun i => if i.val = 0 then x 0 else if i.val = 1 then x 1
      else if i.val = 2 then x 2 else x 3) := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> norm_num <;> rfl
  cases hx₀ : x 0 <;> cases hx₁ : x 1 <;> cases hx₂ : x 2 <;> cases hx₃ : x 3 <;>
    rw [hx₀, hx₁, hx₂, hx₃] at hx <;> rw [hx] <;>
    simp only [PaperSpecs.quadraticValue, Finset.sum_filter, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.lt_def] <;>
    norm_num [quadraticPhase, crossCoefficients, PaperSpecs.bit, sign_add,
      sign_signCode c hc, fun i => sign_signCode (l i) (hl i),
      fun i => sign_signCode (e i) (he i)] <;>
    (try simp only [show (Fin.succ (2 : Fin 3)) = (3 : Fin 4) from rfl, eq_self, true_or]) <;> first | (left; first | trivial | ring) | ring

name: Hellinger.BentFourClassification.bent_isQuadratic
statement:
theorem bent_isQuadratic (f : Fourier.Cube 4 → ℝ) (hf : PaperSpecs.IsBoolean f)
    (hb : Flatness.IsBent f) : PaperSpecs.IsQuadratic f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hc, hl, he⟩ := BentFourStructure.coefficient_squares f hf
  rw [bent_quadratic_representation f hf hb]
  exact quadraticPhase_isQuadratic _ _ _ hc hl he

name: Hellinger.IndependentChannels.measurable_bias
statement:
theorem measurable_bias {E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace E] (κ : Kernel E Bool) :
    Measurable (bias κ)
proof:
:=
  ((κ.measurable_coe (measurableSet_singleton false)).ennreal_toReal).sub
    ((κ.measurable_coe (measurableSet_singleton true)).ennreal_toReal)

name: Hellinger.IndependentChannels.bool_masses
statement:
theorem bool_masses (ν : Measure Bool) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] :
    ν.real {false} + ν.real {true} = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := measureReal_add_measureReal_compl (μ := ν) (measurableSet_singleton false)
  have hc : ({false} : Set Bool)ᶜ = {true} := by ext b; cases b <;> simp
  simpa only [hc, measureReal_def, measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one] using h

name: Hellinger.IndependentChannels.bias_mem
statement:
theorem bias_mem {E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace E] (κ : Kernel E Bool) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (y : E) :
    bias κ y ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := bool_masses (κ y)
  have hp := measureReal_nonneg (μ := κ y) (s := {false})
  have hn := measureReal_nonneg (μ := κ y) (s := {true})
  dsimp [bias]
  constructor <;> linarith

name: Hellinger.IndependentChannels.bias_mass
statement:
theorem bias_mass {E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace E] (κ : Kernel E Bool) [IsMarkovKernel κ]
    (y : E) (b : Bool) : (κ y).real {b} = bitProbability (bias κ y) b
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := bool_masses (κ y)
  cases b <;> norm_num [bitProbability, bias, boolSign] <;> linarith

name: Hellinger.IndependentChannels.boolSign_integrable
statement: theorem boolSign_integrable (ν : Measure Bool) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] : Integrable boolSign ν
proof:
:= by
  apply integrable_of_abs_le ν boolSign (measurable_of_finite boolSign) 1
  intro b
  cases b <;> norm_num [boolSign]

name: Hellinger.IndependentChannels.bias_integral
statement:
theorem bias_integral {E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace E] (κ : Kernel E Bool) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (y : E) :
    bias κ y = ∫ b, boolSign b ∂κ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_fintype (boolSign_integrable (κ y))]
  simp [bias, boolSign]
  ring

name: Hellinger.IndependentChannels.uniform_mean
statement: theorem uniform_mean : ∫ b, boolSign b ∂(PMF.uniformOfFintype Bool).toMeasure = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_fintype (boolSign_integrable _)]
  norm_num [boolSign, Measure.real, PMF.toMeasure_apply_singleton, PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply]

name: Hellinger.IndependentChannels.productKernel_integral
statement:
theorem productKernel_integral {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {E : ι → Type*} [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (E i)]
    (κ : (i : ι) → Kernel (E i) Bool) [∀ i, IsMarkovKernel (κ i)]
    (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (y : (i : ι) → E i) :
    (∫ b, f b ∂productKernel κ y) = PosteriorSections.value (fun i => bias (κ i)) f y
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_fintype Integrable.of_finite]
  unfold PosteriorSections.value PosteriorSections.probability
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b _
  change (productKernel κ y {b}).toReal * f b = _
  rw [productKernel_singleton, ENNReal.toReal_prod]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact bias_mass (κ i) (y i) (b i)

name: Hellinger.IndependentChannels.coordinate_condExp
statement:
theorem coordinate_condExp (hB : ∀ i, Measurable (B i)) (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i)) (i : ι) :
    μ[fun ω => boolSign (B i ω) | MeasurableSpace.comap (Y i) inferInstance] =ᵐ[μ]
      fun ω => coordinateBias μ B Y i (Y i ω)
proof:
:= by
  have hint : Integrable (fun ω => boolSign (B i ω)) μ := by
    apply integrable_of_abs_le μ _ ((measurable_of_finite boolSign).comp (hB i)) 1
    intro ω
    cases hb : B i ω <;> norm_num [boolSign, hb]
  have h := condExp_ae_eq_integral_condDistrib (hY i) (hB i).aemeasurable
    (measurable_of_finite boolSign).stronglyMeasurable hint
  simpa only [coordinateBias, bias_integral] using h

name: Hellinger.IndependentChannels.coordinate_mean_zero
statement:
theorem coordinate_mean_zero (hB : ∀ i, Measurable (B i)) (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i))
    (hfair : ∀ i, μ.map (B i) = (PMF.uniformOfFintype Bool).toMeasure) (i : ι) :
    ∫ y, coordinateBias μ B Y i y ∂outputLaw μ Y i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable (coordinateBias μ B Y i) := measurable_bias _
  rw [outputLaw, integral_map (hY i).aemeasurable hm.aestronglyMeasurable]
  calc
    _ = ∫ ω, μ[fun ω => boolSign (B i ω) | MeasurableSpace.comap (Y i) inferInstance] ω ∂μ :=
      integral_congr_ae (coordinate_condExp μ B Y hB hY i).symm
    _ = ∫ ω, boolSign (B i ω) ∂μ := integral_condExp (hY i).comap_le
    _ = ∫ b, boolSign b ∂μ.map (B i) :=
      (integral_map (hB i).aemeasurable (measurable_of_finite boolSign).aestronglyMeasurable).symm
    _ = 0 := by rw [hfair i]; exact uniform_mean

name: Hellinger.IndependentChannels.channelParameter_eq
statement:
theorem channelParameter_eq (hB : ∀ i, Measurable (B i)) (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i)) (i : ι) :
    channelParameter μ B Y i =
      PosteriorSections.parameter (outputLaw μ Y) (coordinateBias μ B Y) i
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable (fun y => root (coordinateBias μ B Y i y)) := by
    have hb := measurable_bias (condDistrib (B i) (Y i) μ)
    unfold coordinateBias root
    fun_prop
  rw [PosteriorSections.parameter, outputLaw, integral_map (hY i).aemeasurable hm.aestronglyMeasurable]
  exact integral_congr_ae ((coordinate_condExp μ B Y hB hY i).fun_comp root)

name: Hellinger.IndependentChannels.posterior_value
statement:
theorem posterior_value (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, Measurable (B i)) (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i))
    (hpairs : iIndepFun (fun i ω => (Y i ω, B i ω)) μ) :
    posterior μ B Y f =ᵐ[μ]
      fun ω => PosteriorSections.value (coordinateBias μ B Y) f (fun i => Y i ω)
proof:
:= by
  have h := conditional_expectation_productKernel μ B Y f hB hY hpairs
  simp_rw [productKernel_integral] at h
  exact h

name: Hellinger.IndependentChannels.posterior_root_integral
statement:
theorem posterior_root_integral (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, Measurable (B i)) (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i))
    (hpairs : iIndepFun (fun i ω => (Y i ω, B i ω)) μ) :
    (∫ ω, root (posterior μ B Y f ω) ∂μ) =
      ∫ y, root (PosteriorSections.value (coordinateBias μ B Y) f y)
        ∂Measure.pi (outputLaw μ Y)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable (fun y => root (PosteriorSections.value (coordinateBias μ B Y) f y)) := by
    have hv := PosteriorSections.measurable_value (coordinateBias μ B Y)
      (fun i => measurable_bias (condDistrib (B i) (Y i) μ)) f
    unfold root
    fun_prop
  calc
    _ = ∫ ω, root (PosteriorSections.value (coordinateBias μ B Y) f (fun i => Y i ω)) ∂μ :=
      integral_congr_ae ((posterior_value μ B Y f hB hY hpairs).fun_comp root)
    _ = ∫ y, root (PosteriorSections.value (coordinateBias μ B Y) f y)
        ∂μ.map (fun ω i => Y i ω) :=
      (integral_map (by fun_prop : Measurable (fun ω i => Y i ω)).aemeasurable
        hm.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [independent_output_law μ B Y hY hpairs]; rfl

name: Hellinger.IndependentChannels.independent_channel_bound
statement:
theorem independent_channel_bound (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] [Nonempty {i // p i}]
    (hB : ∀ i, Measurable (B i)) (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i))
    (hpairs : iIndepFun (fun i ω => (Y i ω, B i ω)) μ)
    (hfair : ∀ i, μ.map (B i) = (PMF.uniformOfFintype Bool).toMeasure)
    (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (hf : ∀ b, f b = -1 ∨ f b = 1)
    (hflip : ∀ b, f (fun i => if p i then !(b i) else b i) = -f b)
    (i : {i // p i}) (hmin : ∀ j : {j // p j}, channelParameter μ B Y i ≤ channelParameter μ B Y j) :
    channelParameter μ B Y i ≤ ∫ ω, root (posterior μ B Y f ω) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  let : ∀ j, IsProbabilityMeasure (outputLaw μ Y j) :=
    fun j => Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (hY j).aemeasurable
  rw [channelParameter_eq μ B Y hB hY i, posterior_root_integral μ B Y f hB hY hpairs]
  apply PosteriorSections.subset_bound p (outputLaw μ Y) (coordinateBias μ B Y)
    (fun j => measurable_bias _) (fun j => bias_mem _)
    (coordinate_mean_zero μ B Y hB hY hfair) f hf hflip
  · exact PosteriorSections.parameter_mem (outputLaw μ Y) (coordinateBias μ B Y)
      (fun j => measurable_bias (condDistrib (B j) (Y j) μ)) i
  · intro j hj
    simpa only [channelParameter_eq μ B Y hB hY] using hmin ⟨j, hj⟩

name: Hellinger.IndependentChannels.coordinate_attains
statement:
theorem coordinate_attains (hB : ∀ i, Measurable (B i)) (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i))
    (hpairs : iIndepFun (fun i ω => (Y i ω, B i ω)) μ) (i : ι) :
    (∫ ω, root (posterior μ B Y (fun b => boolSign (b i)) ω) ∂μ) = channelParameter μ B Y i
proof:
:= by
  let : ∀ j, IsProbabilityMeasure (outputLaw μ Y j) :=
    fun j => Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (hY j).aemeasurable
  rw [posterior_root_integral μ B Y _ hB hY hpairs, channelParameter_eq μ B Y hB hY]
  exact PosteriorSections.coordinate_attains _ _ (fun j => measurable_bias _) i

name: Hellinger.IndependentChannels.independent_channels
statement:
theorem independent_channels (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] [Nonempty {i // p i}]
    (hB : ∀ i, Measurable (B i)) (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i))
    (hpairs : iIndepFun (fun i ω => (Y i ω, B i ω)) μ)
    (hfair : ∀ i, μ.map (B i) = (PMF.uniformOfFintype Bool).toMeasure) :
    ∃ i : {i // p i}, (∀ j : {j // p j}, channelParameter μ B Y i ≤ channelParameter μ B Y j) ∧
      (∀ f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ, (∀ b, f b = -1 ∨ f b = 1) →
        (∀ b, f (fun j => if p j then !(b j) else b j) = -f b) →
        channelParameter μ B Y i ≤ ∫ ω, root (posterior μ B Y f ω) ∂μ) ∧
      (∀ b : ι → Bool, boolSign ((fun j => if p j then !(b j) else b j) i) = -boolSign (b i)) ∧
      (∫ ω, root (posterior μ B Y (fun b => boolSign (b i)) ω) ∂μ) = channelParameter μ B Y i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, _, hmin⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image (Finset.univ : Finset {i // p i})
    (fun i => channelParameter μ B Y i) Finset.univ_nonempty
