name: Hellinger.BentFourGraphs.derivative_moment_upper
statement:
theorem derivative_moment_upper (e : Fin 6 → ℝ)
    (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1) (hnd : EdgeNondegenerate e) (ρ : ℝ) :
    (∑ s : Cube 4, noiseDerivativeSum e ρ s ^ 2) / 256 ≤
      BentEstimates.bentH (ρ ^ 2) ^ 2 / 256
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, heq⟩ := derivative_moment_classification e he hnd ρ
  rw [heq]
  have h := BentEstimates.fourthMomentExpression_le d (ρ ^ 2) hd
  nlinarith only [h]

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.dot_self_nonneg
statement: theorem dot_self_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) : 0 ≤ v ⬝ᵥ v
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [star_trivial] using dotProduct_star_self_nonneg v

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.vectorNorm_nonneg
statement: theorem vectorNorm_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) : 0 ≤ vectorNorm v
proof: := Real.sqrt_nonneg _

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.vectorNorm_sq
statement: theorem vectorNorm_sq (v : ι → ℝ) : vectorNorm v ^ 2 = v ⬝ᵥ v
proof:
:=
  Real.sq_sqrt (dot_self_nonneg v)

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.vectorNorm_pos
statement: theorem vectorNorm_pos {v : ι → ℝ} (hv : 0 < v ⬝ᵥ v) : 0 < vectorNorm v
proof:
:=
  Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hv

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.vectorNorm_eq_norm
statement: theorem vectorNorm_eq_norm (v : ι → ℝ) : vectorNorm v = ‖toLp 2 v‖
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [vectorNorm, EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp, star_trivial] using
    (norm_eq_sqrt_real_inner (toLp 2 v)).symm

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.dot_le_vectorNorm_mul
statement: theorem dot_le_vectorNorm_mul (u v : ι → ℝ) : u ⬝ᵥ v ≤ vectorNorm u * vectorNorm v
proof:
:= by
  rw [vectorNorm_eq_norm, vectorNorm_eq_norm]
  simpa only [EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp, star_trivial, dotProduct_comm] using
    real_inner_le_norm (toLp 2 u) (toLp 2 v)

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.normalizedVector_self
statement:
theorem normalizedVector_self {v : ι → ℝ} (hv : 0 < v ⬝ᵥ v) :
    normalizedVector v ⬝ᵥ normalizedVector v = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hs := vectorNorm_sq v
  have hn := ne_of_gt (vectorNorm_pos hv)
  simp only [normalizedVector, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  field_simp
  nlinarith

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.normalizedVector_dot
statement:
theorem normalizedVector_dot (u v : ι → ℝ) :
    normalizedVector u ⬝ᵥ normalizedVector v =
      (u ⬝ᵥ v) / (vectorNorm u * vectorNorm v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [normalizedVector, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul,
    div_eq_mul_inv, _root_.mul_inv_rev]
  ring

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.dot_mulVec_comm
statement:
theorem dot_mulVec_comm {Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hQ : Q.IsHermitian) (u v : ι → ℝ) :
    u ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ v = v ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ u
proof:
:= by
  have hQt : Q.transpose = Q := by
    simpa only [conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hQ.eq
  simpa only [hQt] using Matrix.dotProduct_transpose_mulVec Q u v

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.orderContraction_isHermitian
statement:
theorem orderContraction_isHermitian {Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hQ : OrderContraction Q) :
    Q.IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  have h := Matrix.isHermitian_one.sub hQ.1.isHermitian
  simpa only [sub_sub_cancel] using h

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.signWitness_isHermitian
statement:
theorem signWitness_isHermitian {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (signWitness hA).IsHermitian
proof:
:=
  isHermitian_conjugate (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal _) hA.eigenvectorUnitary

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.orderContraction_eigenvalue_abs_le
proof:
:= by
  let hH := orderContraction_isHermitian hQ
  have h := hQ.conjugate (star hH.eigenvectorUnitary)
  rw [hH.conjStarAlgAut_star_eigenvectorUnitary] at h
  simpa only [diagonal_apply_eq, Function.comp_apply, RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id_eq] using
    h.diagonal_abs_le i

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.orderContraction_square_posSemidef
statement:
theorem orderContraction_square_posSemidef {Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hQ : OrderContraction Q) : (1 - Q * Q).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  let hH := orderContraction_isHermitian hQ
  let D := Matrix.diagonal hH.eigenvalues
  have hspec : Q = conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ hH.eigenvectorUnitary D := by
    simpa only [RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, Function.id_comp] using hH.spectral_theorem
  have hdiag : (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => 1 - hH.eigenvalues i ^ 2)).PosSemidef := by
    apply Matrix.PosSemidef.diagonal
    intro i
    exact sub_nonneg.mpr ((sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one _).mpr (orderContraction_eigenvalue_abs_le hQ i))
  have hD : 1 - D * D = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => 1 - hH.eigenvalues i ^ 2) := by
    rw [show (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) = Matrix.diagonal (fun _ => 1) from diagonal_one.symm]
    simp only [D, diagonal_mul_diagonal, diagonal_sub, pow_two]
  have hid : 1 - Q * Q = conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ hH.eigenvectorUnitary (1 - D * D) := by
    rw [map_sub, map_one, map_mul, ← hspec]
  rw [hid, hD]
  exact posSemidef_conjugate _ hdiag

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.orderContraction_dot_sq_le
statement:
theorem orderContraction_dot_sq_le {Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hQ : OrderContraction Q)
    (v : ι → ℝ) : (Q *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (Q *ᵥ v) ≤ v ⬝ᵥ v
proof:
:= by
  have h := (orderContraction_square_posSemidef hQ).dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg v
  simp only [star_trivial, Matrix.sub_mulVec, one_mulVec, dotProduct_sub,
    ← mulVec_mulVec] at h
  rw [dot_mulVec_comm (orderContraction_isHermitian hQ)] at h
  exact sub_nonneg.mp h

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.orderContraction_vectorNorm_le
statement:
theorem orderContraction_vectorNorm_le {Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hQ : OrderContraction Q)
    (v : ι → ℝ) : vectorNorm (Q *ᵥ v) ≤ vectorNorm v
proof:
:=
  Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (orderContraction_dot_sq_le hQ v)

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.orderContraction_operatorNorm_le
statement:
theorem orderContraction_operatorNorm_le {Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hQ : OrderContraction Q) :
    ‖Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := ι) Q‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one
  intro x
  change ‖toLp 2 (Q *ᵥ ofLp x)‖ ≤ 1 * ‖x‖
  simpa only [one_mul, vectorNorm_eq_norm, toLp_ofLp] using
    orderContraction_vectorNorm_le hQ (ofLp x)

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.operatorNorm_quadratic_abs_le
proof:
:= by
  have hn : vectorNorm (Q *ᵥ v) ≤ vectorNorm v := by
    simpa only [vectorNorm_eq_norm, Matrix.toEuclideanCLM_toLp, one_mul] using
      (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := ι) Q).le_of_opNorm_le hQ (toLp 2 v)
  have hcs : |v ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ v| ≤ vectorNorm v * vectorNorm (Q *ᵥ v) := by
    rw [vectorNorm_eq_norm, vectorNorm_eq_norm]
    simpa only [EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp, star_trivial, dotProduct_comm] using
      abs_real_inner_le_norm (toLp 2 v) (toLp 2 (Q *ᵥ v))
  have hs := vectorNorm_sq v
  nlinarith [vectorNorm_nonneg v]

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.orderContraction_iff_operatorNorm
statement:
theorem orderContraction_iff_operatorNorm {Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hQ : Q.IsHermitian) :
    OrderContraction Q ↔ ‖Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := ι) Q‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact orderContraction_operatorNorm_le
  · intro hn
    constructor
    · apply Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (Matrix.isHermitian_one.sub hQ)
      intro v
      have h := (abs_le.mp (operatorNorm_quadratic_abs_le hn v)).2
      simpa only [star_trivial, sub_mulVec, one_mulVec, dotProduct_sub] using sub_nonneg.mpr h
    · apply Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (Matrix.isHermitian_one.add hQ)
      intro v
      have h := (abs_le.mp (operatorNorm_quadratic_abs_le hn v)).1
      simp only [star_trivial, add_mulVec, one_mulVec, dotProduct_add]
      linarith

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.orderContraction_pair_le
statement:
theorem orderContraction_pair_le {Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hQ : OrderContraction Q)
    (u v : ι → ℝ) : u ⬝ᵥ (Q *ᵥ v) ≤ vectorNorm u * vectorNorm v
proof:
:=
  (dot_le_vectorNorm_mul u _).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (orderContraction_vectorNorm_le hQ v) (vectorNorm_nonneg u))

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.unit_pair_equality_maps
statement:
theorem unit_pair_equality_maps {Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hQ : OrderContraction Q)
    (u v : ι → ℝ) (hu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1) (hv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1)
    (heq : u ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ v = 1) : Q *ᵥ v = u
proof:
:= by
  have hb := orderContraction_dot_sq_le hQ v
  rw [hv] at hb
  have hn := dot_self_nonneg (Q *ᵥ v - u)
  have hc : Q *ᵥ v ⬝ᵥ u = 1 := by rw [dotProduct_comm]; exact heq
  have hz : (Q *ᵥ v - u) ⬝ᵥ (Q *ᵥ v - u) = 0 := by
    simp only [sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub, hu, heq, hc] at hn ⊢
    linarith
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp hz)

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.pair_equality_maps_normalized
statement:
theorem pair_equality_maps_normalized {Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hQ : OrderContraction Q)
    (u v : ι → ℝ) (hu : 0 < u ⬝ᵥ u) (hv : 0 < v ⬝ᵥ v)
    (heq : u ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ v = vectorNorm u * vectorNorm v) :
    Q *ᵥ normalizedVector v = normalizedVector u ∧
      Q *ᵥ normalizedVector u = normalizedVector v
proof:
:= by
  have hnu := ne_of_gt (vectorNorm_pos hu)
  have hnv := ne_of_gt (vectorNorm_pos hv)
  have hpair : normalizedVector u ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ normalizedVector v = 1 := by
    simp only [normalizedVector, mulVec_smul, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, heq]
    field_simp
  constructor
  · exact unit_pair_equality_maps hQ _ _ (normalizedVector_self hu) (normalizedVector_self hv) hpair
  · apply unit_pair_equality_maps hQ _ _ (normalizedVector_self hv) (normalizedVector_self hu)
    rw [dot_mulVec_comm (orderContraction_isHermitian hQ)]
    exact hpair

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.common_pair_equality_gram
statement:
theorem common_pair_equality_gram {α : Type*} {Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hQ : OrderContraction Q) (u v : α → ι → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ y, 0 < u y ⬝ᵥ u y) (hv : ∀ y, 0 < v y ⬝ᵥ v y)
    (heq : ∀ y, u y ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ v y = vectorNorm (u y) * vectorNorm (v y)) (y z : α) :
    (u y ⬝ᵥ u z) / (vectorNorm (u y) * vectorNorm (u z)) =
      (v y ⬝ᵥ v z) / (vectorNorm (v y) * vectorNorm (v z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← normalizedVector_dot, ← normalizedVector_dot]
  have hy := pair_equality_maps_normalized hQ (u y) (v y) (hu y) (hv y) (heq y)
  have hz := pair_equality_maps_normalized hQ (u z) (v z) (hu z) (hv z) (heq z)
  calc
    _ = normalizedVector (u z) ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ normalizedVector (v y) := by
      rw [hy.1, dotProduct_comm]
    _ = normalizedVector (v y) ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ normalizedVector (u z) :=
      dot_mulVec_comm (orderContraction_isHermitian hQ) _ _
    _ = _ := by rw [hz.2]

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.cross_isHermitian
statement:
theorem cross_isHermitian (u v : ι → ℝ) :
    (vecMulVec u v + vecMulVec v u).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  change (vecMulVec u v + vecMulVec v u).conjTranspose = _
  simp only [conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, transpose_add, transpose_vecMulVec]
  exact add_comm _ _

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.trace_mul_cross
statement:
theorem trace_mul_cross {Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hQ : Q.IsHermitian) (u v : ι → ℝ) :
    (Q * (vecMulVec u v + vecMulVec v u)).trace = 2 * (u ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_add, trace_add, mul_vecMulVec, mul_vecMulVec, trace_vecMulVec, trace_vecMulVec]
  rw [dotProduct_comm (Q *ᵥ u), dotProduct_comm (Q *ᵥ v), dot_mulVec_comm hQ v u]
  ring

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.weighted_cross_trace_equality_gram
statement:
theorem weighted_cross_trace_equality_gram {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (p : α → ℝ) (u v : α → ι → ℝ) (hp : ∀ y, 0 < p y)
    (hu : ∀ y, 0 < u y ⬝ᵥ u y) (hv : ∀ y, 0 < v y ⬝ᵥ v y)
    (heq : traceNorm (∑ y, p y • (vecMulVec (u y) (v y) + vecMulVec (v y) (u y))) =
      2 * ∑ y, p y * vectorNorm (u y) * vectorNorm (v y)) (y z : α) :
    (u y ⬝ᵥ u z) / (vectorNorm (u y) * vectorNorm (u z)) =
      (v y ⬝ᵥ v z) / (vectorNorm (v y) * vectorNorm (v z))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H := ∑ y, p y • (vecMulVec (u y) (v y) + vecMulVec (v y) (u y))
  have hH : H.IsHermitian := isSelfAdjoint_sum _ fun y _ =>
    (cross_isHermitian (u y) (v y)).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg (hp y).le)
  let Q := signWitness hH
  have hQ : OrderContraction Q := signWitness_orderContraction hH
  have hQH : Q.IsHermitian := signWitness_isHermitian hH
  have ht : (Q * H).trace = 2 * ∑ y, p y * (u y ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ v y) := by
    simp only [H, Matrix.mul_sum, Matrix.mul_smul, trace_sum, trace_smul,
      trace_mul_cross hQH, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro y _
    ring
  have hs : (∑ y, p y * (u y ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ v y)) =
      ∑ y, p y * vectorNorm (u y) * vectorNorm (v y) := by
    have hw := signWitness_attains hH
    change (Q * H).trace = traceNorm H at hw
    rw [ht, heq] at hw
    linarith
  have hnonneg : ∀ y, 0 ≤ p y * vectorNorm (u y) * vectorNorm (v y) -
      p y * (u y ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ v y) := by
    intro y
    have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (orderContraction_pair_le hQ (u y) (v y)) (hp y).le
    nlinarith
  have hzero : ∑ y, (p y * vectorNorm (u y) * vectorNorm (v y) -
      p y * (u y ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ v y)) = 0 := by rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hs, sub_self]
  have heach := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun y _ => hnonneg y)).mp hzero
  apply common_pair_equality_gram hQ u v hu hv _ y z
  intro a
  have ha := heach a (Finset.mem_univ a)
  have hpa := hp a
  nlinarith

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.reflection_conjugate_twice
statement:
theorem reflection_conjugate_twice {F : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hF : F * F = 1)
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) : F * (F * A * F) * F = A
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (F * F) * A * (F * F) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hF, one_mul, mul_one]

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.reflection_conjugate_isHermitian
statement:
theorem reflection_conjugate_isHermitian {F A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hF : F.IsHermitian) (hA : A.IsHermitian) : (F * A * F).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  change (F * A * F).conjTranspose = _
  simp only [conjTranspose_mul, hF.eq, hA.eq, mul_assoc]

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.orderContraction_reflection_conjugate
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have h := hQ.1.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same F
    simpa only [hF.eq, mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_one, hFsq] using h
  · have h := hQ.2.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same F
    simpa only [hF.eq, mul_add, add_mul, mul_one, hFsq] using h

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.orderContraction_half_sub
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have h := (hQ.1.add hR.2).smul (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 by norm_num)
    convert h using 1; module
  · have h := (hQ.2.add hR.1).smul (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 by norm_num)
    convert h using 1; module

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.trace_reflection_move
statement:
theorem trace_reflection_move (F A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    (F * A * F * B).trace = (A * (F * B * F)).trace
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (F * (A * F * B)).trace := by congr 1; noncomm_ring
    _ = ((A * F * B) * F).trace := trace_mul_comm _ _
    _ = _ := by congr 1; noncomm_ring

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.anticommuting_trace_identity
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (Q * (F * K * F)).trace = -(Q * K).trace := by
    rw [← trace_reflection_move, hQ, neg_mul, trace_neg]
  rw [mul_sub, trace_sub, hm, trace_mul_comm Q K]
  ring

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.exists_anticommuting_trace_witness
statement:
theorem exists_anticommuting_trace_witness {K F : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hK : K.IsHermitian) (hF : F.IsHermitian) (hFsq : F * F = 1) :
    ∃ Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ, Q.IsHermitian ∧ OrderContraction Q ∧ F * Q * F = -Q ∧
      (K * Q).trace = traceNorm (K - F * K * F) / 2
proof:
:= by
  let H := K - F * K * F
  have hH : H.IsHermitian := hK.sub (reflection_conjugate_isHermitian hF hK)
  let S := signWitness hH
  have hS : OrderContraction S := signWitness_orderContraction hH
  let Q := (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (S - F * S * F)
  have hQ : OrderContraction Q := orderContraction_half_sub hS
    (orderContraction_reflection_conjugate hF hFsq hS)
  have ha : F * Q * F = -Q := by
    dsimp only [Q]
    simp only [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, mul_sub, sub_mul]
    rw [reflection_conjugate_twice hFsq]
    module
  refine ⟨Q, orderContraction_isHermitian hQ, hQ, ha, ?_⟩
  have hHanti : F * H * F = -H := by
    dsimp only [H]
    simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul]
    rw [reflection_conjugate_twice hFsq]
    abel
  have hSH : (S * H).trace = traceNorm H := signWitness_attains hH
  have hQH : (Q * H).trace = traceNorm H := by
    dsimp only [Q]
    rw [smul_mul_assoc, trace_smul, sub_mul, trace_sub, trace_reflection_move,
      hHanti, mul_neg, trace_neg, hSH]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hi := anticommuting_trace_identity ha K
  change (Q * H).trace = 2 * (K * Q).trace at hi
  change (K * Q).trace = traceNorm H / 2
  linarith

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.anticommuting_trace_le
statement:
theorem anticommuting_trace_le {K F Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hK : K.IsHermitian) (hF : F.IsHermitian) (hQ : OrderContraction Q)
    (ha : F * Q * F = -Q) :
    (K * Q).trace ≤ traceNorm (K - F * K * F) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := trace_mul_le_traceNorm
    (hK.sub (reflection_conjugate_isHermitian hF hK)) hQ
  rw [anticommuting_trace_identity ha] at h
  linarith

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.reflection_anticommutes
statement:
theorem reflection_anticommutes {F Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hFsq : F * F = 1) (ha : F * Q * F = -Q) : F * Q = -(Q * F)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun A => A * F) ha
  simpa only [mul_assoc, hFsq, mul_one, neg_mul] using h

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.anticommuting_uncertainty
statement:
theorem anticommuting_uncertainty {F Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hF : F.IsHermitian) (hFsq : F * F = 1) (hQ : OrderContraction Q)
    (ha : F * Q * F = -Q) (ψ : ι → ℝ) (hψ : ψ ⬝ᵥ ψ = 1) :
    (ψ ⬝ᵥ F *ᵥ ψ) ^ 2 + (ψ ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ ψ) ^ 2 ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  let a := ψ ⬝ᵥ F *ᵥ ψ
  let b := ψ ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ ψ
  let A := a • F + b • Q
  have hAH : A.IsHermitian := (hF.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial a))).add
    ((orderContraction_isHermitian hQ).smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial b)))
  have hA2 : A * A = a ^ 2 • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) + b ^ 2 • (Q * Q) := by
    simp only [A, add_mul, mul_add, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm,
      hFsq, reflection_anticommutes hFsq ha]
    module
  have hQQ : ψ ⬝ᵥ (Q * Q) *ᵥ ψ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← mulVec_mulVec, dot_mulVec_comm (orderContraction_isHermitian hQ)]
    simpa only [hψ] using orderContraction_dot_sq_le hQ ψ
  have hAψ : (A *ᵥ ψ) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ ψ) ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
    rw [← dot_mulVec_comm hAH ψ, mulVec_mulVec, hA2]
    simp only [add_mulVec, smul_mulVec, one_mulVec, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul,
      smul_eq_mul, hψ, mul_one]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg b]
  have hinner : ψ ⬝ᵥ A *ᵥ ψ = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
    simp only [A, add_mulVec, smul_mulVec, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    change a * a + b * b = _
    ring
  have hcs := dot_le_vectorNorm_mul ψ (A *ᵥ ψ)
  have hnorm : vectorNorm ψ = 1 := by simp [vectorNorm, hψ]
  rw [hinner, hnorm, one_mul] at hcs
  have hnorm2 := vectorNorm_sq (A *ᵥ ψ)
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := add_nonneg (sq_nonneg a) (sq_nonneg b)
  have hsq : (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [vectorNorm_nonneg (A *ᵥ ψ)]
  change a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 ≤ 1
  nlinarith

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.anticommuting_trace_maximum
statement:
theorem anticommuting_trace_maximum {K F : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hK : K.IsHermitian) (hF : F.IsHermitian) (hFsq : F * F = 1) :
    IsGreatest {t : ℝ | ∃ Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ, Q.IsHermitian ∧
      ‖Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := ι) Q‖ ≤ 1 ∧ F * Q * F = -Q ∧
      t = (K * Q).trace} (traceNorm (K - F * K * F) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨Q, hQH, hQ, ha, ht⟩ := exists_anticommuting_trace_witness hK hF hFsq
    exact ⟨Q, hQH, orderContraction_operatorNorm_le hQ, ha, ht.symm⟩
  · rintro t ⟨Q, hQH, hn, ha, rfl⟩
    exact anticommuting_trace_le hK hF ((orderContraction_iff_operatorNorm hQH).mpr hn) ha

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.anticommuting_uncertainty_operatorNorm
statement:
theorem anticommuting_uncertainty_operatorNorm {F Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hF : F.IsHermitian) (hFsq : F * F = 1) (hQ : Q.IsHermitian)
    (hn : ‖Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := ι) Q‖ ≤ 1)
    (ha : F * Q * F = -Q) (ψ : ι → ℝ) (hψ : ψ ⬝ᵥ ψ = 1) :
    (ψ ⬝ᵥ F *ᵥ ψ) ^ 2 + (ψ ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ ψ) ^ 2 ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  anticommuting_uncertainty hF hFsq ((orderContraction_iff_operatorNorm hQ).mpr hn) ha ψ hψ

name: Hellinger.PrincipalSubspaces.embed_supported
statement: theorem embed_supported {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n)) (x : S → F2) : Supported S (embed S x)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  simp [embed, hi]

name: Hellinger.PrincipalSubspaces.sum_supported
statement:
theorem sum_supported {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n)) (F : Cube n → ℝ) :
    (∑ v : Cube n, if Supported S v then F v else 0) = ∑ x : S → F2, F (embed S x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [Finset.sum_subtype _ (by simp : ∀ x : Cube n,
    x ∈ Finset.univ.filter (Supported S) ↔ Supported S x)]
  rw [← (supportedEquiv S).sum_comp]
  rfl

name: Hellinger.PrincipalSubspaces.embed_dot
statement:
theorem embed_dot {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n)) (x : S → F2) (v : Cube n) :
    embed S x ⬝ᵥ v = ∑ i : S, x i * v i
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (∑ i ∈ S, embed S x i * v i) = ∑ i : Fin n, embed S x i * v i := by
    apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S)
    intro i _ hi
    simp [embed, hi]
  rw [dotProduct, ← hs, Finset.sum_subtype S (p := fun i => i ∈ S) (F := inferInstance) (by intro i; rfl)]
  simp [embed]

name: Hellinger.PrincipalSubspaces.mulVec_embed
statement:
theorem mulVec_embed {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) F2)
    (S : Finset (Fin n)) (y : S → F2) (i : Fin n) :
    (B *ᵥ embed S y) i = ∑ j : S, B i j * y j
proof:
:= by
  change B i ⬝ᵥ embed S y = _
  rw [dotProduct_comm, embed_dot]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

name: Hellinger.PrincipalSubspaces.embed_bilin
statement:
theorem embed_bilin {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) F2)
    (S : Finset (Fin n)) (x y : S → F2) :
    embed S x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ embed S y = x ⬝ᵥ principalMatrix B S *ᵥ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [embed_dot]
  simp_rw [mulVec_embed]
  rfl

name: Hellinger.PrincipalSubspaces.principal_character_sum
statement:
theorem principal_character_sum {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) F2)
    (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    (∑ s : Cube n, ∑ d : Cube n,
      if Supported S s ∧ Supported S d then sign (d ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ s) else 0) =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * S.card - (principalMatrix B S).rank)
proof:
:= by
  have hi (s d : Cube n) :
      (if Supported S s ∧ Supported S d then sign (d ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ s) else 0) =
      if Supported S s then (if Supported S d then sign (d ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ s) else 0) else 0 := by
    split_ifs <;> simp_all
  simp_rw [hi, Finset.sum_ite_irrel, Finset.sum_const_zero, sum_supported]
  simp_rw [embed_bilin]
  simpa using double_character_sum (principalMatrix B S)

name: Hellinger.Fourier.degree_zero
statement: theorem degree_zero : ∀ n, degree (fun _ : Fin n => false) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  simp [degree, support]

name: Hellinger.Fourier.degree_pos_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem degree_pos_of_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (s : Cube n) (hs : s ≠ (fun _ => false)) :
    0 < degree s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, s i ≠ false := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hs (funext h)
  apply Finset.card_pos.mpr
  refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
  cases hsi : s i <;> simp_all [support]

name: Hellinger.Fourier.support_unit
statement: theorem support_unit {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : support (unit i) = {i}
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  simp [support, unit]

name: Hellinger.Fourier.degree_unit
statement: theorem degree_unit {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : degree (unit i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [degree, support_unit]

name: Hellinger.Fourier.unit_injective
statement: theorem unit_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (unit (n := n))
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h
  have hs := congrArg support h
  simpa only [support_unit, Finset.singleton_inj] using hs

name: Hellinger.Fourier.degree_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem degree_eq_one_iff {n : ℕ} (s : Cube n) :
    degree s = 1 ↔ ∃ i : Fin n, s = unit i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp h
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    apply (supportEquiv n).injective
    change support s = support (unit i)
    rw [hi, support_unit]
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact degree_unit i

name: Hellinger.Fourier.phase_unit
statement:
theorem phase_unit {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (x : Cube n) :
    phase (unit i) x = boolSign (x i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [phase_character, support_unit]
  simp [character]

name: Hellinger.Fourier.high_walsh_eq_zero_of_noise_equality
statement:
theorem high_walsh_eq_zero_of_noise_equality {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hm : mean f = 0)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρpos : 0 < ρ) (hρlt : ρ < 1)
    (heq : mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x) ^ 2) = ρ ^ 2)
    (s : Cube n) (hs : 1 < degree s) : walsh f s = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hz : walsh f (fun _ => false) = 0 := by rw [walsh_zero, hm]
  have hnorm :
      (∑ t ∈ Finset.univ.erase (fun _ : Fin n => false), walsh f t ^ 2) = 1 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_erase _ (by rw [hz]; norm_num), boolean_parseval f hf]
  have hnoise :
      (∑ t ∈ Finset.univ.erase (fun _ : Fin n => false),
        ρ ^ (2 * degree t) * walsh f t ^ 2) = ρ ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_erase _ (by rw [hz]; simp), ← noise_second_moment f ρ hρ, heq]
  apply Rigidity.coefficient_eq_zero_of_noise_parseval_equality degree (walsh f)
    ρ hρpos hρlt
    (fun t ht => degree_pos_of_ne_zero t (Finset.mem_erase.mp ht).1)
    hnorm hnoise
  · apply Finset.mem_erase.mpr
    refine ⟨?_, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
    intro h
    subst s
    simp [degree_zero] at hs
  · exact hs

name: Hellinger.Fourier.linear_expansion_of_high_walsh_zero
statement:
theorem linear_expansion_of_high_walsh_zero {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hm : mean f = 0) (hh : ∀ s, 1 < degree s → walsh f s = 0) (x : Cube n) :
    f x = ∑ i : Fin n, walsh f (unit i) * boolSign (x i)
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : Finset.univ.image (unit (n := n)) ⊆ (Finset.univ : Finset (Cube n)) :=
    Finset.subset_univ _
  have hvanish (s : Cube n) (hsmem : s ∈ Finset.univ)
      (hsnot : s ∉ Finset.univ.image (unit (n := n))) : walsh f s * phase s x = 0 := by
    have hneone : degree s ≠ 1 := by
      intro h
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (degree_eq_one_iff s).mp h
      exact hsnot (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, hi.symm⟩)
    by_cases hs : s = (fun _ => false)
    · subst s
      rw [walsh_zero, hm, zero_mul]
    · have hpos := degree_pos_of_ne_zero s hs
      rw [hh s (by omega), zero_mul]
  calc
    f x = ∑ s, walsh f s * phase s x := inversion f x
    _ = ∑ s ∈ Finset.univ.image (unit (n := n)), walsh f s * phase s x :=
      (Finset.sum_subset hsub hvanish).symm
    _ = ∑ i : Fin n, walsh f (unit i) * boolSign (x i) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_image (fun i _ j _ h => unit_injective n h)]
      simp only [phase_unit]

name: Hellinger.Fourier.signed_dictator_of_noise_equality
statement:
theorem signed_dictator_of_noise_equality {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hm : mean f = 0)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρpos : 0 < ρ) (hρlt : ρ < 1)
    (heq : mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x) ^ 2) = ρ ^ 2) :
    ∃ i : Fin n, ∃ a : ℝ, (a = 1 ∨ a = -1) ∧
      ∀ x, f x = a * boolSign (x i)
proof:
:= by
  have hlinear := linear_expansion_of_high_walsh_zero f hm
    (high_walsh_eq_zero_of_noise_equality f hf hm ρ hρ hρpos hρlt heq)
  have hbool : ∀ z : Fin n → ℝ, Rigidity.IsSignVector z →
      (∑ i, walsh f (unit i) * z i) ^ 2 = 1 := by
    intro z hz
    let x : Cube n := fun i => if z i = -1 then true else false
    have hx (i : Fin n) : boolSign (x i) = z i := by
      have hp : (z i - 1) * (z i + 1) = 0 := by nlinarith [hz i]
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hp with h | h
      · have hi : z i = 1 := by linarith
        norm_num [x, hi, boolSign]
      · have hi : z i = -1 := by linarith
        norm_num [x, hi, boolSign]
    have hxlinear := hlinear x
    simp only [hx] at hxlinear
    rw [← hxlinear]
    rcases hf x with h | h <;> simp [h]
  obtain ⟨i, hsign, hothers, hform⟩ :=
    Rigidity.boolean_linear_is_signed_coordinate (fun i => walsh f (unit i)) hbool
  refine ⟨i, walsh f (unit i), hsign, ?_⟩
  intro x
  rw [hlinear]
  exact hform (fun j => boolSign (x j))

name: Hellinger.AntipodalEquality.root_mean_equality_iff_signed_dictator
statement:
theorem root_mean_equality_iff_signed_dictator (n : ℕ) (f : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hanti : ∀ x, f (antipode (n + 1) x) = -f x)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρpos : 0 < ρ) (hρlt : ρ < 1) :
    mean (fun y => root ((cubeBSC (n + 1) ρ hρ).apply f y)) = root ρ ↔
      ∃ i : Fin (n + 1), ∃ negative : Bool,
        f = fun x => if negative then -boolSign (x i) else boolSign (x i)
proof:
:= by
  have hm := antipodal_mean_zero (n + 1) f hanti
  have hr0 : root (0 : ℝ) = 1 := by norm_num [root]
  constructor
  · intro heq
    have hc : root ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
      ⟨Real.sqrt_nonneg _, Real.sqrt_le_one.mpr (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ρ])⟩
    have hlower := ParityBlocks.antipodal_trace_lower_bound n (root ρ) hc f hf hanti
    have hupper := bsc_lifting (n + 1) f hf ρ hρ
    have hlift : TraceNorm.traceNorm
        (ProductState.state (n + 1) (root ρ) -
          reflection f * ProductState.state (n + 1) (root ρ) * reflection f) / 2 =
        mean (fun y => root ((cubeBSC (n + 1) ρ hρ).apply f y)) := by
      change root ρ ≤ TraceNorm.traceNorm
        (ProductState.state (n + 1) (root ρ) -
          reflection f * ProductState.state (n + 1) (root ρ) * reflection f) / 2 at hlower
      linarith
    have hobj : objective ((cubeBSC (n + 1) ρ hρ).apply f) = 1 - root ρ := by
      unfold objective
      rw [UniformChannel.mean_apply, hm, heq, hr0]
    obtain ⟨i, a, ha, hform⟩ :=
      signed_dictator_of_lifting_and_objective_equality f hf hm ρ hρ hρpos hρlt hlift hobj
    rcases ha with ha | ha
    · refine ⟨i, false, ?_⟩
      funext x
      simp only [hform, ha, one_mul, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    · refine ⟨i, true, ?_⟩
      funext x
      simp only [hform, ha, neg_one_mul, if_true]
  · rintro ⟨i, negative, hform⟩
    have hobj : objective ((cubeBSC (n + 1) ρ hρ).apply f) = 1 - root ρ := by
      rw [hform]
      exact bsc_signed_dictator_equality (n + 1) i negative ρ hρ
    unfold objective at hobj
    rw [UniformChannel.mean_apply, hm, hr0] at hobj
    linarith

name: Hellinger.AntipodalEquality.objective_equality_iff_signed_dictator
statement:
theorem objective_equality_iff_signed_dictator (n : ℕ) (f : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hanti : ∀ x, f (antipode (n + 1) x) = -f x)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρpos : 0 < ρ) (hρlt : ρ < 1) :
    objective ((cubeBSC (n + 1) ρ hρ).apply f) = 1 - root ρ ↔
      ∃ i : Fin (n + 1), ∃ negative : Bool,
        f = fun x => if negative then -boolSign (x i) else boolSign (x i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← root_mean_equality_iff_signed_dictator n f hf hanti ρ hρ hρpos hρlt]
  unfold objective
  rw [UniformChannel.mean_apply, antipodal_mean_zero (n + 1) f hanti]
  have hr0 : root (0 : ℝ) = 1 := by norm_num [root]
  rw [hr0]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
