        simp [e, MeasurableEquiv.piEquivPiSubtypeProd, Equiv.piEquivPiSubtypeProd_symm_apply, i.property]
      rw [hleft, hright]
    simp_rw [← hv] at hmix
    exact hmix
  have hbound := integral_mono (integrable_const c) hRint.integral_prod_right hinner
  simpa using hbound

name: Hellinger.PosteriorSections.value_coordinate
statement:
theorem value_coordinate (a : (i : ι) → E i → ℝ) (i : ι) (y : (i : ι) → E i) :
    value a (fun b => boolSign (b i)) y = a i (y i)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∑ b : ι → Bool, ∏ j, bitProbability (a j (y j)) (b j) *
        (if j = i then boolSign (b j) else 1) := by
      unfold value probability
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro b _
      rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
      simp
    _ = ∏ j, ∑ b : Bool, bitProbability (a j (y j)) b *
        (if j = i then boolSign b else 1) :=
      (Fintype.prod_sum (fun (j : ι) (b : Bool) => bitProbability (a j (y j)) b *
        (if j = i then boolSign b else 1))).symm
    _ = a i (y i) := by
      have hfactor (j : ι) :
          (∑ b : Bool, bitProbability (a j (y j)) b * (if j = i then boolSign b else 1)) =
            if j = i then a j (y j) else 1 := by
        by_cases hji : j = i
        · simp [hji, bitProbability, boolSign]
          ring
        · simp only [hji, if_false, mul_one, bitProbability_sum]
      simp_rw [hfactor]
      simp

name: Hellinger.PosteriorSections.coordinate_attains
statement:
theorem coordinate_attains (μ : (i : ι) → Measure (E i)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (a : (i : ι) → E i → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, Measurable (a i)) (i : ι) :
    (∫ y, root (value a (fun b => boolSign (b i)) y) ∂Measure.pi μ) = parameter μ a i
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [value_coordinate]
  have hm : Measurable (fun y => root (a i y)) := by unfold root; fun_prop
  exact integral_comp_eval hm.aestronglyMeasurable

name: Hellinger.PosteriorSections.parameter_mem
statement:
theorem parameter_mem (μ : (i : ι) → Measure (E i)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (a : (i : ι) → E i → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, Measurable (a i)) (i : ι) :
    parameter μ a i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable (fun y => root (a i y)) := by unfold root; fun_prop
  have hi := integrable_of_abs_le (μ i) _ hm 1
    (fun y => by rw [abs_of_nonneg (root_mem _).1]; exact (root_mem _).2)
  refine ⟨integral_nonneg (fun y => (root_mem _).1), ?_⟩
  exact (integral_mono hi (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)) (fun y => (root_mem _).2)).trans_eq
    (by simp)

name: Hellinger.PosteriorSections.subset_sharp
statement:
theorem subset_sharp (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] [Nonempty {i // p i}]
    (μ : (i : ι) → Measure (E i)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (a : (i : ι) → E i → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, Measurable (a i))
    (hb : ∀ i y, a i y ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ y, a i y ∂μ i = 0) :
    ∃ i : {i // p i}, (∀ j : {j // p j}, parameter μ a i ≤ parameter μ a j) ∧
      (∀ f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ, (∀ b, f b = -1 ∨ f b = 1) →
        (∀ b, f (fun j => if p j then !(b j) else b j) = -f b) →
        parameter μ a i ≤ ∫ y, root (value a f y) ∂Measure.pi μ) ∧
      (∀ b : ι → Bool, boolSign ((fun j => if p j then !(b j) else b j) i) = -boolSign (b i)) ∧
      (∫ y, root (value a (fun b => boolSign (b i)) y) ∂Measure.pi μ) = parameter μ a i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, _, hmin⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image (Finset.univ : Finset {i // p i})
    (fun i => parameter μ a i) Finset.univ_nonempty
  refine ⟨i, fun j => hmin j (Finset.mem_univ j), ?_, ?_, coordinate_attains μ a ha i⟩
  · intro f hf hflip
    exact subset_bound p μ a ha hb hmean f hf hflip (parameter μ a i)
      (parameter_mem μ a ha i)
      (fun j hj => hmin ⟨j, hj⟩ (Finset.mem_univ _))
  · intro b
    simp only [i.property, if_true]
    cases b i <;> norm_num [boolSign]

name: Hellinger.LayerCake.threshold_difference_indicator
statement:
theorem threshold_difference_indicator (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (fun t => |threshold a t - threshold b t|) =
      (Ico a b).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  funext t
  by_cases hta : t < a
  · have htb : t < b := hta.trans_le hab
    simp [threshold, hta, htb, Set.indicator_of_notMem, not_le.mpr hta]
  · by_cases htb : t < b
    · simp [threshold, hta, htb, not_lt.mp hta]
    · simp [threshold, hta, htb]

name: Hellinger.LayerCake.threshold_difference_integrable
statement:
theorem threshold_difference_integrable (a b : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun t => |threshold a t - threshold b t|)
proof:
:= by
  wlog hab : a ≤ b generalizing a b
  · simpa only [abs_sub_comm] using this b a (le_of_not_ge hab)
  rw [threshold_difference_indicator a b hab]
  exact (integrable_indicator_iff measurableSet_Ico).mpr
    (integrableOn_const (by simp [Real.volume_Ico]))

name: Hellinger.LayerCake.threshold_difference_integral
statement:
theorem threshold_difference_integral (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    (∫ t in Ici (0 : ℝ), |threshold a t - threshold b t|) = |a - b|
proof:
:= by
  wlog hab : a ≤ b generalizing a b
  · simpa only [abs_sub_comm] using this b a hb ha (le_of_not_ge hab)
  rw [threshold_difference_indicator a b hab, setIntegral_indicator measurableSet_Ico]
  have hsub : Ico a b ⊆ Ici (0 : ℝ) := fun t ht => ha.trans ht.1
  rw [inter_eq_right.mpr hsub, setIntegral_const]
  simp only [measureReal_def, Real.volume_Ico, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (sub_nonneg.mpr hab),
    smul_eq_mul, mul_one, abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hab)]
  ring

name: Hellinger.LayerCake.threshold_cuts_nested
statement:
theorem threshold_cuts_nested (a b : ι → ℝ) (ha : Antitone a) (hb : Antitone b) (t : ℝ) :
    (∀ i, threshold (a i) t ≤ threshold (b i) t) ∨
      (∀ i, threshold (b i) t ≤ threshold (a i) t)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ∀ i, t < a i → t < b i
  · left
    intro i
    by_cases hi : t < a i
    · simp [threshold, hi, h i hi]
    · simp [threshold, hi]
      split_ifs <;> norm_num
  · push Not at h
    obtain ⟨i, hai, hbi⟩ := h
    have hreverse : ∀ j, t < b j → t < a j := by
      intro j hj
      rcases le_total j i with hji | hij
      · exact hai.trans_le (ha hji)
      · exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hbi) (hj.trans_le (hb hij)))
    right
    intro j
    by_cases hj : t < b j
    · simp [threshold, hj, hreverse j hj]
    · simp [threshold, hj]
      split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: Hellinger.LayerCake.sum_abs_threshold_difference
statement:
theorem sum_abs_threshold_difference (a b : ι → ℝ)
    (ha : Antitone a) (hb : Antitone b) (t : ℝ) :
    (∑ i, |threshold (a i) t - threshold (b i) t|) =
      |(∑ i, threshold (a i) t) - ∑ i, threshold (b i) t|
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rcases threshold_cuts_nested a b ha hb t with hab | hba
  · have hn : ∀ i, threshold (a i) t - threshold (b i) t ≤ 0 :=
      fun i => sub_nonpos.mpr (hab i)
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (Finset.sum_nonpos (fun i _ => hn i))]
    simp_rw [abs_of_nonpos (hn _), Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  · have hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ threshold (a i) t - threshold (b i) t :=
      fun i => sub_nonneg.mpr (hba i)
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hp i))]
    simp_rw [abs_of_nonneg (hp _)]

name: Hellinger.LayerCake.countAbove_eq_sum
statement:
theorem countAbove_eq_sum (a : ι → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    countAbove a t = ∑ i, threshold (a i) t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [countAbove, threshold, Finset.sum_boole]

name: Hellinger.LayerCake.counting_difference_integrable
statement:
theorem counting_difference_integrable (a b : ι → ℝ)
    (ha : Antitone a) (hb : Antitone b) :
    Integrable (fun t => |countAbove a t - countAbove b t|)
proof:
:= by
  have hi := integrable_finsetSum (Finset.univ : Finset ι)
    (fun i _ => threshold_difference_integrable (a i) (b i))
  simpa only [sum_abs_threshold_difference a b ha hb, ← countAbove_eq_sum] using hi

name: Hellinger.LayerCake.ordered_layer_cake
statement:
theorem ordered_layer_cake (a b : ι → ℝ) (ha : Antitone a) (hb : Antitone b)
    (ha₀ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) (hb₀ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ b i) :
    (∑ i, |a i - b i|) = ∫ t in Ici (0 : ℝ), |countAbove a t - countAbove b t|
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [countAbove_eq_sum, ← sum_abs_threshold_difference a b ha hb]
  rw [integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ =>
    (threshold_difference_integrable (a i) (b i)).mono_measure Measure.restrict_le_self)]
  simp_rw [threshold_difference_integral _ _ (ha₀ _) (hb₀ _)]

name: Hellinger.InterlaceMoment.scalar_substitution
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 1 - t ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm ht)
  have he : 2 * n = 2 * (n - s) + 2 * s := by omega
  have he₂ : r + (s - r) = s := by omega
  have hcoef : (4 * t) ^ r * (8 * t) ^ (s - r) =
      (2 * t) ^ s * (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * s - r) := by
    rw [show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, show (8 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 3 by norm_num]
    simp only [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
    calc
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * r + 3 * (s - r)) * t ^ (r + (s - r)) := by
        rw [pow_add, pow_add]
        ring
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (s + (2 * s - r)) * t ^ s := by
        congr 2; omega
      _ = _ := by rw [pow_add]; ring
  rw [he, pow_add]
  calc
    _ = (1 - t) ^ (2 * (n - s)) *
        (((1 - t) ^ 2) ^ s *
          (((4 * t) / (1 - t) ^ 2) ^ r * ((8 * t) / (1 - t) ^ 2) ^ (s - r))) := by
      rw [← pow_mul]
      ring
    _ = (1 - t) ^ (2 * (n - s)) * ((4 * t) ^ r * (8 * t) ^ (s - r)) := by
      congr 1
      rw [div_pow, div_pow, div_mul_div_comm, ← pow_add, he₂]
      exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ (pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ hd))
    _ = _ := by rw [hcoef]; ring

name: Hellinger.InterlaceMoment.interlace_substitution
statement:
theorem interlace_substitution {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) F2)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ≠ 1) :
    (1 - t) ^ (2 * n) * interlace B (1 + 4 * t / (1 - t) ^ 2)
      (1 + 8 * t / (1 - t) ^ 2) =
      ∑ S : Finset (Fin n), rankWeight t S *
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * S.card - (principalMatrix B S).rank)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [interlace, add_sub_cancel_left, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro S _
  have hs : S.card ≤ n := by simpa using Finset.card_le_card (Finset.subset_univ S)
  have hr : (principalMatrix B S).rank ≤ S.card := by
    simpa using (principalMatrix B S).rank_le_card_width
  simpa only [rankWeight, mul_assoc] using scalar_substitution n S.card
    (principalMatrix B S).rank hs hr t ht

name: Hellinger.InterlaceMoment.fourth_moment_interlace
statement:
theorem fourth_moment_interlace {n : ℕ} (a : F2) (Q : Form n)
    (hQ : IsUnit (polarMatrix Q).det) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hρlt : ρ < 1) :
    mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) x) ^ 4) =
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * n))⁻¹ * (1 - ρ ^ 2) ^ (2 * n) *
        interlace (polarMatrix Q)⁻¹ (1 + 4 * ρ ^ 2 / (1 - ρ ^ 2) ^ 2)
          (1 + 8 * ρ ^ 2 / (1 - ρ ^ 2) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have ht : ρ ^ 2 ≠ 1 := by nlinarith [hρ.1]
  rw [fourth_moment_principal_ranks a Q hQ, mul_assoc, interlace_substitution _ _ ht]
  rfl

name: Hellinger.InterlaceMoment.inverse_polar_alternating
statement:
theorem inverse_polar_alternating {n : ℕ} (Q : Form n)
    (hQ : IsUnit (polarMatrix Q).det) (x : Cube n) :
    x ⬝ᵥ (polarMatrix Q)⁻¹ *ᵥ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← dualForm_polar Q hQ]
  change QuadraticMap.polar (dualForm Q) x x = 0
  rw [QuadraticMap.polar_self, two_nsmul]
  exact (F2Model.add_eq_zero_iff _ _).mpr rfl

name: Hellinger.InterlaceMoment.inverse_polar_isAdjMatrix
statement:
theorem inverse_polar_isAdjMatrix {n : ℕ} (Q : Form n)
    (hQ : IsUnit (polarMatrix Q).det) : ((polarMatrix Q)⁻¹).IsAdjMatrix where
  zero_or_one i j
proof:
:= by
    by_cases h : (polarMatrix Q)⁻¹ i j = 0
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (eq_one_of_ne_zero _ h)
  symm := (polarMatrix_symmetric Q).inv
  apply_diag i := by
    have h := inverse_polar_alternating Q hQ (Pi.single i 1)
    simpa using h

name: Hellinger.InterlaceMoment.inversePolarGraph_adjacency
statement:
theorem inversePolarGraph_adjacency {n : ℕ} (Q : Form n) (hQ : IsUnit (polarMatrix Q).det) :
    (inversePolarGraph Q hQ).adjMatrix F2 = (polarMatrix Q)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply]
  simp only [inversePolarGraph, Matrix.IsAdjMatrix.toGraph_adj]
  rcases (inverse_polar_isAdjMatrix Q hQ).zero_or_one i j with h | h <;> simp [h]

name: Hellinger.InterlaceMoment.fourth_moment_graph_interlace
statement:
theorem fourth_moment_graph_interlace {n : ℕ} (a : F2) (Q : Form n)
    (hQ : IsUnit (polarMatrix Q).det) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hρlt : ρ < 1) :
    mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) x) ^ 4) =
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * n))⁻¹ * (1 - ρ ^ 2) ^ (2 * n) *
        graphInterlace (inversePolarGraph Q hQ) (1 + 4 * ρ ^ 2 / (1 - ρ ^ 2) ^ 2)
          (1 + 8 * ρ ^ 2 / (1 - ρ ^ 2) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [graphInterlace, inversePolarGraph_adjacency]
  exact fourth_moment_interlace a Q hQ ρ hρ hρlt

name: Hellinger.InterlaceMoment.noise_one
statement:
theorem noise_one {n : ℕ} (f : Fourier.Cube n → ℝ)
    (h₁ : (1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : (cubeBSC n 1 h₁).apply f = f
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  rw [Fourier.inversion ((cubeBSC n 1 h₁).apply f) x]
  simp only [Fourier.walsh_noise, one_pow, one_mul]
  exact (Fourier.inversion f x).symm

name: Hellinger.InterlaceMoment.phase_fourth_moment_one
statement:
theorem phase_fourth_moment_one {n : ℕ} (a : F2) (Q : Form n)
    (h₁ : (1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC n 1 h₁).apply (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) x) ^ 4) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [noise_one]
  have h (x : Fourier.Cube n) : (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) x ^ 4 = 1 := by
    rcases phase_boolean a Q (bitsEquiv (Fin n) x) with h | h <;>
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, h] <;> norm_num
  simp only [h, mean_const]

name: Hellinger.PivotCoordinates.indexEquiv_inl
statement:
@[simp] theorem indexEquiv_inl (a : Fin k ↪ Fin n) (i : Fin k) :
    indexEquiv a (Sum.inl i) = a i
proof: := rfl

name: Hellinger.PivotCoordinates.indexEquiv_inr
statement:
@[simp] theorem indexEquiv_inr (a : Fin k ↪ Fin n) (i : Remaining a) :
    indexEquiv a (Sum.inr i) = i.val
proof: := rfl

name: Hellinger.PivotCoordinates.coordinates_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinates_fst (a : Fin k ↪ Fin n) (x : Cube n) (i : Fin k) :
    (coordinates a x).1 i = x (a i)
proof: := rfl

name: Hellinger.PivotCoordinates.coordinates_snd
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinates_snd (a : Fin k ↪ Fin n) (x : Cube n) (i : Remaining a) :
    (coordinates a x).2 i = x i.val
proof: := rfl

name: Hellinger.PivotCoordinates.coordinatesLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinatesLinear_apply (a : Fin k ↪ Fin n) (x : Cube n) :
    coordinatesLinear a x = coordinates a x
proof: := rfl

name: Hellinger.PivotCoordinates.noise_weight_coordinates
statement:
theorem noise_weight_coordinates (a : Fin k ↪ Fin n) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x y : Cube n) :
    (productChannel (noise (Fin k) ρ hρ) (noise (Remaining a) ρ hρ)).weight
      (coordinates a x) (coordinates a y) = (noise (Fin n) ρ hρ).weight x y
proof:
:= by
  have h := (indexEquiv a).prod_comp (fun i => (oneStep ρ hρ).weight (x i) (y i))
  rw [Fintype.prod_sum_type] at h
  exact h

name: Hellinger.PivotCoordinates.noise_apply_coordinates
statement:
theorem noise_apply_coordinates (a : Fin k ↪ Fin n) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (g : (Cube k × (Remaining a → F2)) → ℝ) (x : Cube n) :
    (noise (Fin n) ρ hρ).apply (g ∘ coordinates a) x =
      (productChannel (noise (Fin k) ρ hρ) (noise (Remaining a) ρ hρ)).apply g (coordinates a x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold UniformChannel.apply
  rw [← (coordinates a).sum_comp
    (fun y => (productChannel (noise (Fin k) ρ hρ) (noise (Remaining a) ρ hρ)).weight
      (coordinates a x) y * g y)]
  simp only [noise_weight_coordinates, Function.comp_apply]

name: Hellinger.PivotCoordinates.selected_single
statement:
theorem selected_single (a : Fin k ↪ Fin n) (i : Fin k) :
    coordinatesLinear a (Pi.single (a i) 1) = (Pi.single i 1, 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · funext j
    simp [coordinatesLinear, coordinates, indexEquiv, Pi.single_apply, a.injective.eq_iff]
  · funext j
    have hne : j.val ≠ a i := by
      intro h
      exact j.property ⟨i, h.symm⟩
    simp [coordinatesLinear, coordinates, indexEquiv, hne]

name: Hellinger.PivotCoordinates.selected_assembly
statement:
theorem selected_assembly (a : Fin k ↪ Fin n) (x : Cube k) :
    (coordinatesLinear a).symm (x, 0) = ∑ i, x i • Pi.single (a i) 1
proof:
:= by
  apply (coordinatesLinear a).injective
  simp only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, map_sum, map_smul, selected_single,
    Prod.smul_mk, smul_zero]
  apply Prod.ext
  · simp [Prod.fst_sum, ← Pi.single_smul, Finset.univ_sum_single]
  · simp [Prod.snd_sum]

name: Hellinger.PivotCoordinates.quotient_assembly
statement:
theorem quotient_assembly (a : Fin k ↪ Fin n) (b : Module.Basis (Fin k) F2 (Cube k))
    (L : Cube n →ₗ[F2] Cube k) (hb : ∀ i, b i = L (Pi.single (a i) 1)) (x : Cube k) :
    L ((coordinatesLinear a).symm (x, 0)) = b.equivFun.symm x
proof:
:= by
  rw [selected_assembly, map_sum, Module.Basis.equivFun_symm_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [map_smul, hb]

name: Hellinger.PivotCoordinates.quotient_coordinate_formula
statement:
theorem quotient_coordinate_formula (a : Fin k ↪ Fin n) (b : Module.Basis (Fin k) F2 (Cube k))
    (L : Cube n →ₗ[F2] Cube k) (hb : ∀ i, b i = L (Pi.single (a i) 1))
    (x : Cube k) (z : Remaining a → F2) :
    L ((coordinates a).symm (x, z)) = b.equivFun.symm (x + quotientShear a b L z)
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : (x, z) = (x, 0) + (0, z) := by simp
  change L ((coordinatesLinear a).symm (x, z)) = _
  rw [hsplit, map_add, map_add, quotient_assembly a b L hb x, map_add]
  congr 1
  exact (b.equivFun.symm_apply_apply (L (outsideLinear a z))).symm

name: Hellinger.Bhattacharyya.weighted_root
statement:
theorem weighted_root (q p m P M : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hm : 0 ≤ m)
    (hsum : p + m = 1) (hP : q * p = P / 2) (hM : q * m = M / 2) :
    q * root (p - m) = Real.sqrt (P * M)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : p - m ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hr : root (p - m) ^ 2 = 1 - (p - m) ^ 2 :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by nlinarith [ha.1, ha.2])
  have hprod := congrArg₂ (fun a b : ℝ => a * b) hP hM
  have hpm : 1 - (p - m) ^ 2 = 4 * p * m := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p + m - 1)]
  have hsquare : (q * root (p - m)) ^ 2 = P * M := by
    calc
      _ = q ^ 2 * (1 - (p - m) ^ 2) := by rw [mul_pow, hr]
      _ = 4 * (q * p) * (q * m) := by rw [hpm]; ring
      _ = P * M := by nlinarith [hprod]
  rw [← hsquare]
  exact (Real.sqrt_sq (show 0 ≤ q * root (p - m) from mul_nonneg hq (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))).symm

name: Hellinger.Bhattacharyya.discrete_parameter
statement:
theorem discrete_parameter {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace E]
    [Countable E] [MeasurableSingletonClass E] [Nonempty E]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (B : Ω → Bool) (Y : Ω → E)
    (hB : Measurable B) (hY : Measurable Y)
    (hfair : μ.map B = (PMF.uniformOfFintype Bool).toMeasure) :
    (∫ ω, root (μ[fun ω => boolSign (B ω) | MeasurableSpace.comap Y inferInstance] ω) ∂μ) =
      ∑' y, Real.sqrt ((condDistrib Y B μ false).real {y} *
        (condDistrib Y B μ true).real {y})
proof:
:= by
  let a := IndependentChannels.bias (condDistrib B Y μ)
  have ha : Measurable a := IndependentChannels.measurable_bias _
  have hr : Measurable (fun y => root (a y)) := by unfold root; fun_prop
  have hν : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map Y) := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hY.aemeasurable
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map Y) := hν
  have hint := ProductPosterior.integrable_of_abs_le (μ.map Y) _ hr 1
    (fun y => by rw [abs_of_nonneg (ProductPosterior.root_mem _).1]; exact (ProductPosterior.root_mem _).2)
  have hc := IndependentChannels.coordinate_condExp μ (fun _ : Unit => B) (fun _ : Unit => Y)
    (fun _ => hB) (fun _ => hY) ()
  have hpoint (y : E) : (μ.map Y).real {y} * root (a y) =
      Real.sqrt ((condDistrib Y B μ false).real {y} * (condDistrib Y B μ true).real {y}) := by
    apply weighted_root _ _ _ _ _ measureReal_nonneg measureReal_nonneg measureReal_nonneg
      (IndependentChannels.bool_masses (condDistrib B Y μ y))
    · convert DiscreteBayes.bayes_singleton μ B Y hB hY hfair y false using 1
      ring
    · convert DiscreteBayes.bayes_singleton μ B Y hB hY hfair y true using 1
      ring
  calc
    _ = ∫ ω, root (a (Y ω)) ∂μ := integral_congr_ae (hc.fun_comp root)
    _ = ∫ y, root (a y) ∂μ.map Y := (integral_map hY.aemeasurable hr.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
    _ = ∑' y, (μ.map Y).real {y} * root (a y) := by rw [integral_countable hint]; rfl
    _ = _ := tsum_congr hpoint

name: Hellinger.Bhattacharyya.discrete_channelParameter
statement:
theorem discrete_channelParameter {ι Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {E : ι → Type*} [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (E i)]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (B : ι → Ω → Bool) (Y : (i : ι) → Ω → E i)
    (hB : ∀ i, Measurable (B i)) (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i))
    (hfair : ∀ i, μ.map (B i) = (PMF.uniformOfFintype Bool).toMeasure)
    (i : ι) [Countable (E i)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (E i)] [Nonempty (E i)] :
    IndependentChannels.channelParameter μ B Y i =
      ∑' y, Real.sqrt ((condDistrib (Y i) (B i) μ false).real {y} *
        (condDistrib (Y i) (B i) μ true).real {y})
proof:
:=
  discrete_parameter μ (B i) (Y i) (hB i) (hY i) (hfair i)

name: Hellinger.PosteriorState.posteriorVector_unit
statement:
theorem posteriorVector_unit (K : UniformChannel Ω) (y : Ω) :
    posteriorVector K y ⬝ᵥ posteriorVector K y = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold posteriorVector dotProduct
  simp_rw [Real.mul_self_sqrt (K.nonneg y _)]
  exact K.row_sum y

name: Hellinger.PosteriorState.reflectedVector_unit
statement:
theorem reflectedVector_unit (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (y : Ω) :
    reflectedVector f (posteriorVector K y) ⬝ᵥ
      reflectedVector f (posteriorVector K y) = 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = posteriorVector K y ⬝ᵥ posteriorVector K y := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro x _
      rcases hf x with hx | hx <;> simp [reflectedVector, hx]
    _ = 1 := posteriorVector_unit K y

name: Hellinger.PosteriorState.posterior_inner
statement:
theorem posterior_inner (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (y : Ω) :
    posteriorVector K y ⬝ᵥ reflectedVector f (posteriorVector K y) = K.apply f y
proof:
:= by
  unfold dotProduct UniformChannel.apply
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  calc
    _ = f x * (Real.sqrt (K.weight y x) * Real.sqrt (K.weight y x)) := by
      unfold posteriorVector reflectedVector
      ring
    _ = K.weight y x * f x := by
      rw [Real.mul_self_sqrt (K.nonneg y x)]
      ring

name: Hellinger.PosteriorState.reflected_projection
statement:
theorem reflected_projection (f v : Ω → ℝ) :
    Matrix.vecMulVec (reflectedVector f v) (reflectedVector f v) =
      reflection f * Matrix.vecMulVec v v * reflection f
proof:
:= by
  ext x z
  rw [reflection, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul]
  simp only [Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, reflectedVector]
  ring

name: Hellinger.PosteriorState.average_difference
statement:
theorem average_difference (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    averageProjection K - reflection f * averageProjection K * reflection f =
      ∑ y, (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹ •
        pureDifference (posteriorVector K y) (reflectedVector f (posteriorVector K y))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [averageProjection, pureDifference, reflected_projection, Finset.smul_sum,
    Matrix.mul_sum, Matrix.sum_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, smul_sub,
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: Hellinger.PosteriorState.uniform_channel_lifting
statement:
theorem uniform_channel_lifting (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) :
    traceNorm (averageProjection K - reflection f * averageProjection K * reflection f) / 2 ≤
      mean (fun y => root (K.apply f y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [average_difference]
  have h := traceNorm_weighted_pureDifference_le
    (fun _ : Ω => (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹)
    (posteriorVector K) (fun y => reflectedVector f (posteriorVector K y))
    (fun _ => inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    (posteriorVector_unit K) (reflectedVector_unit K f hf)
  simp only [posterior_inner] at h
  have hs : (∑ y, (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹ *
      (2 * Real.sqrt (1 - K.apply f y ^ 2))) =
      2 * mean (fun y => root (K.apply f y)) := by
    unfold mean root
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro y _
    ring
  rw [hs] at h
  linarith

name: Hellinger.PosteriorState.bsc_sqrt_cross
statement:
theorem bsc_sqrt_cross (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    Real.sqrt ((1 + ρ) / 2) * Real.sqrt ((1 - ρ) / 2) = root ρ / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 ≤ (1 + ρ) / 2 := by linarith [hρ.1]
  rw [← Real.sqrt_mul hp]
  have heq : ((1 + ρ) / 2) * ((1 - ρ) / 2) = (1 - ρ ^ 2) / 4 := by ring
  rw [heq, Real.sqrt_div' _ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4)]
  norm_num [root]

name: Hellinger.PosteriorState.bsc_projection_sum
statement:
theorem bsc_projection_sum (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x z : Bool) :
    (∑ y : Bool, Real.sqrt ((bsc ρ hρ).weight y x) *
      Real.sqrt ((bsc ρ hρ).weight y z)) = if x = z then 1 else root ρ
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 ≤ (1 + ρ) / 2 := by linarith [hρ.1]
  have hm : 0 ≤ (1 - ρ) / 2 := by linarith [hρ.2]
  have hc := bsc_sqrt_cross ρ hρ
  cases x <;> cases z <;> rw [Fintype.sum_bool]
  · change Real.sqrt ((1 - ρ) / 2) * Real.sqrt ((1 - ρ) / 2) +
      Real.sqrt ((1 + ρ) / 2) * Real.sqrt ((1 + ρ) / 2) = 1
    rw [Real.mul_self_sqrt hm, Real.mul_self_sqrt hp]
    ring
  · change Real.sqrt ((1 - ρ) / 2) * Real.sqrt ((1 + ρ) / 2) +
      Real.sqrt ((1 + ρ) / 2) * Real.sqrt ((1 - ρ) / 2) = root ρ
    nlinarith [hc]
  · change Real.sqrt ((1 + ρ) / 2) * Real.sqrt ((1 - ρ) / 2) +
      Real.sqrt ((1 - ρ) / 2) * Real.sqrt ((1 + ρ) / 2) = root ρ
    nlinarith [hc]
  · change Real.sqrt ((1 + ρ) / 2) * Real.sqrt ((1 + ρ) / 2) +
      Real.sqrt ((1 - ρ) / 2) * Real.sqrt ((1 - ρ) / 2) = 1
    rw [Real.mul_self_sqrt hp, Real.mul_self_sqrt hm]
    ring

name: Hellinger.PosteriorState.cube_posterior_product
statement:
theorem cube_posterior_product (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (y x : ProductState.Cube n) :
    posteriorVector (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y x =
      ∏ i, Real.sqrt ((bsc ρ hρ).weight (y i) (x i))
proof:
:= by
  unfold posteriorVector cubeBSC UniformChannel.product
  exact Real.sqrt_prod Finset.univ (fun i _ => (bsc ρ hρ).nonneg (y i) (x i))

name: Hellinger.PosteriorState.cube_averageProjection
statement:
theorem cube_averageProjection (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    averageProjection (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) = ProductState.state n (root ρ)
proof:
:= by
  ext x z
  simp only [averageProjection, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply,
    smul_eq_mul]
  change (Fintype.card (ProductState.Cube n) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
    (∑ y, posteriorVector (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y x * posteriorVector (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y z) = _
  simp_rw [cube_posterior_product, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  rw [← Fintype.prod_sum (fun (i : Fin n) (y : Bool) =>
    Real.sqrt ((bsc ρ hρ).weight y (x i)) * Real.sqrt ((bsc ρ hρ).weight y (z i)))]
  simp_rw [bsc_projection_sum]
  simp only [ProductState.state, ProductState.oneQubit, Finset.prod_div_distrib,
    Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  simp [ProductState.Cube, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

name: Hellinger.PosteriorState.bsc_lifting
statement:
theorem bsc_lifting (n : ℕ) (f : ProductState.Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    traceNorm (ProductState.state n (root ρ) -
      reflection f * ProductState.state n (root ρ) * reflection f) / 2 ≤
      mean (fun y => root ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [cube_averageProjection] using uniform_channel_lifting (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) f hf

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.state_isHermitian
statement: theorem state_isHermitian (n : ℕ) (z : Fin n → ℝ) : (state n z).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  ext x y
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, star_trivial, state]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i _ => oneQubit_symmetric (z i) (y i) (x i))

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.state_const
statement: theorem state_const (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) : state n (fun _ => c) = ProductState.state n c
proof: := rfl

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.phaseMatrix_star
statement: theorem phaseMatrix_star {n : ℕ} (s : Cube n) : star (phaseMatrix s) = phaseMatrix s
proof:
:= by
  exact Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal (phase s)

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.phaseMatrix_sq
statement: theorem phaseMatrix_sq {n : ℕ} (s : Cube n) : phaseMatrix s * phaseMatrix s = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [phaseMatrix, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  have hs : (fun x => phase s x * phase s x) = (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) := by
    funext x
    simpa only [pow_two] using phase_sq s x
  rw [hs, Matrix.diagonal_one]

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.phaseConjugate_entry
statement:
theorem phaseConjugate_entry {n : ℕ} (s : Cube n) (A : Matrix (Cube n) (Cube n) ℝ)
    (x y : Cube n) : phaseConjugate s A x y = phase s x * A x y * phase s y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [phaseConjugate, phaseMatrix, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal]

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.phaseConjugate_eq
statement:
theorem phaseConjugate_eq {n : ℕ} (s : Cube n) (A : Matrix (Cube n) (Cube n) ℝ) :
    phaseConjugate s A = Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (phaseUnitary s) A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, phaseUnitary, phaseMatrix_star]
  rfl

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.phaseConjugate_isHermitian
statement:
theorem phaseConjugate_isHermitian {n : ℕ} (s : Cube n)
    {A : Matrix (Cube n) (Cube n) ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (phaseConjugate s A).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  ext x y
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, star_trivial, phaseConjugate_entry]
  have ha := congrFun (congrFun hA.eq x) y
  change A y x = A x y at ha
  rw [ha]
  ring

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.dephase_traceNorm_le
statement:
theorem dephase_traceNorm_le (n : ℕ) (η : Fin n → ℝ) (hη : ∀ i, η i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (A : Matrix (Cube n) (Cube n) ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    traceNorm (dephase n η hη A) ≤ traceNorm A
proof:
:= by
  have hp (s : Cube n) : 0 ≤ mixtureWeight n η hη s := (mixingChannel n η hη).nonneg _ _
  have hs : ∑ s, mixtureWeight n η hη s = 1 := (mixingChannel n η hη).row_sum _
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ s, traceNorm (mixtureWeight n η hη s • phaseConjugate s A) :=
      traceNorm_sum_le Finset.univ _ (fun s _ =>
        (phaseConjugate_isHermitian s hA).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg (hp s)))
    _ = ∑ s, mixtureWeight n η hη s * traceNorm A := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro s _
      rw [traceNorm_smul, abs_of_nonneg (hp s), phaseConjugate_eq, traceNorm_conjugate]
    _ = traceNorm A := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hs, one_mul]

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.bool_mixture_phase
statement:
theorem bool_mixture_phase (η : ℝ) (hη : η ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x y : Bool) :
    (∑ s : Bool, (bsc η hη).weight false s * boolSign (s && x) * boolSign (s && y)) =
      if x = y then 1 else η
proof:
:= by
  cases x <;> cases y <;> simp [bsc, boolSign] <;> ring

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.mixture_phase
statement:
theorem mixture_phase (n : ℕ) (η : Fin n → ℝ) (hη : ∀ i, η i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (x y : Cube n) :
    (∑ s, mixtureWeight n η hη s * phase s x * phase s y) =
      ∏ i, if x i = y i then 1 else η i
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∑ s : Cube n, ∏ i, (bsc (η i) (hη i)).weight false (s i) *
        boolSign (s i && x i) * boolSign (s i && y i) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro s _
      simp only [mixtureWeight, mixingChannel, UniformChannel.product, phase,
        Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    _ = ∏ i, ∑ s : Bool, (bsc (η i) (hη i)).weight false s *
        boolSign (s && x i) * boolSign (s && y i) :=
      (Fintype.prod_sum (fun (i : Fin n) (s : Bool) =>
        (bsc (η i) (hη i)).weight false s * boolSign (s && x i) * boolSign (s && y i))).symm
    _ = _ := by simp only [bool_mixture_phase]

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.dephase_entry
statement:
theorem dephase_entry (n : ℕ) (η : Fin n → ℝ) (hη : ∀ i, η i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (A : Matrix (Cube n) (Cube n) ℝ) (x y : Cube n) :
    dephase n η hη A x y = (∏ i, if x i = y i then 1 else η i) * A x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dephase, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, phaseConjugate_entry]
  rw [← mixture_phase n η hη x y, Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro s _
  ring

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.dephase_state
statement:
theorem dephase_state (n : ℕ) (η : Fin n → ℝ) (hη : ∀ i, η i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (z : Fin n → ℝ) : dephase n η hη (state n z) = state n (fun i => η i * z i)
proof:
:= by
  ext x y
  rw [dephase_entry]
  simp only [state, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases hxy : x i = y i <;> simp [oneQubit, hxy]
  ring

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.dephase_reflection
statement:
theorem dephase_reflection (n : ℕ) (η : Fin n → ℝ) (hη : ∀ i, η i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (f : Cube n → ℝ) (A : Matrix (Cube n) (Cube n) ℝ) :
    dephase n η hη (reflection f * A * reflection f) =
      reflection f * dephase n η hη A * reflection f
proof:
:= by
  ext x y
  simp only [dephase_entry, reflection, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  ring

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.dephase_sub
statement:
theorem dephase_sub (n : ℕ) (η : Fin n → ℝ) (hη : ∀ i, η i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (A B : Matrix (Cube n) (Cube n) ℝ) :
    dephase n η hη (A - B) = dephase n η hη A - dephase n η hη B
proof:
:= by
  ext x y
  simp only [dephase_entry, Matrix.sub_apply, mul_sub]

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.reflection_isHermitian
statement:
theorem reflection_isHermitian {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    {A : Matrix (Cube n) (Cube n) ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (reflection f * A * reflection f).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  ext x y
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, star_trivial, reflection, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  have ha := congrFun (congrFun hA.eq x) y
  change A y x = A x y at ha
  rw [ha]
  ring

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.antipodal_trace_lower_bound
statement:
theorem antipodal_trace_lower_bound (n : ℕ) (z : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hz : ∀ i, z i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hcz : ∀ i, c ≤ z i) (f : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hanti : ∀ x, f (antipode (n + 1) x) = -f x) :
    c ≤ traceNorm (state (n + 1) z - reflection f * state (n + 1) z * reflection f) / 2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hc0 : c = 0
  · rw [hc0]
    exact div_nonneg (traceNorm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
  have hcpos : 0 < c := lt_of_le_of_ne hc.1 (Ne.symm hc0)
  have hzpos (i : Fin (n + 1)) : 0 < z i := hcpos.trans_le (hcz i)
  let η : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ := fun i => c / z i
  have hη (i : Fin (n + 1)) : η i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
    ⟨div_nonneg hc.1 (hz i).1, (div_le_one (hzpos i)).mpr (hcz i)⟩
  have hηz : (fun i => η i * z i) = (fun _ => c) := by
    funext i
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ c (ne_of_gt (hzpos i))
  have hmap : dephase (n + 1) η hη (state (n + 1) z) = ProductState.state (n + 1) c := by
    rw [dephase_state, hηz, state_const]
  have hcontract := dephase_traceNorm_le (n + 1) η hη
    (state (n + 1) z - reflection f * state (n + 1) z * reflection f)
    ((state_isHermitian _ _).sub (reflection_isHermitian f (state_isHermitian _ _)))
  rw [dephase_sub, dephase_reflection, hmap] at hcontract
  have hbase := ParityBlocks.antipodal_trace_lower_bound n c hc f hf hanti
  change c ≤ traceNorm (ProductState.state (n + 1) c -
    reflection f * ProductState.state (n + 1) c * reflection f) / 2 at hbase
  linarith

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.traceNorm_eq_trace_sqrt
statement:
theorem traceNorm_eq_trace_sqrt (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    traceNorm A = (CFC.sqrt (A.conjTranspose * A)).trace.re
proof: := rfl

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.realTrace_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem realTrace_add (A B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    realTrace (A + B) = realTrace A + realTrace B
proof: := by simp [realTrace]

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.realTrace_sub
statement:
@[simp] theorem realTrace_sub (A B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    realTrace (A - B) = realTrace A - realTrace B
proof: := by simp [realTrace]

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.realTrace_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem realTrace_neg (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) : realTrace (-A) = -realTrace A
proof:
:= by
  simp [realTrace]

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.realTrace_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem realTrace_smul (r : ℝ) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    realTrace (r • A) = r * realTrace A
proof: := by simp [realTrace]

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.realTrace_mul_comm
statement: theorem realTrace_mul_comm (A B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) : realTrace (A * B) = realTrace (B * A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [realTrace, realTrace, trace_mul_comm]

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.realTrace_conjugate
statement:
theorem realTrace_conjugate (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    realTrace (conjStarAlgAut ℂ _ U A) = realTrace A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [realTrace, conjStarAlgAut_apply, trace_mul_cycle, coe_star_mul_self, one_mul]

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.realTrace_cfc
statement:
theorem realTrace_cfc {A : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    realTrace (cfc f A) = ∑ i, f (hA.eigenvalues i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hA.cfc_eq, Matrix.IsHermitian.cfc, realTrace_conjugate]
  simp [realTrace, trace_diagonal]

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.traceNorm_eq_sum_abs_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem traceNorm_eq_sum_abs_eigenvalues {A : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    traceNorm A = ∑ i, |hA.eigenvalues i|
proof:
:= by
  rw [traceNorm, CFC.abs_eq_cfc_norm A hA, realTrace_cfc hA]
  simp [Real.norm_eq_abs]

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.realTrace_nonneg
statement: theorem realTrace_nonneg {A : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) : 0 ≤ realTrace A
proof:
:= by
  exact (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp hA.trace_nonneg).1

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.traceNorm_nonneg
statement: theorem traceNorm_nonneg (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) : 0 ≤ traceNorm A
proof:
:=
  realTrace_nonneg (CFC.abs_nonneg A).posSemidef

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.norm_conjugate
statement:
theorem norm_conjugate (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    ‖conjStarAlgAut ℂ _ U A‖ = ‖A‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [conjStarAlgAut_apply, ← Unitary.coe_star, CStarRing.norm_mul_coe_unitary, CStarRing.norm_coe_unitary_mul]

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.norm_entry_le
statement: theorem norm_entry_le (Q : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (i j : ι) : ‖Q i j‖ ≤ ‖Q‖
proof:
:= by
  let e : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι := PiLp.single 2 j 1
  have h := Matrix.l2_opNorm_mulVec Q e
  have he : ‖e‖ = 1 := by simp [e]
  have hc := PiLp.norm_apply_le (toLp 2 (Q *ᵥ ofLp e)) i
  have hei : (Q *ᵥ ofLp e) i = Q i j := by simp [e, mulVec, dotProduct]
  rw [he, mul_one] at h
  change ‖(Q *ᵥ ofLp e) i‖ ≤ ‖toLp 2 (Q *ᵥ ofLp e)‖ at hc
  rw [hei] at hc
  exact hc.trans h

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.realTrace_mul_le_traceNorm
statement:
theorem realTrace_mul_le_traceNorm {A Q : Matrix ι ι ℂ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hQ : ‖Q‖ ≤ 1) : realTrace (Q * A) ≤ traceNorm A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← realTrace_conjugate (star hA.eigenvectorUnitary) (Q * A), map_mul,
    hA.conjStarAlgAut_star_eigenvectorUnitary, traceNorm_eq_sum_abs_eigenvalues hA]
  simp only [realTrace, trace, diag_apply, mul_diagonal, Function.comp_apply, Complex.re_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  change (_ * (hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ)).re ≤ |hA.eigenvalues i|
  simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, mul_zero, sub_zero]
  have hb : |(conjStarAlgAut ℂ _ (star hA.eigenvectorUnitary) Q i i).re| ≤ 1 := by
    exact (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans ((norm_entry_le _ i i).trans (by rwa [norm_conjugate]))
  calc
    _ ≤ |(conjStarAlgAut ℂ _ (star hA.eigenvectorUnitary) Q i i).re * hA.eigenvalues i| :=
      le_abs_self _
    _ = |(conjStarAlgAut ℂ _ (star hA.eigenvectorUnitary) Q i i).re| * |hA.eigenvalues i| :=
      abs_mul _ _
    _ ≤ 1 * |hA.eigenvalues i| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb (abs_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := one_mul _

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.signWitness_isHermitian
statement: theorem signWitness_isHermitian (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) : (signWitness A).IsHermitian
proof:
:=
  IsSelfAdjoint.cfc

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.signWitness_norm_le
statement: theorem signWitness_norm_le (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) : ‖signWitness A‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply norm_cfc_le zero_le_one
  intro x _
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  exact abs_le.mpr (TraceNorm.scalarSign_bounds x)

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.signWitness_attains
statement:
theorem signWitness_attains {A : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    realTrace (signWitness A * A) = traceNorm A
proof:
:= by
  rw [signWitness, hA.cfc_eq, Matrix.IsHermitian.cfc]
  calc
    _ = realTrace (conjStarAlgAut ℂ _ hA.eigenvectorUnitary
      (diagonal (fun i => (TraceNorm.scalarSign (hA.eigenvalues i) : ℂ))) *
      conjStarAlgAut ℂ _ hA.eigenvectorUnitary
        (diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ hA.eigenvalues))) := by
          congr 1
          exact congrArg (fun X => _ * X) hA.spectral_theorem
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← map_mul, realTrace_conjugate, diagonal_mul_diagonal,
        traceNorm_eq_sum_abs_eigenvalues hA]
      simp [realTrace, trace_diagonal, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, TraceNorm.scalarSign_mul]

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.reflection_conjugate_twice
statement:
theorem reflection_conjugate_twice {F : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hF : F * F = 1)
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) : F * (F * A * F) * F = A
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (F * F) * A * (F * F) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hF, one_mul, mul_one]

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.reflection_conjugate_isHermitian
statement:
theorem reflection_conjugate_isHermitian {F A : Matrix ι ι ℂ}
    (hF : F.IsHermitian) (hA : A.IsHermitian) : (F * A * F).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  change (F * A * F).conjTranspose = _
  simp only [conjTranspose_mul, hF.eq, hA.eq, mul_assoc]

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.norm_reflection_conjugate
proof:
:= by
  let U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ := ⟨F, Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff.mpr (by
    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, hF.eq] using hFsq)⟩
  have hc : conjStarAlgAut ℂ _ U A = F * A * F := by
    change F * A * F.conjTranspose = F * A * F
    rw [hF.eq]
  rw [← hc, norm_conjugate]

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.realTrace_reflection_move
statement:
theorem realTrace_reflection_move (F A B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    realTrace (F * A * F * B) = realTrace (A * (F * B * F))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = realTrace (F * (A * F * B)) := by congr 1; noncomm_ring
    _ = realTrace ((A * F * B) * F) := realTrace_mul_comm _ _
    _ = _ := by congr 1; noncomm_ring

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.anticommuting_trace_identity
proof:
:= by
  have hm : realTrace (Q * (F * K * F)) = -realTrace (Q * K) := by
    rw [← realTrace_reflection_move, hQ, neg_mul, realTrace_neg]
  rw [mul_sub, realTrace_sub, hm, realTrace_mul_comm Q K]
  ring

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.exists_anticommuting_trace_witness
statement:
theorem exists_anticommuting_trace_witness {K F : Matrix ι ι ℂ}
    (hK : K.IsHermitian) (hF : F.IsHermitian) (hFsq : F * F = 1) :
    ∃ Q : Matrix ι ι ℂ, Q.IsHermitian ∧ ‖Q‖ ≤ 1 ∧ F * Q * F = -Q ∧
      realTrace (K * Q) = traceNorm (K - F * K * F) / 2
proof:
:= by
  let H := K - F * K * F
  have hH : H.IsHermitian := hK.sub (reflection_conjugate_isHermitian hF hK)
  let S := signWitness H
  let Q := (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (S - F * S * F)
  have hQH : Q.IsHermitian := ((signWitness_isHermitian H).sub
    (reflection_conjugate_isHermitian hF (signWitness_isHermitian H))).smul
      (IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 by norm_num))
  have hQ : ‖Q‖ ≤ 1 := by
    have hs : ‖S‖ ≤ 1 := signWitness_norm_le H
    have h := norm_sub_le S (F * S * F)
    rw [norm_reflection_conjugate hF hFsq] at h
    simp only [Q, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)]
    linarith
  have ha : F * Q * F = -Q := by
    dsimp only [Q]
    simp only [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, mul_sub, sub_mul]
    rw [reflection_conjugate_twice hFsq]
    module
  refine ⟨Q, hQH, hQ, ha, ?_⟩
  have hHanti : F * H * F = -H := by
    dsimp only [H]
    simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul]
    rw [reflection_conjugate_twice hFsq]
    abel
  have hSH : realTrace (S * H) = traceNorm H := signWitness_attains hH
  have hQH : realTrace (Q * H) = traceNorm H := by
    dsimp only [Q]
    rw [smul_mul_assoc, realTrace_smul, sub_mul, realTrace_sub, realTrace_reflection_move,
      hHanti, mul_neg, realTrace_neg, hSH]
    ring
  have hi := anticommuting_trace_identity ha K
  change realTrace (Q * H) = 2 * realTrace (K * Q) at hi
  change realTrace (K * Q) = traceNorm H / 2
  linarith

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.anticommuting_trace_maximum
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨Q, hQH, hn, ha, ht⟩ := exists_anticommuting_trace_witness hK hF hFsq
    exact ⟨Q, hQH, hn, ha, ht.symm⟩
  · rintro t ⟨Q, _, hn, ha, rfl⟩
    have h := realTrace_mul_le_traceNorm (hK.sub (reflection_conjugate_isHermitian hF hK)) hn
    rw [anticommuting_trace_identity ha] at h
    linarith

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.norm_toLp_sq
statement: theorem norm_toLp_sq (v : ι → ℂ) : ‖toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2 = (star v ⬝ᵥ v).re
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp, dotProduct_comm, RCLike.re_to_complex] using
    (norm_sq_eq_re_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) (toLp 2 v))

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.hermitian_norm_mulVec_sq
statement:
theorem hermitian_norm_mulVec_sq {A : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    ‖toLp 2 (A *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2 = (star v ⬝ᵥ (A * A) *ᵥ v).re
proof:
:= by
  have hs : star v ᵥ* A = star (A *ᵥ v) := by
    rw [star_mulVec, hA.eq]
  rw [← mulVec_mulVec, dotProduct_mulVec (star v) A (A *ᵥ v), hs, norm_toLp_sq]

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.reflection_anticommutes
statement:
theorem reflection_anticommutes {F Q : Matrix ι ι ℂ}
    (hFsq : F * F = 1) (ha : F * Q * F = -Q) : F * Q = -(Q * F)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun A => A * F) ha
  simpa only [mul_assoc, hFsq, mul_one, neg_mul] using h

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.anticommuting_uncertainty
statement:
theorem anticommuting_uncertainty {F Q : Matrix ι ι ℂ}
    (hF : F.IsHermitian) (hFsq : F * F = 1) (hQ : Q.IsHermitian) (hn : ‖Q‖ ≤ 1)
    (ha : F * Q * F = -Q) (ψ : ι → ℂ) (hψ : ‖toLp 2 ψ‖ = 1) :
    (star ψ ⬝ᵥ F *ᵥ ψ).re ^ 2 + (star ψ ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ ψ).re ^ 2 ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  let a := (star ψ ⬝ᵥ F *ᵥ ψ).re
  let b := (star ψ ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ ψ).re
  let A := a • F + b • Q
  have hAH : A.IsHermitian := (hF.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial a))).add
    (hQ.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial b)))
  have hA2 : A * A = a ^ 2 • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℂ) + b ^ 2 • (Q * Q) := by
    simp only [A, add_mul, mul_add, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm,
      hFsq, reflection_anticommutes hFsq ha]
    module
  have hself : (star ψ ⬝ᵥ ψ).re = 1 := by rw [← norm_toLp_sq, hψ, one_pow]
  have hQψ : ‖toLp 2 (Q *ᵥ ψ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    have h := Matrix.l2_opNorm_mulVec Q (toLp 2 ψ)
    rw [hψ, mul_one] at h
    exact h.trans hn
  have hQQ : (star ψ ⬝ᵥ (Q * Q) *ᵥ ψ).re ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← hermitian_norm_mulVec_sq hQ]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (toLp 2 (Q *ᵥ ψ))]
  have hAψ : ‖toLp 2 (A *ᵥ ψ)‖ ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
    rw [hermitian_norm_mulVec_sq hAH, hA2]
    simp only [add_mulVec, smul_mulVec, one_mulVec, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul,
      Complex.add_re, Complex.real_smul, Complex.re_ofReal_mul, hself, mul_one]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg b]
  have hinner : (star ψ ⬝ᵥ A *ᵥ ψ).re = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
    simp only [A, add_mulVec, smul_mulVec, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul,
      Complex.add_re, Complex.real_smul, Complex.re_ofReal_mul]
    change a * a + b * b = _
    ring
  have hcs := re_inner_le_norm (𝕜 := ℂ) (toLp 2 ψ) (toLp 2 (A *ᵥ ψ))
  simp only [EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp, dotProduct_comm, RCLike.re_to_complex, hψ, one_mul] at hcs
  rw [hinner] at hcs
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := add_nonneg (sq_nonneg a) (sq_nonneg b)
  have hsq : (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (toLp 2 (A *ᵥ ψ))]
  change a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 ≤ 1
  nlinarith

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.operator_norm_eq
statement:
theorem operator_norm_eq (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    ‖A‖ = ‖Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℂ) (n := ι) A‖
proof: := rfl

name: Hellinger.ComplexSpectral.realTrace_hermitian_product
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.conj_eq_iff_re.mp
  change star (K * Q).trace = (K * Q).trace
  rw [← trace_conjTranspose, conjTranspose_mul, hQ.eq, hK.eq, trace_mul_comm]

name: Hellinger.AllBent.bent_hellinger
statement:
theorem bent_hellinger (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) ≤ 1 - root ρ ∧
      (0 < ρ → objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) < 1 - root ρ)
proof:
:= by
  have heven := Flatness.dimension_even hf hb
  by_cases hn2 : n = 2
  · subst n
    exact ⟨BentSmall.bent_two_hellinger f hf hb ρ hρ,
      fun hp => BentSmall.bent_two_hellinger_strict f hf hb ρ hρ hp⟩
  · by_cases hn4 : n = 4
    · subst n
      exact BentFourFinal.bent_four_hellinger f hf hb ρ hρ
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := heven
      have hn6 : 6 ≤ n := by omega
      exact BentLow.bent_large_hellinger hn6 hf hb ρ hρ

name: Hellinger.AllBent.paper_bent_hellinger
statement: theorem paper_bent_hellinger : PaperSpecs.BentHellinger
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn f hf hb ρ hρ
  exact bent_hellinger n hn f hf hb ρ hρ

name: Hellinger.IntegralLifting.matrixIntegral_isHermitian
statement:
theorem matrixIntegral_isHermitian (μ : Measure Ω) (A : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ y, (A y).IsHermitian) : (matrixIntegral μ A).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  change (∫ y, A y j i ∂μ) = ∫ y, A y i j ∂μ
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with y
  have h := congrFun (congrFun (hA y).eq i) j
  exact h

name: Hellinger.IntegralLifting.matrixIntegral_sub
statement:
theorem matrixIntegral_sub (μ : Measure Ω) (A B : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun y => A y i j) μ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun y => B y i j) μ) :
    matrixIntegral μ (fun y => A y - B y) = matrixIntegral μ A - matrixIntegral μ B
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  exact integral_sub (hA i j) (hB i j)

name: Hellinger.IntegralLifting.matrixIntegral_reflection
statement:
theorem matrixIntegral_reflection (μ : Measure Ω) (A : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ) (f : ι → ℝ) :
    matrixIntegral μ (fun y => reflection f * A y * reflection f) =
      reflection f * matrixIntegral μ A * reflection f
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [matrixIntegral, reflection, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal,
    integral_mul_const, integral_const_mul]

name: Hellinger.IntegralLifting.trace_mul_integrable
statement:
theorem trace_mul_integrable (μ : Measure Ω) (A : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun y => A y i j) μ) (Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun y => (Q * A y).trace) μ
proof:
:= by
  unfold Matrix.trace
  apply integrable_finsetSum
  intro i _
  simp only [Matrix.diag_apply, Matrix.mul_apply]
  apply integrable_finsetSum
  intro j _
  exact (hA j i).const_mul (Q i j)

name: Hellinger.IntegralLifting.trace_mul_matrixIntegral
statement:
theorem trace_mul_matrixIntegral (μ : Measure Ω) (A : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun y => A y i j) μ) (Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    (Q * matrixIntegral μ A).trace = ∫ y, (Q * A y).trace ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  symm
  unfold Matrix.trace
  rw [integral_finsetSum Finset.univ]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    simp only [Matrix.diag_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, matrixIntegral]
    rw [integral_finsetSum Finset.univ]
    · simp only [integral_const_mul]
    · intro j _
      exact (hA j i).const_mul (Q i j)
  · intro i _
    simp only [Matrix.diag_apply, Matrix.mul_apply]
    apply integrable_finsetSum
    intro j _
    exact (hA j i).const_mul (Q i j)

name: Hellinger.IntegralLifting.traceNorm_matrixIntegral_le
statement:
theorem traceNorm_matrixIntegral_le (μ : Measure Ω) (A : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun y => A y i j) μ)
    (hAH : ∀ y, (A y).IsHermitian) (g : Ω → ℝ) (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hbound : ∀ y, traceNorm (A y) ≤ g y) :
    traceNorm (matrixIntegral μ A) ≤ ∫ y, g y ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  let Q := signWitness (matrixIntegral_isHermitian μ A hAH)
  rw [← signWitness_attains (matrixIntegral_isHermitian μ A hAH), trace_mul_matrixIntegral μ A hA]
  apply integral_mono (trace_mul_integrable μ A hA Q) hg
  intro y
  exact (trace_mul_le_traceNorm (hAH y) (signWitness_orderContraction _)).trans (hbound y)

name: Hellinger.IntegralLifting.integral_pure_lifting
statement:
theorem integral_pure_lifting (μ : Measure Ω) (v w : Ω → ι → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ y, v y ⬝ᵥ v y = 1) (hw : ∀ y, w y ⬝ᵥ w y = 1)
    (hentry : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun y => pureDifference (v y) (w y) i j) μ)
    (hroot : Integrable (fun y => root (v y ⬝ᵥ w y)) μ) :
    traceNorm (matrixIntegral μ (fun y => pureDifference (v y) (w y))) / 2 ≤
      ∫ y, root (v y ⬝ᵥ w y) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have h := traceNorm_matrixIntegral_le μ (fun y => pureDifference (v y) (w y)) hentry
    (fun y => pureDifference_isHermitian (v y) (w y))
    (fun y => 2 * root (v y ⬝ᵥ w y)) (hroot.const_mul 2)
    (fun y => le_of_eq (traceNorm_pureDifference _ _ (hv y) (hw y)))
  rw [integral_const_mul] at h
  linarith

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_eq_trace_sqrt
statement:
theorem traceNorm_eq_trace_sqrt (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    traceNorm A = (CFC.sqrt (A.transpose * A)).trace
proof:
:= by
  simp only [traceNorm, CFC.abs, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_nonneg
statement: theorem traceNorm_nonneg (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) : 0 ≤ traceNorm A
proof:
:=
  (CFC.abs_nonneg A).posSemidef.trace_nonneg

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem traceNorm_zero : traceNorm (0 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [traceNorm]

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem traceNorm_neg (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) : traceNorm (-A) = traceNorm A
proof:
:= by
  simp [traceNorm]

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_smul
statement:
theorem traceNorm_smul (r : ℝ) (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    traceNorm (r • A) = |r| * traceNorm A
proof:
:= by
  simp [traceNorm, CFC.abs_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem traceNorm_of_posSemidef (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    traceNorm A = A.trace
proof:
:= by
  rw [traceNorm, CFC.abs_of_nonneg A hA.nonneg]

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.trace_conjugate
statement:
theorem trace_conjugate (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℝ) (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    (conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U A).trace = A.trace
proof:
:= by
  simp only [conjStarAlgAut_apply, trace_mul_cycle, coe_star_mul_self, one_mul]

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.trace_cfc
statement:
theorem trace_cfc {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (cfc f A).trace = ∑ i, f (hA.eigenvalues i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hA.cfc_eq, Matrix.IsHermitian.cfc, trace_conjugate, trace_diagonal]
  rfl

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_eq_sum_abs_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem traceNorm_eq_sum_abs_eigenvalues {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    traceNorm A = ∑ i, |hA.eigenvalues i|
proof:
:= by
  rw [traceNorm, CFC.abs_eq_cfc_norm A hA, trace_cfc hA]
  simp [Real.norm_eq_abs]

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.posSemidef_conjugate
statement:
theorem posSemidef_conjugate (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℝ)
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    (conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U A).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [conjStarAlgAut_apply, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using
    hA.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same (U : Matrix ι ι ℝ)

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.abs_conjugate
statement:
theorem abs_conjugate (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℝ) (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    CFC.abs (conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U A) = conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U (CFC.abs A)
proof:
:= by
  change CFC.sqrt (star (conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U A) * conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U A) = _
  apply CFC.sqrt_unique
  · rw [← map_mul, CFC.abs_mul_abs, map_mul, map_star]
  · exact (posSemidef_conjugate U (CFC.abs_nonneg A).posSemidef).nonneg

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_conjugate
statement:
theorem traceNorm_conjugate (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℝ) (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    traceNorm (conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U A) = traceNorm A
proof:
:= by
  rw [traceNorm, abs_conjugate, trace_conjugate]
  rfl

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem traceNorm_eq_zero_iff (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) : traceNorm A = 0 ↔ A = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [traceNorm, (CFC.abs_nonneg A).posSemidef.trace_eq_zero_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply Matrix.conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_zero.mp
    have hs := CFC.abs_mul_abs A
    simpa only [h, zero_mul, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using hs.symm
  · rintro rfl
    exact CFC.abs_zero

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.OrderContraction.conjugate
statement:
theorem OrderContraction.conjugate {Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hQ : OrderContraction Q)
    (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℝ) : OrderContraction (conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U Q)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simpa only [map_sub, map_one] using posSemidef_conjugate U hQ.1
  · simpa only [map_add, map_one] using posSemidef_conjugate U hQ.2

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.OrderContraction.diagonal_abs_le
statement:
theorem OrderContraction.diagonal_abs_le {Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hQ : OrderContraction Q) (i : ι) : |Q i i| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := hQ.1.diag_nonneg (i := i)
  have h₂ := hQ.2.diag_nonneg (i := i)
  simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.add_apply, one_apply_eq] at h₁ h₂
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.trace_mul_le_traceNorm
proof:
:= by
  rw [← trace_conjugate (star hA.eigenvectorUnitary) (Q * A), map_mul,
    hA.conjStarAlgAut_star_eigenvectorUnitary, traceNorm_eq_sum_abs_eigenvalues hA]
  simp only [trace, diag_apply, mul_diagonal, Function.comp_apply, RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id_eq]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  calc
    _ ≤ |(conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (star hA.eigenvectorUnitary) Q) i i * hA.eigenvalues i| :=
      le_abs_self _
    _ = |(conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (star hA.eigenvectorUnitary) Q) i i| * |hA.eigenvalues i| :=
      abs_mul _ _
    _ ≤ 1 * |hA.eigenvalues i| :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ((hQ.conjugate _).diagonal_abs_le i) (abs_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := one_mul _

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.scalarSign_bounds
statement: theorem scalarSign_bounds (x : ℝ) : -1 ≤ scalarSign x ∧ scalarSign x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold scalarSign
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.scalarSign_mul
statement: theorem scalarSign_mul (x : ℝ) : scalarSign x * x = |x|
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x < 0
  · simp [scalarSign, hx, abs_of_neg hx]
  · by_cases hz : x = 0
    · simp [scalarSign, hz]
    · simp [scalarSign, hx, hz, abs_of_nonneg (le_of_not_gt hx)]

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.signWitness_orderContraction
statement:
theorem signWitness_orderContraction {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    OrderContraction (signWitness hA)
proof:
:= by
  apply OrderContraction.conjugate
  constructor
  · rw [← diagonal_one, diagonal_sub]
    exact .diagonal fun i => sub_nonneg.mpr (scalarSign_bounds _).2
  · rw [← diagonal_one, diagonal_add]
    exact .diagonal fun i => by dsimp; linarith [(scalarSign_bounds (hA.eigenvalues i)).1]

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.signWitness_attains
statement:
theorem signWitness_attains {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (signWitness hA * A).trace = traceNorm A
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (signWitness hA * conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ hA.eigenvectorUnitary
        (diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ hA.eigenvalues))).trace :=
      congrArg (fun X => (signWitness hA * X).trace) hA.spectral_theorem
    _ = _ := by
      rw [signWitness, ← map_mul, trace_conjugate, diagonal_mul_diagonal, trace_diagonal,
        traceNorm_eq_sum_abs_eigenvalues hA]
      simp [scalarSign_mul]

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_add_le
statement:
theorem traceNorm_add_le {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    traceNorm (A + B) ≤ traceNorm A + traceNorm B
proof:
:= by
  rw [← signWitness_attains (hA.add hB), mul_add, trace_add]
  exact add_le_add (trace_mul_le_traceNorm hA (signWitness_orderContraction _))
    (trace_mul_le_traceNorm hB (signWitness_orderContraction _))

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_sum_le
statement:
theorem traceNorm_sum_le {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (A : α → Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ i ∈ s, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    traceNorm (∑ i ∈ s, A i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, traceNorm (A i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi]
    have hs : (∑ j ∈ s, A j).IsHermitian :=
      isSelfAdjoint_sum s (fun j hj => hA j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj))
    exact (traceNorm_add_le (A := A i) (B := ∑ j ∈ s, A j)
      (hA i (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)) hs).trans
      (add_le_add (le_refl _) (ih (fun j hj => hA j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj))))

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.posSemidef_blockDiagonal
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg
    (hA.isHermitian.fromBlocks (by simp) hB.isHermitian)
  intro x
  have h₁ := hA.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (x ∘ Sum.inl)
  have h₂ := hB.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (x ∘ Sum.inr)
  simpa [Matrix.fromBlocks_mulVec, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type] using add_nonneg h₁ h₂

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.trace_blockDiagonal
statement:
theorem trace_blockDiagonal (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (B : Matrix κ κ ℝ) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B).trace = A.trace + B.trace
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Fintype.sum_sum_type]

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.sqrt_blockDiagonal
statement:
theorem sqrt_blockDiagonal {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {B : Matrix κ κ ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
    CFC.sqrt (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (CFC.sqrt A) 0 0 (CFC.sqrt B)
proof:
:= by
  apply CFC.sqrt_unique
  · simp only [fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add]
    rw [CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self A hA.nonneg, CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self B hB.nonneg]
  · exact (posSemidef_blockDiagonal (CFC.sqrt_nonneg A).posSemidef
      (CFC.sqrt_nonneg B).posSemidef).nonneg

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.abs_blockDiagonal
statement:
theorem abs_blockDiagonal (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (B : Matrix κ κ ℝ) :
    CFC.abs (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (CFC.abs A) 0 0 (CFC.abs B)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [CFC.abs, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, fromBlocks_conjTranspose,
    conjTranspose_zero, fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add]
  exact sqrt_blockDiagonal (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self A)
    (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self B)

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_blockDiagonal
statement:
theorem traceNorm_blockDiagonal (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (B : Matrix κ κ ℝ) :
    traceNorm (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B) = traceNorm A + traceNorm B
proof:
:= by
  rw [traceNorm, abs_blockDiagonal, trace_blockDiagonal]
  rfl

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_paired_difference
statement:
theorem traceNorm_paired_difference (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℝ)
    (A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    traceNorm (Matrix.fromBlocks (A - conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U B) 0 0
      (B - conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (star U) A)) =
      2 * traceNorm (A - conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U B)
proof:
:= by
  have hsecond : B - conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (star U) A =
      -conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (star U) (A - conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U B) := by
    rw [map_sub, ← conjStarAlgAut_mul_apply]
    simp
  rw [traceNorm_blockDiagonal, hsecond, traceNorm_neg, traceNorm_conjugate]
  ring

name: Hellinger.ProductState.oneQubit_symmetric
statement:
theorem oneQubit_symmetric (c : ℝ) (x z : Bool) :
    oneQubit c x z = oneQubit c z x
proof:
:= by
  simp [oneQubit, eq_comm]

name: Hellinger.ProductState.state_isHermitian
statement: theorem state_isHermitian (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) : (state n c).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  ext x z
  simp only [conjTranspose_apply, star_trivial, state]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => oneQubit_symmetric c (z i) (x i)

name: Hellinger.ProductState.oneQubit_apply_one
statement:
theorem oneQubit_apply_one (c : ℝ) (x : Bool) :
    (oneQubit c *ᵥ (fun _ => 1)) x = (1 + c) / 2
proof:
:= by
  cases x <;> simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, oneQubit] <;> ring

name: Hellinger.ProductState.oneQubit_apply_sign
statement:
theorem oneQubit_apply_sign (c : ℝ) (x : Bool) :
    (oneQubit c *ᵥ boolSign) x = (1 - c) / 2 * boolSign x
proof:
:= by
  cases x <;> simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, oneQubit, boolSign] <;> ring

name: Hellinger.ProductState.state_apply_product
statement:
theorem state_apply_product (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (f : Fin n → Bool → ℝ) (x : Cube n) :
    (state n c *ᵥ (fun z => ∏ i, f i (z i))) x =
      ∏ i, (oneQubit c *ᵥ f i) (x i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, state]
  simp_rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  exact (Fintype.prod_sum (fun i z => oneQubit c (x i) z * f i z)).symm

name: Hellinger.ProductState.product_two_levels
statement:
theorem product_two_levels (n : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (a b : ℝ) :
    (∏ i : Fin n, if i ∈ S then b else a) = a ^ (n - S.card) * b ^ S.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.prod_ite]
  simp only [Finset.prod_const, Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.univ_inter]
  have hfilter : (Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin n => i ∉ S) = Finset.univ \ S := by
    ext i
    simp
  rw [hfilter, Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset (Finset.subset_univ S)]
  simp [mul_comm]

name: Hellinger.ProductState.state_character
statement:
theorem state_character (n : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (c : ℝ) (x : Cube n) :
    (state n c *ᵥ character n S) x =
      ((1 + c) / 2) ^ (n - S.card) * ((1 - c) / 2) ^ S.card * character n S x
proof:
:= by
  unfold character
  rw [state_apply_product n c (fun i z => if i ∈ S then boolSign z else 1) x]
  have hfactor (i : Fin n) :
      (oneQubit c *ᵥ (fun z => if i ∈ S then boolSign z else 1)) (x i) =
        (if i ∈ S then (1 - c) / 2 else (1 + c) / 2) *
        (if i ∈ S then boolSign (x i) else 1) := by
    by_cases hi : i ∈ S
    · simp only [hi, if_true, oneQubit_apply_sign]
    · simp only [hi, if_false, oneQubit_apply_one, mul_one]
  simp_rw [hfactor]
  rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, product_two_levels]

name: Hellinger.ProductState.state_entry
statement:
theorem state_entry (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (x z : Cube n) :
    state n c x z = c ^ hammingDistance n x z / (2 : ℝ) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [state, oneQubit, Finset.prod_div_distrib, Finset.prod_const,
    Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  congr 1
  rw [Finset.prod_ite]
  simp [hammingDistance]

name: Hellinger.ProductState.antipodalMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem antipodalMatrix_apply (n : ℕ) (v : Cube n → ℝ) (x : Cube n) :
    (antipodalMatrix n *ᵥ v) x = v (antipode n x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [antipodalMatrix, Matrix.permMatrix_mulVec]

name: Hellinger.ProductState.character_antipode
statement:
theorem character_antipode (n : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (x : Cube n) :
    character n S (antipode n x) = (-1 : ℝ) ^ S.card * character n S x
proof:
:= by
  unfold character
  have hfactor (i : Fin n) :
      (if i ∈ S then boolSign ((antipode n x) i) else 1) =
        (if i ∈ S then (-1 : ℝ) else 1) * (if i ∈ S then boolSign (x i) else 1) := by
    by_cases hi : i ∈ S
    · simp [hi, antipode, boolSign_neg]
    · simp [hi]
  simp_rw [hfactor]
  rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  simp

name: Hellinger.ProductState.antipodalMatrix_character
statement:
theorem antipodalMatrix_character (n : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (x : Cube n) :
    (antipodalMatrix n *ᵥ character n S) x = (-1 : ℝ) ^ S.card * character n S x
proof:
:= by
  rw [antipodalMatrix_apply, character_antipode]

name: Hellinger.ProductState.normalization_square
statement: theorem normalization_square (n : ℕ) : normalization n ^ 2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ n = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalization, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), inv_mul_cancel₀]
  positivity

name: Hellinger.ProductState.hadamard_transpose
statement: theorem hadamard_transpose (n : ℕ) : (hadamard n).transpose = hadamard n
proof:
:= by
  ext x s
  exact congrArg (normalization n * ·) (Fourier.phase_symm x s)

name: Hellinger.ProductState.hadamard_squared
statement: theorem hadamard_squared (n : ℕ) : hadamard n * hadamard n = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext x z
  change (∑ s, (normalization n * Fourier.phase s x) *
    (normalization n * Fourier.phase z s)) = (1 : Matrix (Cube n) (Cube n) ℝ) x z
  calc
    _ = normalization n ^ 2 * ∑ s, Fourier.phase x s * Fourier.phase z s := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro s _
      rw [Fourier.phase_symm s x]
      ring
    _ = normalization n ^ 2 * (if x = z then (2 : ℝ) ^ n else 0) := by
      rw [Fourier.sum_phase_mul]
    _ = _ := by
      by_cases hxz : x = z
      · subst z
        simp [normalization_square]
      · simp [hxz, Matrix.one_apply_ne hxz]

name: Hellinger.ProductState.hadamardUnitary_coe
statement:
theorem hadamardUnitary_coe (n : ℕ) :
    (hadamardUnitary n : Matrix (Cube n) (Cube n) ℝ) = hadamard n
proof: := rfl

name: Hellinger.ProductState.state_phase
statement:
theorem state_phase (n : ℕ) (s : Cube n) (c : ℝ) (x : Cube n) :
    (state n c *ᵥ Fourier.phase s) x =
      ((1 + c) / 2) ^ (n - Fourier.degree s) *
      ((1 - c) / 2) ^ Fourier.degree s * Fourier.phase s x
proof:
:= by
  have hp : Fourier.phase s = character n (Fourier.support s) :=
    funext (Fourier.phase_character s)
  rw [hp]
  exact state_character n (Fourier.support s) c x

name: Hellinger.ProductState.state_mul_hadamard
statement:
theorem state_mul_hadamard (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    state n c * hadamard n = hadamard n * Matrix.diagonal (eigenvalue n c)
proof:
:= by
  ext x s
  rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, hadamard]
  calc
    (∑ z, state n c x z * (normalization n * Fourier.phase s z)) =
        normalization n * (state n c *ᵥ Fourier.phase s) x := by
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro z _
      ring
    _ = (normalization n * Fourier.phase s x) * eigenvalue n c s := by
      rw [state_phase]
      unfold eigenvalue
      ring

name: Hellinger.ProductState.state_diagonalization
statement:
theorem state_diagonalization (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    hadamard n * state n c * hadamard n = Matrix.diagonal (eigenvalue n c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, state_mul_hadamard, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hadamard_squared, Matrix.one_mul]

name: Hellinger.ProductState.antipodalMatrix_phase
statement:
theorem antipodalMatrix_phase (n : ℕ) (s : Cube n) (x : Cube n) :
    (antipodalMatrix n *ᵥ Fourier.phase s) x =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ Fourier.degree s * Fourier.phase s x
proof:
:= by
  have hp : Fourier.phase s = character n (Fourier.support s) :=
    funext (Fourier.phase_character s)
  rw [hp]
  exact antipodalMatrix_character n (Fourier.support s) x

name: Hellinger.ProductState.antipodalMatrix_mul_hadamard
statement:
theorem antipodalMatrix_mul_hadamard (n : ℕ) :
    antipodalMatrix n * hadamard n =
      hadamard n * Matrix.diagonal (fun s => (-1 : ℝ) ^ Fourier.degree s)
proof:
:= by
  ext x s
  rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, hadamard]
  calc
    (∑ z, antipodalMatrix n x z * (normalization n * Fourier.phase s z)) =
        normalization n * (antipodalMatrix n *ᵥ Fourier.phase s) x := by
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro z _
      ring
    _ = (normalization n * Fourier.phase s x) * ((-1 : ℝ) ^ Fourier.degree s) := by
      rw [antipodalMatrix_phase]
      ring

name: Hellinger.ProductState.antipodalMatrix_diagonalization
statement:
theorem antipodalMatrix_diagonalization (n : ℕ) :
    hadamard n * antipodalMatrix n * hadamard n =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun s => (-1 : ℝ) ^ Fourier.degree s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, antipodalMatrix_mul_hadamard, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
    hadamard_squared, Matrix.one_mul]

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.coefficient_squares
statement:
theorem coefficient_squares (f : Cube 4 → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) :
    constantTerm f ^ 2 = 1 ∧ (∀ i, linearTerms f i ^ 2 = 1) ∧
      (∀ i, mixedTerms f i ^ 2 = 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hs (x : Cube 4) : f x ^ 2 = 1 := by rcases hf x with h | h <;> norm_num [h]
  refine ⟨hs _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    fin_cases i <;> dsimp [linearTerms, constantTerm] <;>
      simp only [mul_pow, hs, mul_one]
  · intro i
    fin_cases i <;> dsimp [mixedTerms, constantTerm] <;>
      simp only [mul_pow, hs, mul_one]

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.dual_boolean
statement:
theorem dual_boolean (f : Cube 4 → ℝ) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f) :
    ∀ s, dual f s = -1 ∨ dual f s = 1
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  rcases flat_four_coefficient f hb s with h | h <;> norm_num [dual, h]

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.dual_walsh
statement: theorem dual_walsh (f : Cube 4 → ℝ) (x : Cube 4) : walsh (dual f) x = f x / 4
proof:
:= by
  change mean (fun s => (4 * walsh f s) * phase x s) = _
  have hmul : (fun s => 4 * walsh f s * phase x s) =
      (fun s => 4 * (walsh f s * phase x s)) := by funext; ring
  rw [hmul, mean_const_mul]
  change 4 * walsh (walsh f) x = _
  rw [FourierProducts.walsh_involution]
  norm_num
  ring

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.dual_bent
statement:
theorem dual_bent (f : Cube 4 → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) :
    Flatness.IsBent (dual f)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  rw [dual_walsh]
  rcases hf x with h | h <;> norm_num [h]

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.edgeAction_sq
statement:
theorem edgeAction_sq (e : Fin 6 → ℝ) (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1)
    (x : Cube 4) (i : Fin 4) : edgeAction e x i ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> dsimp [edgeAction] <;>
    simp only [mul_pow, ite_pow, he, one_pow, ite_self, mul_one]

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.signFactor_xor
statement:
private theorem signFactor_xor (a : ℝ) (ha : a ^ 2 = 1) (b c : Bool) :
    (if Bool.xor b c then a else 1) = (if b then a else 1) * (if c then a else 1)
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> cases c <;> norm_num [← pow_two, ha]

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.edgeAction_translate
statement:
theorem edgeAction_translate (e : Fin 6 → ℝ) (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1)
    (s x : Cube 4) (i : Fin 4) :
    edgeAction e (translate s x) i = edgeAction e x i * edgeAction e s i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · change (if Bool.xor (x 1) (s 1) then e 0 else 1) * (if Bool.xor (x 2) (s 2) then e 1 else 1) * (if Bool.xor (x 3) (s 3) then e 2 else 1) = ((if x 1 then e 0 else 1) * (if x 2 then e 1 else 1) * (if x 3 then e 2 else 1)) * ((if s 1 then e 0 else 1) * (if s 2 then e 1 else 1) * (if s 3 then e 2 else 1))
    simp_rw [signFactor_xor _ (he _)]
    ring
  · change (if Bool.xor (x 0) (s 0) then e 0 else 1) * (if Bool.xor (x 2) (s 2) then e 3 else 1) * (if Bool.xor (x 3) (s 3) then e 4 else 1) = ((if x 0 then e 0 else 1) * (if x 2 then e 3 else 1) * (if x 3 then e 4 else 1)) * ((if s 0 then e 0 else 1) * (if s 2 then e 3 else 1) * (if s 3 then e 4 else 1))
    simp_rw [signFactor_xor _ (he _)]
    ring
  · change (if Bool.xor (x 0) (s 0) then e 1 else 1) * (if Bool.xor (x 1) (s 1) then e 3 else 1) * (if Bool.xor (x 3) (s 3) then e 5 else 1) = ((if x 0 then e 1 else 1) * (if x 1 then e 3 else 1) * (if x 3 then e 5 else 1)) * ((if s 0 then e 1 else 1) * (if s 1 then e 3 else 1) * (if s 3 then e 5 else 1))
    simp_rw [signFactor_xor _ (he _)]
    ring
  · change (if Bool.xor (x 0) (s 0) then e 2 else 1) * (if Bool.xor (x 1) (s 1) then e 4 else 1) * (if Bool.xor (x 2) (s 2) then e 5 else 1) = ((if x 0 then e 2 else 1) * (if x 1 then e 4 else 1) * (if x 2 then e 5 else 1)) * ((if s 0 then e 2 else 1) * (if s 1 then e 4 else 1) * (if s 2 then e 5 else 1))
    simp_rw [signFactor_xor _ (he _)]
    ring

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.edgeBits_sign
statement:
theorem edgeBits_sign (e : Fin 6 → ℝ) (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1)
    (x : Cube 4) (i : Fin 4) : boolSign (edgeBits e x i) = edgeAction e x i
proof:
:= by
  rcases sq_eq_one_iff.mp (edgeAction_sq e he x i) with h | h <;>
    norm_num [edgeBits, boolSign, h]

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.edgeBits_injective
statement:
theorem edgeBits_injective (e : Fin 6 → ℝ) (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1)
    (hnd : EdgeNondegenerate e) : Function.Injective (edgeBits e)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  have heq (i : Fin 4) : edgeAction e x i = edgeAction e y i := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z : Cube 4 => boolSign (z i)) hxy
    simpa only [edgeBits_sign e he] using h
  have hall (i : Fin 4) : edgeAction e (translate y x) i = 1 := by
    rw [edgeAction_translate e he, heq, ← pow_two, edgeAction_sq e he]
  have hzero : translate y x = (fun _ => false) := by
    by_contra hz
    have h := hnd (translate y x) hz
    simp only [hall] at h
    norm_num at h
  funext i
  have h := congrFun hzero i
  cases hx : x i <;> cases hy : y i <;> simp [translate, hx, hy] at h ⊢

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.edge_mean_invariant
statement:
theorem edge_mean_invariant (e : Fin 6 → ℝ) (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1)
    (hnd : EdgeNondegenerate e) (F : Cube 4 → ℝ) :
    mean (fun x => F (edgeBits e x)) = mean F
proof:
:= by
  unfold mean
  rw [show (∑ x, F (edgeBits e x)) = ∑ x, F x from (edgeEquiv e he hnd).sum_comp F]

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.edgeAction_unit_character
statement:
theorem edgeAction_unit_character (e : Fin 6 → ℝ) (x : Cube 4) (i : Fin 4) :
    signCharacter (edgeAction e (unit i)) x = edgeAction e x i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [signCharacter, Fin.prod_univ_succ]
  fin_cases i <;> dsimp [edgeAction, unit] <;> simp only [ite_self, one_mul, mul_one] <;> ring

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.quadratic_unit
statement:
theorem quadratic_unit (c : ℝ) (l : Fin 4 → ℝ) (e : Fin 6 → ℝ) (i : Fin 4) :
    quadraticPhase c l e (unit i) = c * l i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> dsimp [quadraticPhase, unit] <;> ring

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.quadratic_coordinate_derivative
statement:
theorem quadratic_coordinate_derivative (c : ℝ) (l : Fin 4 → ℝ) (e : Fin 6 → ℝ)
    (hc : c ^ 2 = 1) (hl : ∀ i, l i ^ 2 = 1) (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1)
    (x : Cube 4) (i : Fin 4) :
    quadraticPhase c l e x * quadraticPhase c l e (translate (unit i) x) =
      l i * edgeAction e x i
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadratic_polar c l e hc hl he, edgeAction_unit_character, quadratic_unit]
  calc
    c * (c * l i) * edgeAction e x i = c ^ 2 * (l i * edgeAction e x i) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hc, one_mul]

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.linearBits_sign
statement:
theorem linearBits_sign (l : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hl : ∀ i, l i ^ 2 = 1) (i : Fin 4) :
    boolSign (linearBits l i) = l i
proof:
:= by
  rcases sq_eq_one_iff.mp (hl i) with h | h <;> norm_num [linearBits, boolSign, h]

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.sign_disagreement
statement:
private theorem sign_disagreement (a b : Bool) :
    (1 - boolSign a * boolSign b) / 2 = if Bool.xor b a then (1 : ℝ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> norm_num [boolSign]

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.degree_eq_sum
statement: theorem degree_eq_sum (x : Cube 4) : (degree x : ℝ) = ∑ i, if x i then (1 : ℝ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [degree, support, Finset.sum_boole]

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.quadratic_sensitivity
statement:
theorem quadratic_sensitivity (c : ℝ) (l : Fin 4 → ℝ) (e : Fin 6 → ℝ)
    (hc : c ^ 2 = 1) (hl : ∀ i, l i ^ 2 = 1) (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1)
    (x : Cube 4) :
    Flatness.sensitivity (quadraticPhase c l e) x =
      (degree (translate (linearBits l) (edgeBits e x)) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Flatness.sensitivity Flatness.sensitivityIndicator
  simp_rw [quadratic_coordinate_derivative c l e hc hl he]
  rw [degree_eq_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [← linearBits_sign l hl i, ← edgeBits_sign e he x i, sign_disagreement]
  rfl

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.quadratic_sensitivity_distribution
statement:
theorem quadratic_sensitivity_distribution (c : ℝ) (l : Fin 4 → ℝ) (e : Fin 6 → ℝ)
    (hc : c ^ 2 = 1) (hl : ∀ i, l i ^ 2 = 1) (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1)
    (hnd : EdgeNondegenerate e) (Φ : ℝ → ℝ) :
    mean (fun x => Φ (Flatness.sensitivity (quadraticPhase c l e) x)) =
      mean (fun x : Cube 4 => Φ (degree x))
