proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [quadratic_sensitivity c l e hc hl he]
  rw [edge_mean_invariant e he hnd (fun x => Φ (degree (translate (linearBits l) x)))]
  exact mean_translate (fun x : Cube 4 => Φ (degree x)) (linearBits l)

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.sqrt_degree_mean
statement:
theorem sqrt_degree_mean :
    mean (fun x : Cube 4 => Real.sqrt (degree x)) =
      (3 + 3 * Real.sqrt 2 + 2 * Real.sqrt 3) / 8
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [degree_eq_sum]
  simp only [mean, cube_card, sum_four_bits, Fintype.sum_bool, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  dsimp
  norm_num
  have h4 : Real.sqrt (4 : ℝ) = 2 := by
    rw [show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)]
  rw [h4]
  ring

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.bent_four_sensitivity_mean
statement:
theorem bent_four_sensitivity_mean (f : Cube 4 → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f) :
    mean (fun x => Real.sqrt (Flatness.sensitivity f x)) =
      (3 + 3 * Real.sqrt 2 + 2 * Real.sqrt 3) / 8
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hc, hl, he⟩ := coefficient_squares f hf
  have hrep := bent_quadratic_representation f hf hb
  have hnd := quadratic_bent_nondegenerate (constantTerm f) (linearTerms f) (mixedTerms f)
    hc hl he (by rw [← hrep]; exact hb)
  conv_lhs => rw [hrep]
  rw [quadratic_sensitivity_distribution (constantTerm f) (linearTerms f) (mixedTerms f)
    hc hl he hnd Real.sqrt, sqrt_degree_mean]

name: Hellinger.ProductStateSemantics.antipodal_iff_anticommutes
statement:
theorem antipodal_iff_anticommutes (n : ℕ) (f : Cube n → ℝ) :
    (∀ x, f (antipode n x) = -f x) ↔
      Matrix.diagonal f * antipodalMatrix n = -(antipodalMatrix n * Matrix.diagonal f)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact reflection_anticommutes n f
  · intro h x
    have hm := congrArg (fun A : Matrix (Cube n) (Cube n) ℝ => (A *ᵥ (fun _ => 1)) x) h
    simp only [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.neg_mulVec, Pi.neg_apply,
      Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, antipodalMatrix_apply, mul_one] at hm
    linarith

name: Hellinger.ProductStateSemantics.state_commutes_spin
statement:
theorem state_commutes_spin (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    Commute (state n c) (spin n i)
proof:
:= by
  apply (Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (hadamardUnitary n)).injective
  change Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (hadamardUnitary n) (state n c * spin n i) =
    Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (hadamardUnitary n) (spin n i * state n c)
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, transformed_state, transformed_spin]
  simp [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, mul_comm]

name: Hellinger.ProductStateSemantics.state_commutes_antipode
statement:
theorem state_commutes_antipode (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    Commute (state n c) (antipodalMatrix n)
proof:
:= by
  apply (Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (hadamardUnitary n)).injective
  change Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (hadamardUnitary n) (state n c * antipodalMatrix n) =
    Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (hadamardUnitary n) (antipodalMatrix n * state n c)
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, transformed_state, transformed_antipodalMatrix]
  simp [parityDiagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, mul_comm]

name: Hellinger.ProductStateSemantics.spin_isHermitian
statement: theorem spin_isHermitian (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) : (spin n i).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  apply (Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (hadamardUnitary n)).injective
  change Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (hadamardUnitary n) (star (spin n i)) =
    Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (hadamardUnitary n) (spin n i)
  rw [map_star, transformed_spin]
  exact Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal_iff.mpr (fun _ => IsSelfAdjoint.all _)

name: Hellinger.ProductStateSemantics.spin_trace_zero
statement: theorem spin_trace_zero (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) : (spin n i).trace = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hn (x : Cube n) : Fourier.translationEquiv (Fourier.unit i) x ≠ x := by
    intro h
    have hi := congrFun h i
    change (Fourier.translate (Fourier.unit i) x) i = x i at hi
    rw [Fourier.translate_unit, Function.update_self] at hi
    cases hx : x i <;> simp [hx] at hi
  unfold Matrix.trace Matrix.diag
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro x _
  simp [spin, Equiv.toPEquiv_apply, hn x]

name: Hellinger.ProductStateSemantics.coordinate_spin_zero_distance
statement:
theorem coordinate_spin_zero_distance (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    (spin n i).IsHermitian ∧ spin n i * spin n i = 1 ∧ (spin n i).trace = 0 ∧
      traceNorm (state n c - spin n i * state n c * spin n i) / 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨spin_isHermitian n i, spin_squared n i, spin_trace_zero n i, ?_⟩
  rw [← (state_commutes_spin n c i).eq, Matrix.mul_assoc, spin_squared,
    Matrix.mul_one, sub_self, traceNorm_zero, zero_div]

name: Hellinger.ProductStateSemantics.multiplication_fourier_diagonal
statement:
theorem multiplication_fourier_diagonal (n : ℕ) (f : Cube n → ℝ) (s : Cube n) :
    transformedReflection n f s s = mean f
proof:
:= by
  rw [multiplication_xor]
  have ht : Fourier.translate s s = (fun _ => false) := by
    funext i
    exact Bool.xor_self _
  rw [ht, Fourier.walsh_zero]

name: Hellinger.ProductStateSemantics.multiplication_trace_zero_of_balanced
statement:
theorem multiplication_trace_zero_of_balanced (n : ℕ) (f : Cube n → ℝ) (hf : mean f = 0) :
    (Matrix.diagonal f).trace = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.trace_diagonal]
  have hp : (Fintype.card (Cube n) : ℝ)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by simp [Cube]
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hf).resolve_left hp

name: Hellinger.AllQuadratic.support_nonempty
statement: theorem support_nonempty {n : ℕ} (v : Cube n) (hv : v ≠ 0) : (support v).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  apply hv
  funext i
  by_contra hi
  have hi1 := eq_one_of_ne_zero (v i) hi
  exact h ⟨i, by simp [support, hi1]⟩

name: Hellinger.AllQuadratic.bits_flip_support
statement:
theorem bits_flip_support {n : ℕ} (v : Cube n) (x : PaperSpecs.Cube n) :
    bitsEquiv (Fin n) (PaperSpecs.flip (support v) x) = bitsEquiv (Fin n) x + v
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := bitEquiv.surjective (v i)
  simp only [bitsEquiv_apply, PaperSpecs.flip, support, Finset.mem_filter,
    Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Pi.add_apply, ← hb]
  cases x i <;> cases b <;> norm_num [show (1 : F2) + 1 = 0 from rfl]

name: Hellinger.AllQuadratic.translation_phase_bound
statement:
theorem translation_phase_bound {n : ℕ} (a : F2) (Q : Form n) (v : Cube n)
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hanti : ∀ x, phase a Q (x + v) = -phase a Q x)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    PaperSpecs.HellingerBound (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) ρ hρ ∧
    (0 < ρ → ρ < 1 →
      (objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n))) = 1 - root ρ ↔
        PaperSpecs.SignedDictatorOn (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) Finset.univ))
proof:
:= by
  let f := phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)
  have hf : PaperSpecs.IsBoolean f := fun x => phase_boolean a Q _
  have hs : PaperSpecs.SignReversing f (support v) := by
    intro x
    change phase a Q (bitsEquiv (Fin n) (PaperSpecs.flip (support v) x)) = _
    rw [bits_flip_support]
    exact hanti _
  have ht := translation_hellinger n f hf (support v) (support_nonempty v hv) hs ρ hρ
  refine ⟨ht.2.2, ?_⟩
  intro hp hl
  constructor
  · intro heq
    have hr : PaperSpecs.posteriorRootMean f ρ hρ = root ρ := by
      unfold objective at heq
      rw [UniformChannel.mean_apply, ht.1] at heq
      have hz : root (0 : ℝ) = 1 := by norm_num [root]
      rw [hz] at heq
      exact sub_right_injective heq
    obtain ⟨i, _, negative, hf⟩ :=
      (TranslationEquality.translation_equality n f hf (support v)
        (support_nonempty v hv) hs ρ hρ hp hl).mp hr
    exact ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, negative, hf⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, _, negative, hf⟩
    rw [hf]
    exact bsc_signed_dictator_equality n i negative ρ hρ

name: Hellinger.AllQuadratic.constant_objective
statement:
theorem constant_objective {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (K : UniformChannel Ω) (c : ℝ) : objective (K.apply (fun _ => c)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have heq : K.apply (fun _ => c) = fun _ => c := by
    funext x
    simp only [UniformChannel.apply, ← Finset.sum_mul, K.row_sum, one_mul]
  simp only [heq, objective, mean_const, sub_self]

name: Hellinger.AllQuadratic.root_le_one
statement: theorem root_le_one (ρ : ℝ) : root ρ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold root
  exact Real.sqrt_le_iff.mpr ⟨by norm_num, by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ρ]⟩

name: Hellinger.AllQuadratic.root_lt_one
statement: theorem root_lt_one (ρ : ℝ) (hp : 0 < ρ) : root ρ < 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold root
  exact (Real.sqrt_lt' (by norm_num)).mpr (by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hp])

name: Hellinger.AllQuadratic.quotient_phase_bound
statement:
theorem quotient_phase_bound {n k : ℕ} (a : F2) (Q : Form n) (Q₀ : Form k)
    (L : Cube n →ₗ[F2] Cube k) (hL : Function.Surjective L)
    (hQ₀ : Q₀.polarBilin.ker = ⊥) (hf : phase a Q = phase a Q₀ ∘ L)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    PaperSpecs.HellingerBound (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) ρ hρ ∧
    (0 < ρ → objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply
      (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n))) < 1 - root ρ)
proof:
:= by
  have hg : ∀ x, phase a Q₀ x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
    intro x
    rcases phase_boolean a Q₀ x with hx | hx <;> simp [hx]
  obtain ⟨M, _, hcmp⟩ := LinearQuotient.linear_quotient_objective_comparison n k L hL
    (phase a Q₀) hg
  have hc := hcmp ρ hρ
  rw [← hf, noise_objective_bits, noise_objective_bits] at hc
  change objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n))) ≤
    objective ((cubeBSC k ρ hρ).apply ((phase a Q₀ ∘ M) ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin k))) at hc
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · subst k
    have hfun : ((phase a Q₀ ∘ M) ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin 0)) = fun _ => phase a Q₀ 0 := by
      funext x
      exact congrArg (phase a Q₀) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    rw [hfun, constant_objective] at hc
    exact ⟨hc.trans (by linarith [root_le_one ρ]), fun hp =>
      hc.trans_lt (by linarith [root_lt_one ρ hp])⟩
  · have hb := bent_linearEquiv k (phase a Q₀) (phase_boolean a Q₀)
      (phase_bent a Q₀ hQ₀) M
    have ht := AllBent.bent_hellinger k (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk)
      ((phase a Q₀ ∘ M) ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin k)) (fun x => phase_boolean a Q₀ _) hb ρ hρ
    exact ⟨hc.trans ht.1, fun hp => hc.trans_lt (ht.2 hp)⟩

name: Hellinger.AllQuadratic.phase_hellinger
statement:
theorem phase_hellinger {n : ℕ} (a : F2) (Q : Form n)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    PaperSpecs.HellingerBound (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) ρ hρ ∧
    (0 < ρ → ρ < 1 →
      (objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n))) = 1 - root ρ ↔
        PaperSpecs.SignedDictatorOn (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) Finset.univ))
proof:
:= by
  rcases radical_dichotomy a Q with ⟨v, hv, hanti⟩ | ⟨k, L, hL, Q₀, hQ₀, hf⟩
  · exact translation_phase_bound a Q v hv hanti ρ hρ
  · have h := quotient_phase_bound a Q Q₀ L hL hQ₀ hf ρ hρ
    refine ⟨h.1, fun hp _ => ?_⟩
    constructor
    · intro heq
      exact False.elim ((ne_of_lt (h.2 hp)) heq)
    · rintro ⟨i, _, negative, heq⟩
      rw [heq]
      exact bsc_signed_dictator_equality n i negative ρ hρ

name: Hellinger.AllQuadratic.paper_quadratic_hellinger
statement: theorem paper_quadratic_hellinger : PaperSpecs.QuadraticHellinger
proof:
:= by
  intro n _ f hquad ρ hρ
  obtain ⟨a, b, q, hq⟩ := hquad
  have hf : f = phase a (polynomial b q) ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n) := by
    funext x
    exact (hq x).trans (polynomial_phase_bits a b q x).symm
  rw [hf]
  exact phase_hellinger a (polynomial b q) ρ hρ

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.boolean_has_both_signs
statement:
theorem boolean_has_both_signs {Ω : Type*} (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hnonconstant : ∃ x z, f x ≠ f z) :
    (∃ x, f x = 1) ∧ ∃ x, f x = -1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, z, hxz⟩ := hnonconstant
  rcases hf x with hx | hx <;> rcases hf z with hz | hz
  · exact False.elim (hxz (hx.trans hz.symm))
  · exact ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, ⟨x, hx⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨z, hz⟩⟩
  · exact False.elim (hxz (hx.trans hz.symm))

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.bsc_weight_pos
statement:
theorem bsc_weight_pos (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρlt : ρ < 1)
    (y x : Bool) : 0 < (bsc ρ hρ).weight y x
proof:
:= by
  change 0 < if y = x then (1 + ρ) / 2 else (1 - ρ) / 2
  split_ifs <;> linarith [hρ.1]

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.cube_weight_pos
statement:
theorem cube_weight_pos (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hρlt : ρ < 1) (y x : Cube n) : 0 < (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).weight y x
proof:
:= by
  change 0 < ∏ i : Fin n, (bsc ρ hρ).weight (y i) (x i)
  exact Finset.prod_pos (fun i _ => bsc_weight_pos ρ hρ hρlt (y i) (x i))

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.apply_strict_bounds
statement:
theorem apply_strict_bounds {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (K : UniformChannel Ω) (hK : ∀ y x, 0 < K.weight y x) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hnonconstant : ∃ x z, f x ≠ f z) (y : Ω) :
    -1 < K.apply f y ∧ K.apply f y < 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨xp, hxp⟩, ⟨xm, hxm⟩⟩ := boolean_has_both_signs f hf hnonconstant
  have hb (x : Ω) : -1 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ 1 := by
    rcases hf x with h | h <;> norm_num [h]
  constructor
  · calc
      -1 = ∑ x, K.weight y x * (-1) := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, K.row_sum]; ring
      _ < K.apply f y := by
        apply Finset.sum_lt_sum
        · intro x hx
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hb x).1 (hK y x).le
        · refine ⟨xp, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
          rw [hxp]
          linarith [hK y xp]
  · calc
      K.apply f y < ∑ x, K.weight y x * 1 := by
        apply Finset.sum_lt_sum
        · intro x hx
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hb x).2 (hK y x).le
        · refine ⟨xm, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
          rw [hxm]
          linarith [hK y xm]
      _ = 1 := by simp only [mul_one, K.row_sum]

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.posterior_strict_bounds
statement:
theorem posterior_strict_bounds {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hnonconstant : ∃ x z, f x ≠ f z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρlt : ρ < 1) (y : Cube n) :
    -1 < (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y ∧ (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y < 1
proof:
:=
  apply_strict_bounds (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) (cube_weight_pos n ρ hρ hρlt)
    f hf hnonconstant y

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.plus_norm_sq
statement:
theorem plus_norm_sq {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (K : UniformChannel Ω) (y : Ω) :
    plusVector f K y ⬝ᵥ plusVector f K y = (1 + K.apply f y) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have he (x : Ω) : plusVector f K y x * plusVector f K y x =
      (K.weight y x + K.weight y x * f x) / 2 := by
    rcases hf x with h | h
    · norm_num [plusVector, h]
    · simp only [plusVector, h, if_true, posteriorVector, Real.mul_self_sqrt (K.nonneg y x)]
      ring
  unfold dotProduct
  simp only [he]
  rw [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_add_distrib, K.row_sum]
  rfl

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.minus_norm_sq
statement:
theorem minus_norm_sq {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (K : UniformChannel Ω) (y : Ω) :
    minusVector f K y ⬝ᵥ minusVector f K y = (1 - K.apply f y) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have he (x : Ω) : minusVector f K y x * minusVector f K y x =
      (K.weight y x - K.weight y x * f x) / 2 := by
    rcases hf x with h | h
    · norm_num [minusVector, h, posteriorVector, Real.mul_self_sqrt (K.nonneg y x)]
    · simp only [minusVector, h, if_true]
      ring
  unfold dotProduct
  simp only [he]
  rw [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, K.row_sum]
  rfl

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.component_orthogonal
statement:
theorem component_orthogonal {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (K : UniformChannel Ω) (y z : Ω) :
    plusVector f K y ⬝ᵥ minusVector f K z = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro x hx
  by_cases h : f x = 1 <;> simp [plusVector, minusVector, h]

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.bsc_flip_sum
statement:
theorem bsc_flip_sum (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (y x : Bool) :
    (bsc ρ hρ).weight y x + (bsc ρ hρ).weight (!y) x = 1
proof:
:= by
  cases y <;> cases x <;> simp [bsc] <;> ring

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.bsc_flip_sqrt_product
statement:
theorem bsc_flip_sqrt_product (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (y x : Bool) :
    Real.sqrt ((bsc ρ hρ).weight y x) *
      Real.sqrt ((bsc ρ hρ).weight (!y) x) = root ρ / 2
proof:
:= by
  cases y <;> cases x <;> simpa [bsc, mul_comm] using bsc_sqrt_cross ρ hρ

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.cube_weight_split
statement:
theorem cube_weight_split {n : ℕ} (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (y x : Cube n) (i : Fin n) :
    (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).weight y x =
      (bsc ρ hρ).weight (y i) (x i) *
        ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (bsc ρ hρ).weight (y j) (x j)
proof:
:= by
  exact (Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ
    (fun j => (bsc ρ hρ).weight (y j) (x j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)).symm

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.cube_weight_neighbor_sum
statement:
theorem cube_weight_neighbor_sum {n : ℕ} (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (y x : Cube n) (i : Fin n) :
    (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).weight y x +
      (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).weight (Function.update y i (!(y i))) x =
        ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (bsc ρ hρ).weight (y j) (x j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cube_weight_split ρ hρ y x i,
    cube_weight_split ρ hρ (Function.update y i (!(y i))) x i]
  simp only [Function.update_self]
  have he :
      (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        (bsc ρ hρ).weight ((Function.update y i (!(y i))) j) (x j)) =
      ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (bsc ρ hρ).weight (y j) (x j) := by
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [Function.update_of_ne (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1]
  rw [he, ← add_mul, bsc_flip_sum, one_mul]

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.posterior_neighbor_product
statement:
theorem posterior_neighbor_product {n : ℕ} (ρ : ℝ)
    (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (y x : Cube n) (i : Fin n) :
    posteriorVector (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y x *
      posteriorVector (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) (Function.update y i (!(y i))) x =
      root ρ / 2 * ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).weight y x +
        (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).weight (Function.update y i (!(y i))) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cube_weight_neighbor_sum]
  simp only [cube_posterior_product, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ
    (fun j => Real.sqrt ((bsc ρ hρ).weight (y j) (x j)) *
      Real.sqrt ((bsc ρ hρ).weight ((Function.update y i (!(y i))) j) (x j)))
    (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  simp only [Function.update_self, bsc_flip_sqrt_product]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [Function.update_of_ne (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1,
    Real.mul_self_sqrt ((bsc ρ hρ).nonneg (y j) (x j))]

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.plus_neighbor_inner
statement:
theorem plus_neighbor_inner {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (y : Cube n) (i : Fin n) :
    plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y ⬝ᵥ
      plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) (Function.update y i (!(y i))) =
      root ρ / 2 * (1 + ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y +
        (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f (Function.update y i (!(y i)))) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have he (x : Cube n) :
      plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y x *
        plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) (Function.update y i (!(y i))) x =
      root ρ / 2 *
        (plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y x * plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y x +
          plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) (Function.update y i (!(y i))) x *
            plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) (Function.update y i (!(y i))) x) := by
    by_cases h : f x = 1
    · simp only [plusVector, h, if_true]
      rw [posterior_neighbor_product]
      simp only [posteriorVector, Real.mul_self_sqrt ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).nonneg _ _)]
    · simp [plusVector, h]
  unfold dotProduct
  simp only [he, ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  change root ρ / 2 * (plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y ⬝ᵥ
      plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y +
      plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) (Function.update y i (!(y i))) ⬝ᵥ
        plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) (Function.update y i (!(y i)))) = _
  rw [plus_norm_sq f hf, plus_norm_sq f hf]
  ring

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.minus_neighbor_inner
statement:
theorem minus_neighbor_inner {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (y : Cube n) (i : Fin n) :
    minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y ⬝ᵥ
      minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) (Function.update y i (!(y i))) =
      root ρ / 2 * (1 - ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y +
        (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f (Function.update y i (!(y i)))) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have he (x : Cube n) :
      minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y x *
        minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) (Function.update y i (!(y i))) x =
      root ρ / 2 *
        (minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y x * minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y x +
          minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) (Function.update y i (!(y i))) x *
            minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) (Function.update y i (!(y i))) x) := by
    by_cases h : f x = 1
    · simp [minusVector, h]
    · simp only [minusVector, h, if_false]
      rw [posterior_neighbor_product]
      simp only [posteriorVector, Real.mul_self_sqrt ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).nonneg _ _)]
  unfold dotProduct
  simp only [he, ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  change root ρ / 2 * (minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y ⬝ᵥ
      minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y +
      minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) (Function.update y i (!(y i))) ⬝ᵥ
        minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) (Function.update y i (!(y i)))) = _
  rw [minus_norm_sq f hf, minus_norm_sq f hf]
  ring

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.sqrt_half_product
statement:
theorem sqrt_half_product (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    Real.sqrt (a / 2) * Real.sqrt (b / 2) = Real.sqrt (a * b) / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Real.sqrt_mul (div_nonneg ha (by norm_num))]
  rw [show a / 2 * (b / 2) = (a * b) / 4 by ring]
  rw [Real.sqrt_div' _ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4)]
  norm_num

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.root_eq_two_component_norms
statement:
theorem root_eq_two_component_norms {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (K : UniformChannel Ω) (y : Ω) :
    root (K.apply f y) =
      2 * Real.sqrt (plusVector f K y ⬝ᵥ plusVector f K y) *
        Real.sqrt (minusVector f K y ⬝ᵥ minusVector f K y)
proof:
:= by
  have hb := K.apply_mem_Icc f (fun x => by
    rcases hf x with h | h <;> norm_num [h]) y
  rw [plus_norm_sq f hf, minus_norm_sq f hf, mul_assoc, sqrt_half_product _ _
    (by linarith [hb.1])]
  rw [show (1 + K.apply f y) * (1 - K.apply f y) = 1 - K.apply f y ^ 2 by ring]
  unfold root
  ring

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.pureDifference_components
statement:
theorem pureDifference_components {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (K : UniformChannel Ω) (y : Ω) :
    MatrixLifting.pureDifference (posteriorVector K y)
      (reflectedVector f (posteriorVector K y)) =
      (2 : ℝ) • (Matrix.vecMulVec (plusVector f K y) (minusVector f K y) +
        Matrix.vecMulVec (minusVector f K y) (plusVector f K y))
proof:
:= by
  ext x z
  rcases hf x with hx | hx <;> rcases hf z with hz | hz <;>
    norm_num [MatrixLifting.pureDifference, reflectedVector, plusVector, minusVector,
      Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, hx, hz] <;> ring

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.average_component_cross
statement:
theorem average_component_cross {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω]
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (K : UniformChannel Ω) :
    averageProjection K - reflection f * averageProjection K * reflection f =
      (2 : ℝ) • ∑ y, (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹ •
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (plusVector f K y) (minusVector f K y) +
          Matrix.vecMulVec (minusVector f K y) (plusVector f K y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [average_difference]
  simp only [pureDifference_components f hf, Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro y hy
  exact smul_comm _ _ _

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.weighted_component_roots
statement:
theorem weighted_component_roots {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (K : UniformChannel Ω) :
    (2 : ℝ) * ∑ y, (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        Real.sqrt (plusVector f K y ⬝ᵥ plusVector f K y) *
        Real.sqrt (minusVector f K y ⬝ᵥ minusVector f K y) =
      mean (fun y => root (K.apply f y))
proof:
:= by
  unfold mean
  simp only [root_eq_two_component_norms f hf, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro y hy
  ring

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.cross_equality_of_lifting_equality
statement:
theorem cross_equality_of_lifting_equality {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω]
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (K : UniformChannel Ω)
    (heq : TraceNorm.traceNorm
      (averageProjection K - reflection f * averageProjection K * reflection f) / 2 =
        mean (fun y => root (K.apply f y))) :
    TraceNorm.traceNorm
      (∑ y, (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹ •
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (plusVector f K y) (minusVector f K y) +
          Matrix.vecMulVec (minusVector f K y) (plusVector f K y))) =
      2 * ∑ y, (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        Real.sqrt (plusVector f K y ⬝ᵥ plusVector f K y) *
        Real.sqrt (minusVector f K y ⬝ᵥ minusVector f K y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [average_component_cross f hf, TraceNorm.traceNorm_smul] at heq
  norm_num only [abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)] at heq
  rw [weighted_component_roots f hf]
  linarith

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.component_norms_pos
statement:
theorem component_norms_pos {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hnonconstant : ∃ x z, f x ≠ f z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρlt : ρ < 1) (y : Cube n) :
    0 < plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y ⬝ᵥ plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y ∧
      0 < minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y ⬝ᵥ minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [plus_norm_sq f hf, minus_norm_sq f hf]
  have h := posterior_strict_bounds f hf hnonconstant ρ hρ hρlt y
  constructor <;> linarith

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.normalized_gram_of_component_equality
statement:
theorem normalized_gram_of_component_equality (p q c : ℝ)
    (hp : -1 < p ∧ p < 1) (hq : -1 < q ∧ q < 1) (hc : 0 < c)
    (h :
      (c / 2 * (1 + (p + q) / 2)) /
          (Real.sqrt ((1 + p) / 2) * Real.sqrt ((1 + q) / 2)) =
        (c / 2 * (1 - (p + q) / 2)) /
          (Real.sqrt ((1 - p) / 2) * Real.sqrt ((1 - q) / 2))) :
    (1 + (p + q) / 2) / Real.sqrt ((1 + p) * (1 + q)) =
      (1 - (p + q) / 2) / Real.sqrt ((1 - p) * (1 - q))
proof:
:= by
  have hplus : Real.sqrt ((1 + p) * (1 + q)) ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (mul_pos (by linarith [hp.1]) (by linarith [hq.1])))
  have hminus : Real.sqrt ((1 - p) * (1 - q)) ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (mul_pos (by linarith [hp.2]) (by linarith [hq.2])))
  rw [sqrt_half_product _ _ (by linarith [hp.1]),
    sqrt_half_product _ _ (by linarith [hp.2])] at h
  have hleft :
      (c / 2 * (1 + (p + q) / 2)) / (Real.sqrt ((1 + p) * (1 + q)) / 2) =
      c * ((1 + (p + q) / 2) / Real.sqrt ((1 + p) * (1 + q))) := by
    field_simp
  have hright :
      (c / 2 * (1 - (p + q) / 2)) / (Real.sqrt ((1 - p) * (1 - q)) / 2) =
      c * ((1 - (p + q) / 2) / Real.sqrt ((1 - p) * (1 - q))) := by
    field_simp
  rw [hleft, hright] at h
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hc) h

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.posterior_abs_constant_of_component_gram
statement:
theorem posterior_abs_constant_of_component_gram {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hnonconstant : ∃ x z, f x ≠ f z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρlt : ρ < 1)
    (hgram : ∀ y z : Cube n,
      (plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y ⬝ᵥ plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) z) /
        (Real.sqrt (plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y ⬝ᵥ plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y) *
          Real.sqrt (plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) z ⬝ᵥ plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) z)) =
      (minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y ⬝ᵥ minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) z) /
        (Real.sqrt (minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y ⬝ᵥ minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y) *
          Real.sqrt (minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) z ⬝ᵥ minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) z))) :
    ∀ y z, |(cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y| = |(cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f z|
proof:
:= by
  have hb := posterior_strict_bounds f hf hnonconstant ρ hρ hρlt
  apply Rigidity.abs_constant_of_normalized_edge_gram ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) hb
  intro y i
  have hg := hgram y (Function.update y i (!(y i)))
  rw [plus_neighbor_inner f hf, minus_neighbor_inner f hf] at hg
  simp only [plus_norm_sq f hf, minus_norm_sq f hf] at hg
  have hc : 0 < root ρ := by
    unfold root
    apply Real.sqrt_pos.2
    nlinarith [hρ.1]
  have hh := normalized_gram_of_component_equality _ _ _ (hb y) (hb _) hc hg
  simpa only [add_comm, mul_comm] using hh

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.balanced_boolean_nonconstant
statement:
theorem balanced_boolean_nonconstant {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hm : mean f = 0) :
    ∃ x z, f x ≠ f z
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  let x₀ : Cube n := fun _ => false
  have hc : f = fun _ => f x₀ := funext (fun x => h x x₀)
  have hmean : mean f = f x₀ := calc
    mean f = mean (fun _ : Cube n => f x₀) := congrArg mean hc
    _ = f x₀ := mean_const _
  have hz : f x₀ = 0 := hmean.symm.trans hm
  rcases hf x₀ with hs | hs <;> linarith

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.noise_second_moment_of_abs_constant_and_objective_eq
statement:
theorem noise_second_moment_of_abs_constant_and_objective_eq {n : ℕ}
    (f : Cube n → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hm : mean f = 0)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (habs : ∀ y z, |(cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y| = |(cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f z|)
    (hobj : objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) = 1 - root ρ) :
    mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x) ^ 2) = ρ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let x₀ : Cube n := fun _ => false
  have hsq (x : Cube n) :
      (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x ^ 2 = (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x₀ ^ 2 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun r : ℝ => r ^ 2) (habs x x₀)
    rw [_root_.sq_abs ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x),
      _root_.sq_abs ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x₀)] at h
    exact h
  have hroot (x : Cube n) :
      root ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x) = root ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x₀) := by
    unfold root
    rw [hsq x]
  have hmroot :
      mean (fun x => root ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x)) =
        root ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x₀) := by
    simp only [hroot, mean_const]
  unfold objective at hobj
  rw [UniformChannel.mean_apply, hm, hmroot] at hobj
  have hr0 : root (0 : ℝ) = 1 := by norm_num [root]
  rw [hr0] at hobj
  have hr : root ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x₀) = root ρ := by linarith
  have hb := (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply_mem_Icc f
    (fun x => by rcases hf x with h | h <;> norm_num [h]) x₀
  have hp : 0 ≤ 1 - (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x₀ ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb.2) (show 0 ≤ 1 + (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x₀ by linarith [hb.1])]
  have hρsq : 0 ≤ 1 - ρ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hρ.1, hρ.2]
  have hp2 : root ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x₀) ^ 2 =
      1 - (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x₀ ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt hp
  have hρ2 : root ρ ^ 2 = 1 - ρ ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt hρsq
  rw [hr] at hp2
  have heq : (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x₀ ^ 2 = ρ ^ 2 := by linarith
  simp only [hsq, heq, mean_const]

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.posterior_abs_constant_of_lifting_equality
statement:
theorem posterior_abs_constant_of_lifting_equality {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hnonconstant : ∃ x z, f x ≠ f z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρlt : ρ < 1)
    (heq : TraceNorm.traceNorm
      (averageProjection (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) -
        reflection f * averageProjection (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) * reflection f) / 2 =
        mean (fun y => root ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y))) :
    ∀ y z, |(cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y| = |(cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f z|
proof:
:= by
  apply posterior_abs_constant_of_component_gram f hf hnonconstant ρ hρ hρlt
  have hnorm := component_norms_pos f hf hnonconstant ρ hρ hρlt
  have hcross := cross_equality_of_lifting_equality f hf (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) heq
  intro y z
  exact TraceEquality.weighted_cross_trace_equality_gram
    (fun _ : Cube n => (Fintype.card (Cube n) : ℝ)⁻¹)
    (plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ)) (minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ))
    (fun _ => by positivity) (fun y => (hnorm y).1) (fun y => (hnorm y).2)
    hcross y z

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.bsc_posterior_abs_constant_of_lifting_equality
statement:
theorem bsc_posterior_abs_constant_of_lifting_equality {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hnonconstant : ∃ x z, f x ≠ f z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρlt : ρ < 1)
    (heq : TraceNorm.traceNorm
      (ProductState.state n (root ρ) -
        reflection f * ProductState.state n (root ρ) * reflection f) / 2 =
        mean (fun y => root ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y))) :
    ∀ y z, |(cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y| = |(cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f z|
proof:
:= by
  apply posterior_abs_constant_of_lifting_equality f hf hnonconstant ρ hρ hρlt
  simpa only [cube_averageProjection] using heq

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.signed_dictator_of_lifting_and_objective_equality
statement:
theorem signed_dictator_of_lifting_and_objective_equality {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hm : mean f = 0)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρpos : 0 < ρ) (hρlt : ρ < 1)
    (hlift : TraceNorm.traceNorm
      (ProductState.state n (root ρ) -
        reflection f * ProductState.state n (root ρ) * reflection f) / 2 =
        mean (fun y => root ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y)))
    (hobj : objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) = 1 - root ρ) :
    ∃ i : Fin n, ∃ a : ℝ, (a = 1 ∨ a = -1) ∧
      ∀ x, f x = a * boolSign (x i)
proof:
:= by
  have habs := bsc_posterior_abs_constant_of_lifting_equality f hf
    (balanced_boolean_nonconstant f hf hm) ρ hρ hρlt hlift
  exact Fourier.signed_dictator_of_noise_equality f hf hm ρ hρ hρpos hρlt
    (noise_second_moment_of_abs_constant_and_objective_eq f hf hm ρ hρ habs hobj)

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.signed_dictator_coordinate_in_support
statement:
theorem signed_dictator_coordinate_in_support {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (i : Fin n) (a : ℝ) (ha : a = 1 ∨ a = -1)
    (hform : ∀ x, f x = a * boolSign (x i)) (v : Cube n)
    (hv : ∀ x, f (translate v x) = -f x) : i ∈ support v
proof:
:= by
  have h := hv (fun _ => false)
  rw [hform, hform] at h
  cases hvi : v i
  · simp [translate, hvi, boolSign] at h
    rcases ha with ha | ha <;> linarith
  · simp [support, hvi]

name: Hellinger.F2Model.bitEquiv_false
statement: @[simp] theorem bitEquiv_false : bitEquiv false = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Hellinger.F2Model.bitEquiv_true
statement: @[simp] theorem bitEquiv_true : bitEquiv true = 1
proof: := rfl

name: Hellinger.F2Model.bitsEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem bitsEquiv_apply {ι : Type*} (x : ι → Bool) (i : ι) :
    bitsEquiv ι x i = bitEquiv (x i)
proof: := rfl

name: Hellinger.F2Model.bitsEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem bitsEquiv_symm_apply {ι : Type*} (x : ι → F2) (i : ι) :
    (bitsEquiv ι).symm x i = bitEquiv.symm (x i)
proof: := rfl

name: Hellinger.F2Model.sign_bit
statement: @[simp] theorem sign_bit (b : Bool) : sign (bitEquiv b) = boolSign b
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> norm_num [sign, boolSign]

name: Hellinger.F2Model.sign_add
statement: theorem sign_add (a b : F2) : sign (a + b) = sign a * sign b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := bitEquiv.surjective a
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := bitEquiv.surjective b
  cases a <;> cases b <;> norm_num [sign, show (1 : F2) + 1 = 0 from rfl]

name: Hellinger.F2Model.transportedChannel_apply
statement:
theorem transportedChannel_apply {Ω Λ : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Λ]
    (e : Ω ≃ Λ) (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Λ → ℝ) (x : Ω) :
    (transportedChannel e K).apply f (e x) = K.apply (f ∘ e) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [UniformChannel.apply, transportedChannel, Equiv.symm_apply_apply,
    Function.comp_apply]
  rw [← e.sum_comp (fun y => K.weight x (e.symm y) * f y)]
  simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: Hellinger.F2Model.oneStep_weight
statement:
theorem oneStep_weight (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x y : F2) :
    (oneStep ρ hρ).weight x y = if x = y then (1 + ρ) / 2 else (1 - ρ) / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [oneStep, transportedChannel, bsc]

name: Hellinger.F2Model.noise_weight_bits
statement:
theorem noise_weight_bits {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x y : ι → Bool) :
    (noise ι ρ hρ).weight (bitsEquiv ι x) (bitsEquiv ι y) =
      (ChannelSections.indexedBSC ι ρ hρ).weight x y
proof:
:= by
  simp [noise, UniformChannel.product, oneStep, transportedChannel,
    ChannelSections.indexedBSC]

name: Hellinger.F2Model.noise_apply_bits
statement:
theorem noise_apply_bits {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (f : (ι → F2) → ℝ) (x : ι → Bool) :
    (noise ι ρ hρ).apply f (bitsEquiv ι x) =
      (ChannelSections.indexedBSC ι ρ hρ).apply (f ∘ bitsEquiv ι) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold UniformChannel.apply
  rw [← (bitsEquiv ι).sum_comp
    (fun y => (noise ι ρ hρ).weight (bitsEquiv ι x) y * f y)]
  simp only [noise_weight_bits, Function.comp_apply]

name: Hellinger.F2Model.add_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem add_eq_zero_iff (x y : F2) : x + y = 0 ↔ x = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg, ZMod.neg_eq_self_mod_two]

name: Hellinger.F2Model.noise_weight_additive
statement:
theorem noise_weight_additive {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x y : ι → F2) :
    (noise ι ρ hρ).weight x y = errorMass ρ (x + y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [noise, UniformChannel.product, oneStep_weight, errorMass, Pi.add_apply,
    add_eq_zero_iff]

name: Hellinger.F2Model.errorMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem errorMass_nonneg {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (ρ : ℝ)
    (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (e : ι → F2) : 0 ≤ errorMass ρ e
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.prod_nonneg
  intro i _
  split_ifs <;> linarith [hρ.1, hρ.2]

name: Hellinger.F2Model.errorMass_sum
statement:
theorem errorMass_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (ρ : ℝ)
    (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : (∑ e : ι → F2, errorMass ρ e) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := (noise ι ρ hρ).row_sum 0
  simp only [noise_weight_additive, zero_add] at h
  exact h

name: Hellinger.F2Model.noise_apply_additive
statement:
theorem noise_apply_additive {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (f : (ι → F2) → ℝ) (y : ι → F2) :
    (noise ι ρ hρ).apply f y = ∑ e, errorMass ρ e * f (y + e)
proof:
:= by
  unfold UniformChannel.apply
  rw [← Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.addLeft y)
    (fun x => (noise ι ρ hρ).weight y x * f x)]
  simp only [Equiv.coe_addLeft, noise_weight_additive]
  have hyy : y + y = 0 := by
    ext i
    exact (add_eq_zero_iff (y i) (y i)).mpr rfl
  simp only [← add_assoc, hyy, zero_add]
